jobs.description:
Inbound Call Specialist – Contractor (Remote)

Department: Enrollment Operations

Reports to: Senior Enrollment Operations Manager

Type: 1099 Contractor | 10 AM–6 PM ET or 12–8 PM ET, Monday–Friday

Compensation: $25/hour, no W-2 benefits

Overview

As our Inbound Call Specialist, you'll be the first voice patients hear when they call Aviary Health about our virtual cardiac rehab program. You'll own inbound calls from start to finish: answering questions about eligibility and coverage, scheduling patients who are ready to start, and getting everyone else to the right person on our team. We're rolling out new inbound calling tools, including a shared call queue, hold, live transfer and callback scheduling, and this role will be central to how we use them.

This role is for an experienced inbound call professional who is comfortable owning a busy queue, can move between scheduling, insurance questions and routing in a single call, and makes every patient feel heard.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inbound Call Handling: Answer calls from the shared queue during your shift, find the patient's record, and resolve the reason for the call on first contact whenever possible.
  • Scheduling: When a patient is ready, schedule their first session on the call, confirm the date and time, and explain next steps, including device or app setup.
  • Eligibility and Coverage: Explain eligibility, insurance coverage and expected cost (copay, deductible or coinsurance) clearly and compassionately, using the patient's coverage notes.
  • Routing and Transfers: Place callers on hold or transfer them live to the right party (Enrollment Specialists, Insurance, Clinical, or Patient Experience/tech support) when the call needs someone else, and set a callback when no one is available.
  • Missed Calls and Voicemails: Promptly return voicemails and missed calls, especially from patients calling back after our outreach.
  • Retention: When a patient wants to cancel or reschedule, understand why and work to keep them in the program before rebooking or routing.
  • Documentation: Record every call accurately and promptly in our patient management system.
  • Feedback: Flag recurring caller issues or routing gaps to the Senior Enrollment Operations Manager so we keep improving the call experience.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of inbound call handling experience, ideally in a healthcare call center, patient access or scheduling role.
  • Experience scheduling appointments in real time on a live call.
  • Comfortable explaining insurance terms (copays, deductibles, coinsurance, Medicare and Medicare Advantage) in plain language.
  • Experience using hold, transfer and queue features in a phone system while navigating a CRM or patient management system.
  • Calm, empathetic and professional with older adults, caregivers and frustrated callers.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate, timely documentation.
  • Available 10 AM–6 PM ET or 12–8 PM ET, Monday–Friday.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private workspace suitable for confidential patient calls.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telehealth, cardiac rehab, or other healthcare enrollment settings.
  • Experience in a metrics-driven environment (answer rate, first-call resolution, scheduling conversion).

Contract Details

  • Contract Type: 1099 Contractor
  • Schedule: 10 AM–6 PM ET or 12–8 PM ET, Monday–Friday (about 40 hours/week)
  • Compensation: $25/hour
  • Location: Remote (U.S.-based)

*Note: This is a 1099 contractor position

About the Role

Anovia is looking for a Project Engineer to deliver Microsoft 365, identity, and migration projects for our clients. This is hands-on cloud engineering, not advisory work: you build and harden tenants, untangle hybrid identity, manage devices through Intune, and move mail, files, and users between platforms without losing data or a weekend.

You will work across many client tenants at once, typically with two to five projects running in parallel at different stages. Each project is yours to execute — discovery, build, pilot, cutover, handover — with a senior engineer available for architecture calls.

The experience bar

• 5-10 years in IT overall, with at least 2 years administering Microsoft 365 and Entra IDacross more than one organization or tenant.

• At least five migrations you personally executed— mailbox, tenant-to-tenant, file, or Active Directory domain — with the tooling you used named.

• You own the technical execution and escalate architecture decisions. You are not expected to design a client's identity strategy from scratch; you are expected to implement one correctly and spot when it is wrong.

What you'll do

Migrations

• Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools — discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.

• Agree rollback criteria and a downtime window with the client before the window opens, and hold to them.

• Reconcile what actually moved against what was supposed to move, and chase the difference.

Microsoft 365 and Entra ID

• Run mailbox, tenant, file, and domain migrations end to end using various migration tools — discovery, pilot group, cutover plan, cutover, post-cutover support.

Azure and endpoints

Delivery and handover

Required qualifications

All four of the pillars below are required. Within each, you should be able to do most of what is listed without supervision.

1. Microsoft 365 administration

• Mail DNS: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Autodiscover, and what TTL does to a cutover

• SharePoint Online and OneDrive: site and library creation, permission inheritance, sharing policies, sync troubleshooting

• Microsoft Teams: provisioning, guest access, and how Teams relates to the SharePoint site behind it

• Microsoft 365 admin center, license assignment, and group-based licensing

2. Entra ID (formerly Azure AD)

• Conditional Access policy design, MFA rollout, SSPR, and why security defaults are not enough

3. Azure

• Azure Backup and Recovery Services vaults

5. Migration delivery— demonstrable experience in at least two of:

• File server or NAS to SharePoint Online, OneDrive, or Teams

• Active Directory domain migration or consolidation: ADMT, SID history, forest trusts, UPN suffix change, workstation re-domain

• Another MDM platform into Intune

6. Windows Server and AD DS

7. PowerShell

8. Working style

jobs.title: Associate Director of Development, UW Libraries and Parent Philanthropy
jobs.excerpt: Overview The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (WFAA)—the private fundraising and alumni relations organization for the University of Wisconsin–Madison—is seeking an Associate Director of Development to expand major gift fundraising with the UW Libraries and the UW Parent Philanthropy Program.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (WFAA)—the private fundraising and alumni relations organization for the University of Wisconsin–Madison—is seeking an Associate Director of Development to expand major gift fundraising with the UW Libraries and the UW Parent Philanthropy Program.

You’ll manage a portfolio of prospects, cultivate relationships with high‑priority alumni, parents, and other friends of the university, and secure significant philanthropic commitments to support UW–Madison. Success in this position requires strong relationship‑building skills, sound judgment, and the ability to represent a wide range of campus priorities with clarity and purpose.

This role offers a unique dual appointment supporting two growing and exciting programs at the university. Half of the position will work closely with the UW Libraries Dean and senior staff to enhance the unit’s advancement and major gifts program, while the other half will focus on fundraising with UW Parents. The position will join a growing team of Directors of Development focused on university-wide fundraising priorities. You will collaborate closely with colleagues to identify opportunities, develop strategies for both programs, and strengthen engagement with under-engaged prospect pools.

Who is WFAA?The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association is a private, nonprofit corporation that encourages individuals and organizations to make gifts to the university and to connect with the UW. In 2014, the UW Foundation merged with the Wisconsin Alumni Association® to better serve a growing population of UW alumni and donors. We believe that private support grows out of good relationships between campus leaders, faculty and program staff who need support, and the alumni and friends who want to invest in UW–Madison. We provide important engagement opportunities to link UW–Madison alumni to each other and to their alma mater, building a strong community of Badgers.

Diversity and Inclusion:

Just as the university community benefits from differing viewpoints, perspectives, and experiences, inclusion and diversity are imperative for the success of our mission. WFAA values people and the differences that they bring to the organization, and creates an environment in which all staff members and constituents feel respected and have opportunities to thrive.

Essential Functions

Major Gift Development:

  • Implement development strategies for both the UW Libraries and for UW Parents, managing a portfolio of prospects and donors in varying stages of involvement to advance them strategically through the development continuum.
  • Educate potential donors about philanthropy and the case for supporting the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
  • Artfully ask for the right gift, at the right time, in the right way, being mindful of both the donor’s philanthropic passions and university priorities
  • Plan and implement recognition for donors, such as writing thank yous, making personal calls, arranging meetings, delivering stewardship reports and gifts, hosting events, etc.
  • Understand the mission and needs of the University and articulate them effectively to potential donors and volunteers

Campus Relations

  • Curate and review data to understand fundraising opportunities for your unit and make recommendations accordingly. Request data/reports from WFAA to meet needs of donors and campus staff as needed.
  • Build strong relationships with UW Libraries staff and maintain a knowledge base about the unit, such as news, gift opportunities, and donor stories.
  • Prep and staff UW Libraries Dean and other senior staff for donor engagements.
  • Communicate, problem solve, and anticipate needs of UW Libraries campus staff regarding accounting for donor created funds and serve as liaison between WFAA accounting department and campus staff.

Collaborative and Administrative

  • Take initiative to become familiar university-wide fundraising priorities and ensure strong internal working relationships with programmatic leads across WFAA.
  • Support and offer feedback on alumni and parent engagement activities when needed.
  • Prepare briefings and other reports for volunteers, campus partners and WFAA.
  • Utilize WFAA’s customer relationship management (CRM) tool to plan, implement and record all development-related activity in a timely manner. This includes regular progress reports on prospect qualification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Plan and execute travel arrangements with responsibility for tracking and submitting related expense reports.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional work experience
  • 1 + years of professional fundraising/ development experience or related experience.
  • Experience and demonstrated success in fundraising or related activities.
  • Excellent oral, written, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills required.
  • Ability work in evenings on occasion for key events and meet travel requirements (up to 25%).

Other Qualifications:

  • College degree, or equivalent preferred.
  • Ability to articulate the case for private support with sufficient effectiveness so that individuals understand the vision and strategy of the Center and choose to invest in the vision.
  • Ability to work independently, in addition to as a member of an effective development team.

At WFAA, we are dedicated to creating an inspiring, creative, and respectful work environment for our employees. We offer competitive pay and an outstanding benefits program, including a generous 10% 401k contribution after just one year of service! Join us and be part of a team that values your growth and well-being. Click here to learn more about our employee benefits!

The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association is an Equal Opportunity Employer *The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (advanceuw.org) is the “doing business as” name of the merged organization comprising the University of Wisconsin Foundation (supportuw.org) and the Wisconsin Alumni Association (uwalumni.com). Its legal corporate name is registered as the University of Wisconsin Foundation.

Location: Remote – UK or EU (independent contractor engagement)

About Us

MobileAction is a leading app growth and analytics platform that has been empowering developers, marketers, and global brands to make smarter decisions across the mobile ecosystem since 2013. Powered by large-scale data, machine learning, and AI, our products span ASO, Apple Ads automation, competitive intelligence, and market analytics, supporting over $2 billion in Apple Ads spend in 2026, with enterprise customers including Google, Meta, Spotify, and Grammarly.

In 2026, MobileAction joined InMobi, one of the world's leading advertising and AI technology companies, accelerating our mission to build next-generation mobile growth solutions. At MobileAction, you'll work alongside talented teams, help some of the world's leading mobile companies grow, and make a direct impact on customer success.

About the Role

    We're looking for a Senior Account Executive to help mobile app advertisers and agencies grow with Apple Ads. Apple Ads will be your primary sales focus, and you'll play a key role in expanding its reach across the mobile advertising market.

    Beyond Apple Ads, you'll have the opportunity to leverage InMobi's broader advertising portfolio, including InMobi DSP, Glance, Accelerate, and Bing Ads. When an advertiser could benefit from solutions beyond Apple Ads, you'll be well positioned to identify the opportunity and collaborate with the relevant InMobi teams to bring those solutions to market.

    This is a quota-carrying, new-business-focused sales role where your impact is visible and measurable through the media spend and revenue you help generate and grow. Reporting to the Head of Sales, you'll own the commercial sales journey, from prospecting and initial conversations to launching test campaigns, negotiating budgets, and closing deals. You'll also work closely with Account Management, Ad Operations, Customer Success, and Product teams to turn successful partnerships into long-term, scalable business.

    This role is a great fit if you have a background in digital advertising, particularly in mobile user acquisition, whether at a DSP, ad network, ad platform, MMP, or performance marketing agency, and enjoy building relationships with the people responsible for user acquisition budgets.

What You'll Do

  • Drive new business acquisition by identifying, engaging, and converting mobile app advertisers and agencies across verticals such as gaming, fintech, e-commerce, and subscription apps.

  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, your professional network, inbound opportunities, agency relationships, and industry events.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial outreach and discovery to presenting solutions, launching test campaigns, negotiating budgets, and closing deals.

  • Develop and grow relationships with UA leaders, growth teams, marketing decision-makers, and agencies responsible for mobile advertising budgets.

  • Work closely with Account Management and Ad Operations to turn successful test campaigns into scaled, long-term Apple Ads partnerships.

  • Bring MobileAction's data, automation, and ASO capabilities into your sales conversations to demonstrate how advertisers can maximise the value of their Apple Ads investments.

  • Identify cross-selling opportunities for InMobi's broader advertising portfolio, including InMobi DSP, Glance, Accelerate, and Bing Ads, collaborating with the relevant teams to develop additional business opportunities.

  • Build compelling, performance-driven business cases using metrics such as CPI, CPA, ROAS, and LTV.

  • Develop commercial strategies to increase advertiser investment, expand existing partnerships, and achieve revenue and media spend targets.

  • Share market intelligence, advertiser feedback, and competitive insights with Product and Marketing teams to help shape product development and positioning.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data in the CRM to ensure clear visibility into commercial performance.

  • Represent MobileAction and InMobi at industry events, conferences, and agency meetings, with occasional travel as required.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, with a strong commercial background in sales, business development, or client-facing roles at a DSP, ad network, ad platform, MMP, or performance marketing agency.

  • Proven track record of acquiring new advertisers, closing deals, and achieving or exceeding commercial targets.

  • Experience growing advertising budgets and turning initial test campaigns into scaled, recurring partnerships.

  • Strong understanding of mobile user acquisition and performance marketing metrics, including CPI, CPA, ROAS, and LTV.

  • Ability to build relationships with UA leaders, growth teams, and agencies, and engage decision-makers responsible for user acquisition budgets.

  • Strong negotiation, consultative selling, and closing skills.

  • Experience managing sales pipelines, maintaining accurate forecasts, and working with CRM systems.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in an international environment.

  • A proactive, results-driven mindset with strong ownership and accountability.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Apple Ads, either as a seller, agency, or advertiser.

  • Experience selling programmatic, DSP, or search advertising solutions.

  • Familiarity with ASO, app intelligence, or SaaS platforms serving mobile marketers.

  • Knowledge of mobile attribution and measurement tools such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch.

  • An established network among mobile app advertisers, UA leaders, growth teams, and performance agencies.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.

  • Familiarity with sales tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Gong.

Our Culture

  • Open, collaborative, and high-trust environment.

  • Fast-moving startup mindset with global-scale impact.

  • Motivated, supportive, and collaborative teammates.

  • Strong focus on customer success, ownership, and continuous learning.

  • Continuous feedback and transparent communication.

  • Impatient with Actions, Patient with Results.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with an attractive commission structure and performance-based incentives.

  • Fully remote contractor engagement from the UK or EU countries.

  • Company-provided laptop

  • Flexible working hours.

  • An English-speaking, multinational work environment.

  • Access to online learning and professional development resources.

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about mobile advertising and excited to help the world's leading mobile companies grow, we'd love to hear from you. Join a fast-moving, global team where your ideas matter and your impact is visible from day one.

Apply now and let's build the next generation of mobile growth together.

jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla?  Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers
  • Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Про нас

Kyivstar.Tech – українська гібридна ІТ-компанія, резидент Дія.City. Ми є дочірньою компанією Київстар, одного з найбільших українських операторів зв'язку.

Понад 700 спеціалістів KS.Tech щодня працюють у різних сферах: мобільні та веб-рішення, а також проєктування, розробка, підтримка та технічне обслуговування високопродуктивних систем і сервісів.
Ми віримо в інновації, що дійсно приносять якісні зміни, та постійно кидаємо виклик традиційним підходам і рішенням. Кожен з нас є адептом підприємницької культури, яка дозволяє ніколи не зупинятися, розвиватися і створювати нове.

Які виклики долатимемо разом

  • Підтримка та розвиток data-driven культури: ми приймаємо рішення не «тому що нам так подобається», а «тому що дані / результати експериментів на це вказують»
  • Оптимізація маркетингу на основі даних: побудова ad-level звітності, розрахунок крос-продуктових конверсій в розрізі маркетингу, робота з авдиторіями, активна участь у навчанні рекламних алгоритмів через якісні сигнали (мікро- та макроконверсії)

  • Побудова аналітичного self-service: створення інструментів для самостійної роботи команд із даними, в тому числі через ШІ-агентів, побудова культури взаємодії з ними
  • Аналітика мультипродуктової екосистеми:
  • проєктування таксономії з урахуванням потреби в оцінці крос-продуктових флоу (почав шлях на сайті, закінчив у додатку)
  • побудова моделі атрибуції: як маркетингової, так і між продуктами
  • рахуємо не тільки маркетингову атрибуцію, а й крос-продуктову
  • робота з безліччю джерел: Google Analytics, Amplitude, рекламні кабінети, зовнішні API, DWH
  • побудова та оптимізація дата-пайплайнів у Airflow (MWAA)
  • аналіз бізнес-ініціатив: є багато ідей для покращень і обмежений ресурс на розробку, ти будеш проводити критичний аналіз цих ініціатив з точки зору бізнесу

Де очікуємо твою проактивність

  • Не просто закриваєш таски, а розумієш, як живе продукт, допомагаєш команді ставити правильні питання та шукати відповіді на них і будуєш системні рішення там, де бачиш повторюваність
  • Не кажеш «працює — не чіпаю», а валідуєш відповідність рішення задачі й за потреби змінюєш існуючі процеси

Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні

  • Відмінне знання продуктових метрик та принципів роботи продукту з бізнесової точки зору
  • Досвід проєктування/налаштування продуктової чи веб-аналітики
  • Впевнене володіння SQL для аналізу великих масивів даних, уміння оптимізувати запити та шукати ресурсоємні місця в них
  • Уміння використовувати Python для автоматизації збору та обробки даних, зокрема для роботи з API та інтеграції даних з різних джерел
  • Досвід створення дашбордів і звітів в BI-інструментах (Looker Studio / Power BI)
  • Досвід проведення A/B/n-тестів для оптимізації продукту
  • Здатність ефективно працювати в команді, генерувати гіпотези та пояснювати складні речі простими словами

Плюсом стане

  • Досвід роботи з Google BigQuery (включно з оптимізацією витрат)
  • Досвід роботи з API рекламних платформ (Google, Meta, TikTok та інші)
  • Досвід роботи з Google Analytics і Google Tag Manager включно з написанням кастомного JavaScript для налаштування відстеження подій та ecommerce-аналітики
  • Досвід роботи з Amplitude (графіки, когорти, дашборди, агенти)
  • Досвід роботи з Apache Airflow

Що ми пропонуємо

  • Ремоут онбординг.
  • Перформанс бонуси для всіх (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі).

jobs.title: Director, AI Product Management (GTM)
jobs.excerpt: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Go-To-Market AI product team builds the internal products our sellers, customer success managers, and support reps use every day. As Director, AI Product Management (GTM), you will own an AI-powered GTM platform that creates a step change in impact, brings in new ways of working, centralizes data and insights, and acts as the foundational system for our GTM organization—from problem identification to development, adoption, and measurable business impact.

Functioning much like a general manager with product at the core, this broad leadership role requires you to build, coach, and grow a high-performing team of product managers while driving enablement, cross-functional alignment, and strategic execution.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for our internal AI-native GTM platform, and be accountable for whether the business adopts it.
  • Manage the platform as one portfolio, so every part of it shares the same data, intelligence and building blocks, and users get one consistent experience.
  • Build an AI-native product practice. Take the best of traditional product management, such as PRDs, prioritization, launch readiness and measurement, and reinvent it with AI so the team moves faster and builds better.
  • Understand internal users' problems and analyze data to identify what to build, sometimes finding the need before users can articulate it.
  • Write clear requirements and partner closely with engineering, which leads technical implementation, to deliver a high-quality product. Make sure you and your team test the product firsthand.
  • Keep pace with an engineering team that moves fast and ships at high velocity. Gather input from the field quickly, turn it into a clear direction for engineering, and use AI to shorten the loop from feedback to shipped improvement.
  • Define what quality means for AI products, including accuracy, trust, evaluation and human review, and hold every release to that bar.
  • Drive adoption by coaching sellers and partnering with Sales Enablement and Product Marketing, and measure the business impact of what you ship.
  • Set clear, measurable goals for adoption, productivity and business impact, instrument the product to track them, and use the results to decide what to build next.
  • Resolve cross-functional dependencies, such as aligning teams on shared datasets with Data Engineering or getting Product Marketing content into the AI knowledge base, and take on the analytics and operational work needed to make the product succeed.
  • Use AI tools in your own work to build prototypes and mini-apps that engineers can take forward into production, and apply AI to improve how Samsara's go-to-market teams work. Hands-on AI experience is a requirement for this role.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team of product managers.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, or in strategy and operations roles where you owned a product built with engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience leading, developing and mentoring product managers or product-oriented teams, while staying close to execution.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an internal or business-facing product, including defining the problem, working with engineering to deliver it, driving adoption and showing measurable business impact.
  • Hands-on experience with AI, such as building or shipping AI-enabled products, using AI tools in your own work, or prototyping with them.
  • Strong analytical skills, with examples of using data to identify problems, shape product decisions and measure results.
  • Technical fluency and ability to establish credibility with engineers.
  • Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with a record of driving work to completion across teams and stakeholders.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience owning internal tools or AI products used by sales, customer success or other go-to-market teams.
  • Familiarity with the systems and data that run a go-to-market organization, such as CRM, forecasting and sales enablement tools.
  • Experience defining quality, evaluation and trust standards for AI products.
  • Experience coaching end users and working with enablement teams to get a new tool used.
  • Experience leading product teams that use AI throughout their own work, from research and requirements to prototyping and launch.
  • Comfort with fast-changing priorities and with the cross-functional alignment that a company at Samsara's scale requires.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$157,080—$280,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
Description

Data Scientist – AI-Driven Financial Crime Detection

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced Data Scientists to support the design, development, and deployment of AI-driven financial crime detection solutions for customers. The role combines data science, advanced analytics, financial crime investigation, and customer-facing technical delivery.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience working with large-scale data using Python and PySpark, building data science workflows, and applying AI and LLM technologies to solve complex business and technical challenges.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, develop, and deploy AI-driven financial crime detection solutions for end customers.
  • Perform data analytics and financial forensics to identify patterns, investigate anomalies, and support financial crime detection.
  • Develop, execute, and optimize data science workflows on large-scale datasets using Python, PySpark, and workflow orchestration and management tools such as MLflow and Airflow.
  • Work directly with customers on technical and business matters, building strong working relationships and translating complex technical concepts into clear, accessible explanations for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues and address unexpected challenges by developing creative solutions to complex requirements and collaborating with relevant teams.
  • Take ownership of assigned deliverables and work independently with minimal supervision, managing multiple concurrent projects and meeting tight deadlines.
  • Apply advanced LLM and AI expertise—including agentic coding, LLM cost optimization, and AI agent development—to accelerate delivery and build data tools for internal and customer-facing use cases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful solution development, implementation, and customer delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, data analytics, or a related technical field.
  • Strong hands-on programming experience with Python and PySpark.
  • Experience developing and managing data science workflows using tools such as MLflow and Airflow.
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and big data processing environments.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience in data analysis, anomaly detection, or financial forensics.
  • Understanding of AI/ML concepts and their application to financial crime detection or related domains.
  • Practical experience with LLMs, agentic coding, LLM cost optimization, and AI agent development.
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver under tight timelines.
  • Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, is mandatory.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to Argentina for customer engagements.

Key Competencies

  • Data science and big data engineering
  • Financial crime analytics and forensic investigation
  • AI/ML and LLM application development
  • Customer engagement and technical communication
  • Problem-solving and solution design
  • Independent ownership and project delivery

Why Join Us?

You’ll work with a talented global team, contribute to meaningful technical initiatives, and help shape a high performing DevOps culture.

Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization.

To learn more, visit: www.matrix-ifs.com

Job Title: Account Partner - Safety

Job Location: Basel, Switzerland

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the Account Partner for Safety, you will lead the strategic expansion and adoption of our Safety solutions across our largest and most critical global pharmaceutical accounts. In this role, you will be responsible for generating opportunities, winning new business, and driving the digital transformation of pharmacovigilance operations through complex enterprise sales cycles. Serving as the dedicated executive relationship owner, you will cultivate deep C-suite relationships, collaborate with internal strategy teams and account leads to maximize value, and help organizations modernize their operations through innovative cloud technology.

What You'll Do

    • Lead Strategic Account Growth: Map out and execute long-term Veeva Safety adoption strategies across top global pharmaceutical strategic accounts
    • Drive Revenue & ACV: Meet and exceed pipeline generation, contract expansion, and Annual Contract Value (ACV) targets for assigned enterprise accounts
    • Orchestrate Complex Sales Cycles: Manage end-to-end, complex enterprise sales cycles, orchestrating internal and external cross-functional resources to deliver tailored customer solutions
    • Cultivate Executive Relationships: Establish and lead an ongoing communication cadence with C-suite leaders and key decision-makers to position Veeva as a long-term strategic partner
    • Collaborate Internally: Partner collaboratively with Safety Strategy and Dev Cloud Account Partners to drive a unified, matrixed account management strategy
    • Provide Industry Thought Leadership: Stay current on pharmacovigilance (PV) and life sciences industry trends, proactively engaging customers to solve complex operational and regulatory challenges
    • Champion Customer Success: Act with urgency, integrity, and a relentless focus on customer success

Requirements

    • 10+ years of combined experience across enterprise sales, strategic account management, and consulting services
    • 3+ years of dedicated account management managing global Fortune 500 accounts, maintaining long-term ownership of executive relationships
    • Life Sciences software background, including consultative sales experience within enterprise software/SaaS or management consulting
    • Proven executive presence, with a track record of cultivating and influencing C-level relationships across multiple business and IT functions
    • Strong commercial negotiation skills, with demonstrated success closing complex, multi-million dollar enterprise contracts
    • High autonomy and drive, with the self-motivation to execute strategic account plans with minimal direct supervision
    • Excellent communication skills, including top-tier written, verbal, interpersonal, and executive presentation capabilities; fluency in English is required

Nice to Have

    • Safety Domain Expertise: Experience selling Pharmacovigilance (PV) software solutions or hands-on familiarity with industry safety databases
    • Community Engagement: Experience building, owning, and leading customer community forums, executive roundtables, or industry events
    • Matrix Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to navigate and collaborate effectively within a complex, global matrix organization
    • Language Skills: Professional working proficiency or fluency in German

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. jobs.title: Capture Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Nava Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective.
jobs.description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.
As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Position summary

The Capture Engineer is a territory-based specialist and the primary client-facing role within Nava’s State BD function. This role owns the full capture loop within an assigned portfolio of states - from first signal through close - developing state-specific strategies, building trusted relationships with government stakeholders, translating market intelligence into qualified leads, and coordinating cross-functionally to position Nava as the preferred partner before RFPs drop.


The Capture Engineer role brings increased technical rigor, AI-native operating habits, and self-reliance in generating materials and running outbound strategy. The role is designed to compress the specialist-handoff architecture that previously split relationship coverage, technical credibility, and pursuit strategy across multiple people.

What you'll do

Territory Strategy & Capture Planning

  • Own a portfolio of 3–5 states; develop and maintain a territory capture plan for each state defining ICPs, political context, trigger conditions, relationship maps, assets in market, and 90-day activity plans
  • Develop state-specific win strategies that include identification of target opportunities, understanding of political and procurement context, and prioritized next actions
  • Translate market intelligence from the RevOps/BD Analyst layer into qualified leads and recommended actions tied to specific opportunities
  • Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, and working sessions with state agency stakeholders; pull in Solutions Architects only where technical depth genuinely requires it
  • Conduct pre-RFP requirement shaping conversations with agency stakeholders to define procurement requirements that favor Nava’s approach

Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain warm, trust-based relationships with 8–12 state agency contacts per territory, including economic buyers, technical evaluators, political blockers, and internal champions
  • Deliver value-additive touchpoints to stakeholders — peer state intelligence, federal guidance, relevant case studies — without explicit asks
  • Hold credible conversations with state CIOs and agency program directors on agency strategic priorities, federal compliance environment, technical architecture, and operational challenges without needing a lifeline
  • Represent Nava at relevant conferences, state-level events, and industry gatherings within assigned territories

AI-Native Content & Asset Generation

  • Self-generate outbound materials including one-pagers, briefing packets, state-specific capability summaries, and demo assets using AI-native tools and Nava’s institutional knowledge base
  • Develop product-based wedge materials — prototypes, demonstration assets, and click-engagement content — that support the state product-led go-to-market motion
  • Operate with an AI-first orientation across intelligence gathering, asset creation, synthesis, and outbound strategy; use AI tools to reduce time on tasks that do not require human judgment

Pursuit & Pipeline Contribution

  • Own win theme development and pursuit strategy on below-threshold opportunities; co-lead with the Capture Manager on above-threshold pursuits
  • Surface opportunity signals into the pipeline — budget shifts, personnel changes, federal compliance pressure, peer state movements — each tied to a recommended next action
  • Coordinate with RevOps so intelligence flows bidirectionally, oriented to the territory capture plan
  • Identify when a POC or product demonstration is the right next move; design and lead those engagements with Solutions Architect depth pulled in as needed

Required skills

  • Experience: 3–7 years in a client-facing, capture, business development, or territory management role in a government technology, civic tech, or public sector consulting environment
  • Government & program fluency: Working knowledge of state government agency operations, federal compliance environment, and the programs Nava serves (SNAP, Medicaid, UI, PFML, child care). Able to hold substantive conversations with agency leaders without needing a subject matter expert in the room
  • Technical credibility: Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with technical buyers (state CIOs, CDOs, agency architects) on implementation approach, data systems, and technology modernization. Does not require engineering depth, but must demonstrate enough technical fluency to engage credibly when technical questions arise
  • Capture & sales motion evidence: Track record of building relationships in a government procurement context, shaping requirements pre-RFP, and developing win strategies on competitive pursuits
  • AI-native orientation: Active user of AI tools for research, writing, synthesis, and outbound asset generation. Treats AI as a core productivity layer, not a novelty
  • Self-reliance & high motor: Proactively generates assets, surfaces insights, and moves territory strategy forward without needing to be directed. Comfortable producing first drafts and prototype materials independently
  • Mission alignment: Genuine orientation toward the mission of improving how government serves people
  • Directional familiarity with the civic tech ecosystem (NASWA, APHSA, Code for America, NASCIO)

Desired skills

  • Experience at a civic tech organization or digital service alumni
  • Background in or strong network into one or more geographic priority states: NY, CA, CO, MA, VA, NJ, MN, PA
  • Experience with product-led go-to-market motions, including POC design, demo facilitation, or prototype-based business development
  • Familiarity with Shipley or similar capture/proposal methodologies
  • Prior experience transitioning from a delivery or technical role into a client-facing or BD capacity

    Role is eligible for a performance-based bonus of up to 10–20% of base salary (role/level dependent), tied to individual quota attainment, in addition to base salary.

Compensation
$119,700—$147,600 USD

Other requirements

All roles at Nava require the following:

Legal authorization to work in the United States
Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

Perks working with Nava

Health coverage — comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to support your overall health needs
Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost
Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge
Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO
Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus
Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home
Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools
Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)
Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest
401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan
Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities
Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs
Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses
Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills
Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs
Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team
Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable
Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states:
Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin
*If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time.

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.
Please contact the recruiting team at if you would like to request any form of reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.
We participate in E-Verify. Upon hire, we will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. This role requires you to work from the contiguous United States.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Nava is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, gender and/or gender identity or expression, color, creed, religion, religious creed, age, national origin, ethnicity, disability, veteran or military status, sex, sexual orientation, reproductive health autonomy, pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth, genetic information, domestic violence victim status, marital status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Nava prohibits any such discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all employees, applicants, contractors, and temporary workers of Nava.

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Als Technical Lead .
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Technical Lead .NET geef je richting aan complexe technische realisaties. Je vertaalt organisatiebrede architectuurkaders naar uitvoerbare oplossingen en zorgt ervoor dat .NET-toepassingen veilig, schaalbaar, beheersbaar en duurzaam in productie komen. Daarbij bewaak je de langetermijnkwaliteit zonder de voortgang van de levering uit het oog te verliezen.

De Uitdaging

Je verbindt product- en organisatiedoelen met concrete technische uitvoering. Vanuit een hands-on aanpak volg je de volledige levenscyclus van een product of toepassing: van haalbaarheid en ontwerp tot realisatie, release, stabiele exploitatie en continue verbetering.

Omschrijving

Je werkt binnen een ICT-ontwikkeldienst die de samenwerking tussen planning, ontwikkeling en beheer verder structureert. In die context help je een gestandaardiseerde .NET-werkwijze uit te bouwen en geef je technische richting aan de samenhang, kwaliteit, haalbaarheid en operationele duurzaamheid van toepassingen.

Je operationaliseert de oplossingsrichting die door de solution architectuur is bepaald, inclusief Architecture Decision Records. Je stuurt engineers inhoudelijk aan, maakt technische afwegingen expliciet en bewaakt de naleving van architectuur-, security-, privacy- en operationele richtlijnen. Tegelijk houd je rekening met opleveringssnelheid en veranderbaarheid.

Binnen het interne .NET-ontwikkelteam bouw je hands-on mee aan standaarden, documentatie, checklists, templates, werkinstructies, kwaliteitscriteria, ontwikkel- en reviewrichtlijnen, test- en releaseafspraken, securitycontroles, kwaliteitscontroles, kwetsbaarheids- en incidentafhandeling en lifecyclebeheer.

Je begeleidt nieuwe teamleden, ondersteunt onboarding en bewaakt een consistente manier van werken. Je helpt bepalen welke competenties en capaciteit nodig zijn om het .NET-team duurzaam uit te bouwen. Kennis wordt verankerd in documentatie, tooling, processen en samenwerking, zodat ze niet bij één persoon blijft.

In een later stadium help je deze werkwijze uitbreiden naar andere .NET-ontwikkelteams, zodat een uniforme aanpak ontstaat.

De eerste maanden staan in het teken van vertrouwen opbouwen, de technische werkelijkheid objectiveren, een gedragen verbeteragenda opstellen en de eerste verbeteringen realiseren. Je start pragmatisch: eerst begrijpen en stabiliseren, daarna standaardiseren en versnellen.

Resultaatsgebieden

1. Technische richting en implementatie

Je vertaalt organisatiebrede architectuurkaders en gekozen oplossingsrichtingen samen met projectteams en lead developers naar een concrete, uitvoerbare technische aanpak.

  • Afstemming met enterprise-, solution-, data-, security- en integratiearchitectuur.
  • Opstellen van een technische roadmap, target state en migratie- of deprecationpaden.
  • Documenteren van keuzes, alternatieven en trade-offs via Architecture Decision Records.
  • Tijdig terugkoppelen over haalbaarheid, afwijkingen en impact.

2. Delivery en engineering excellence

Je creëert een voorspelbare engineeringaanpak waarin kwaliteit, snelheid en overdraagbaarheid elkaar versterken.

  • Uitwerken van de technische opdeling, ramingen, enablers en afhankelijkheden.
  • Bewaken van architectuur-, coding-, review-, branching-, test-, CI/CD- en documentatiestandaarden.
  • Uitvoeren van designreviews en begeleiden van complexe implementaties.
  • Bewaken van Definition of Ready, Definition of Done en release readiness.

3. Security, privacy, risico en compliance

Je vertaalt beleid, controles en beveiligingsprincipes naar aantoonbare technische implementaties.

  • Toepassen van security-by-design en privacy-by-design tijdens de realisatie.

5. Technische schuld en lifecycle

Je maakt technische schuld en lifecycle-risico’s zichtbaar, bestuurbaar en planbaar.

  • Inventariseren en waarderen van technische schuld.
  • Opvolgen van versies, end-of-support, licenties en capaciteitslimieten.
  • Uitwerken van moderniseringsvoorstellen op basis van risico, waarde, kost en veranderbaarheid.

6. Technisch leiderschap en capability building

Je verhoogt de technische zelfstandigheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit van teams en teamleden.

Je voelt je comfortabel in een pioniersrol, kunt zelfstandig starten en betrekt tegelijk de juiste stakeholders. Je zorgt ervoor dat technische keuzes overdraagbaar en schaalbaar worden.

Job Title: Grad Intern – R&D Execution, Strategy & Operations (Summer 2027)

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Grad Intern – R&D Execution, Strategy & Operations (Summer 2027)

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. We have multiple openings for graduate level students to further their educational goals. This internship will be approximately 12 weeks and includes both project-based and experiential learning. The intern will be an integral member of the R&D Execution, Strategy & Operations (R&D EOS) organization, which is focused on driving innovation beyond the molecule and applying digital (and other) strategies to simplify processes. The 4 functional areas within R&D EOS are:

  • Strategy: Powering-up industry-leading R&D through strategy, functional transformation, and performance excellence
  • Portfolio & Program Management: Turning product strategy into execution to bring medicines to patients faster 
  • R&D Business Operations: Innovating excellence and navigating efficiency to manage R&D operational activities, including budget planning and contracting, suppliers, laboratories, workforce strategy and environmental, social & governance (ESG)
  • R&D Knowledge & Learning: Transforming and advancing digitization and contemporized learning as well as cultivating talent & culture for a people-centric and inclusive workforce

As a member of Amgen's R&D EOS organization, your work will be highly collaborative across multiple functions and levels within Amgen, including, Research & Development, Chief Medical Office, Chief Technology Office, Quality & Compliance, and others. You will be uniquely responsible for one or more key projects that will advance R&D EOS’ mission, including the following:

  • Supporting a project within one of our functional areas
  • Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams on projects and/or programs that strive to improve R&D’s competitiveness through speed, agility and excellence in execution
  • Leveraging your analytical, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to work in teams, identify problems, conduct research, develop recommendations through qualitative and quantitative analysis, and deliver final projects
  • Presenting your deliverables/findings through various forums including an intern-wide poster session and a final readout to executive management
  • Engaging in learning activities, networking with colleagues across the company, and enjoying full access to Amgen’s Employee Resource Groups

This description serves as a general outline for the responsibilities of a graduate intern in R&D EOS. The specific tasks and requirements may vary depending on the nature of the project.

  • Must be available to work a full-time schedule
  • Expected continued enrollment in an accredited college or university following the internship program / co-op
  • Student must be located in the United States for the duration of the internship program

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The collaborative individual we seek is hard-working with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Amgen requires that all individuals applying for a grad internship or a co-op assignment at Amgen must meet the following criteria:

  • Currently enrolled in an MBA program for an MBA internship OR a Master’s program for a Master’s internship OR a PharmD program for a PharmD internship OR Ph.D. for a PhD internship from an accredited college or university and completion of the first year of MBA OR Master’s OR Pharm D OR Ph.D. program before the internship starts

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical and organized, with the ability to synthesize information from different sources and manage tasks and deadlines
  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and a willingness to learn
  • Adaptability in navigating and effectively responding to ambiguity and evolving circumstances and priorities
  • Basic understanding of project management concepts is a plus

What You Can Expect of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The base pay range for this opportunity in the U.S. is $35.34 - $41.20 per hour.

jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.

We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead Manager to lead our Mid Market & Celebrity (MMC) team. This team works side by side with our celebrity and mid market customers and the MMC sales org to build the features and customizations that help those customers grow on the platform. You will be the technical voice in the room from the first conversation. The team vets customization use cases on inbound leads before deals close, builds the agreed functionality after close, and turns the best of that work into capabilities every Luxury Presence customer can use.

This role pairs technical leadership with solution engineering. You will work directly with customers and sales to shape what we build, then lead the team that builds it.

What You'll Do

Be the technical partner to MMC sales and customers. Join conversations with prospects, customers, and vendors. Vet customization use cases quickly and explain what is possible, what it takes, and what the tradeoffs are, so deals move forward with confidence.

Practice solution engineering. Turn ambiguous customer needs into clear, scoped, supportable solutions. Translate between customers, sales, product, and engineering, and keep every party aligned.

Build and deliver after close. Plan and schedule the work, and deliver customer functionality with high quality.

Turn one-off builds into platform capabilities. Spot the solutions worth generalizing and graduate them into reusable capabilities for all customers, not only MMC.

Lead and grow the MMC team. Manage 2-4 direct reports. Own coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft.

Deliver the MMC charter. Partner with product and design to deliver the engineering commitments in the current MMC charter.

Own system health. Be accountable for DORA metrics and the health of all MMC-related services.

Stay hands-on. Contribute through code and design reviews, architecture, and thorny debugging, and go deep with architecture leads on the path to mature solutions.

What We're Looking For

Attributes

  • You lead from the front. You are close to the code, technically respected, and you grow engineers through clear feedback.
  • You communicate clearly and directly. You explain complex tradeoffs to customers, vendors, sales, and executives, and you build trust quickly with external parties.
  • You think like a solution engineer. You can listen to a customer, find the real need, and shape a solution that is realistic to build and support.
  • You build with AI daily and expect your team to do the same.
  • You hold strong opinions, loosely. You have a view on how AI changes architecture, team structure, and engineering culture.
  • You think in systems and connect technical decisions to customer outcomes and business value.
  • You are energized by ambiguity and speed. Ownership here is real.
  • You like to have fun at work. We take our craft seriously, but not ourselves.

Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful senior or staff-level time, plus 2+ years managing engineering teams.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solution engineering, scoping, or vetting customer requirements before a sale.
  • Track record of turning custom or one-off work into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Deep expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with the full-stack fluency to reason about the request path from UI to data.
  • Experience designing and operating scalable microservice architectures in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred).
  • Strong understanding of GraphQL, event-driven systems (Kafka), and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience operating production systems with SLOs and incident response, and familiarity with DORA metrics.
  • Experience leading high-impact initiatives from concept through production in a SaaS environment.

Tech Stack

  • Frontend: React, Tailwind, Apollo
  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript microservices
  • Data: PostgreSQL
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Lambda
  • Messaging: Kafka, Redis

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.
We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.
Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.
More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.
Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and oversee all service delivery functions for cybersecurity and cloud security professional services engagements, ensuring quality, timelines, and compliance standards are met.

  • Drive operational strategy and governance frameworks that ensure predictable, high‑quality delivery across all accounts.

  • Ensure teams follow industry standards including NIST 800‑53, FedRAMP Moderate/High, DOD IL frameworks, and agency‑specific ATO requirements.
  • Develop, mentor, and grow high-performance technical delivery teams, including project managers, cloud architects, security engineers and security analysts.
  • Work closely with executive leadership to forecast resource needs, optimize utilization, and support organizational growth initiatives.
  • Maintain deep understanding of emerging cybersecurity risks, cloud technologies, and federal compliance trends.
  • Review and approve statements of work, delivery plans, and technical program documentation.
  • Establish KPIs and drive continuous improvement across delivery operations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • U.S. Citizenship (mandatory).
  • 10+ years of experience leading service delivery, program management, or operations in a cybersecurity, cloud services, or federal consulting environment.
  • Hands-on FedRAMP experience including advisory, implementation, or continuous monitoring.
  • Proven track record managing complex technical programs for U.S. Federal agencies or regulated industries.
  • Extensive experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Strong understanding of federal security frameworks such as NIST 800‑53, FISMA, DFARS/CMMC, SOC, and ATO processes.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Experience managing distributed technical, professional services teams and large-scale delivery organizations.

Desired:
