jobs.title: Retail Wholesale Sales & Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: Wholesale Sales & Account Manager Location: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time About the Role A growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.
jobs.description:
Wholesale Sales & Account Manager

Location: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

A growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.

This is an opportunity for a relationship-driven sales professional who understands the boutique and specialty retail market and knows how to turn product interest into orders, build lasting retailer relationships, and generate repeat business.

The role supports two brands: an established luxury accessories brand specializing in authenticated vintage handbags and accessories, sold through boutiques, gift shops, resorts, and specialty retailers; and an emerging faith-forward wellness brand preparing to expand into the wholesale market.

The ideal candidate has experience representing consumer products to retailers, presenting collections, developing new accounts, and managing the full wholesale sales cycle. You'll have the opportunity to leverage existing relationships while identifying new markets, opening doors with prospective retailers, and helping grow both brands.

Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Sales & New Business Development

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new wholesale accounts with boutiques, gift shops, specialty retailers, resorts, and other relevant retail partners.
  • Build relationships with boutique owners, retail buyers, and purchasing decision-makers.
  • Proactively reach out to prospective accounts through phone, email, social media, industry connections, and wholesale platforms.
  • Present products, collections, and brand offerings to prospective retailers and secure new orders.
  • Follow up on sales opportunities, maintain an active pipeline, and move prospects through the buying process.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce existing retail partners to additional products and complementary brands.

Wholesale Account Management & Growth

  • Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of wholesale accounts, taking ownership of ongoing retailer relationships.
  • Develop strategies to increase order frequency, average order size, and overall account revenue.
  • Build repeat business by consistently following up with customers, identifying reorder opportunities, and introducing new products and collections.
  • Re-engage inactive accounts and turn first-time buyers into long-term wholesale partners.
  • Understand individual retailer needs, buying cycles, product preferences, and customer demographics to recommend relevant products.
  • Maintain regular communication with accounts before and after orders to strengthen relationships and encourage continued business.

Trade Shows, Markets & Product Representation

  • Represent the brands at major wholesale markets, trade shows, and industry events.
  • Schedule and conduct appointments with current and prospective retail buyers.
  • Present product collections, communicate brand value, and develop new sales opportunities.
  • Follow up with leads and buyers after events to convert interest into wholesale orders.
  • Help prepare for markets and coordinate outreach to existing and prospective accounts.

Sales Operations & Account Coordination

  • Maintain organized records of customer interactions, sales opportunities, orders, and follow-up activities.
  • Track account performance, outreach, new business development, and reorder activity.
  • Utilize Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and other wholesale platforms to manage customer relationships and sales activity.
  • Coordinate with internal operations and fulfillment teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.
  • Assist wholesale customers with order questions, shipping updates, and product information as needed.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded wholesale sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing business, and taking ownership of sales results.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of direct wholesale sales, B2B sales, or wholesale account management experience.
  • Experience selling consumer products to boutiques, independent retailers, gift shops, apparel stores, or specialty retailers.
  • Demonstrated success developing new business, securing orders, and growing existing customer accounts.
  • Experience working directly with retail buyers, boutique owners, or purchasing decision-makers.
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting, product presentations, sales conversations, and consistent follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of repeat business, account development, and the wholesale buying cycle.
  • Self-motivated and able to independently manage a sales pipeline and portfolio of accounts.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Background in women's apparel, accessories, handbags, jewelry, beauty, gifts, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience representing multiple brands or product collections.
  • Previous showroom sales, territory sales, or national wholesale sales experience.
  • Experience attending wholesale markets, trade shows, or buyer appointments.
  • Familiarity with Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and online wholesale platforms.
  • Remote Work Experience: Previous experience working remotely and the ability to work independently, stay organized, and manage daily responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Technology Requirements: Must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional workspace suitable for virtual meetings, customer communication, and daily sales activities.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position open to qualified candidates nationwide. The ideal candidate will have prior remote work experience and be comfortable working independently, managing their schedule, and maintaining consistent communication with the team.

Sales and account management activities will be conducted remotely through phone, email, virtual presentations, wholesale platforms, and other sales tools. Occasional in-person meetings and trade show participation may be required.

This is not a daily road-sales position, but it does require proactive outreach, new business development, and the ability to confidently sell products, manage wholesale relationships, and grow accounts.

Why This Role Matters

The company has an established wholesale customer base and significant opportunity to expand its retail presence. There is an opportunity to develop new wholesale partnerships, reactivate existing accounts, increase repeat purchasing, and introduce an emerging brand to an established network of retailers.

The person in this role will have a direct impact on wholesale revenue and brand growth. Success will be measured by the ability to:

  • Develop and secure new wholesale accounts.
  • Grow revenue across existing customer relationships.
  • Increase reorder frequency and average order size.
  • Reactivate inactive accounts and generate repeat business.
  • Build a strong network of retail partners.
  • Support the wholesale expansion of an emerging consumer brand.

Target Start Date: December 2026, with the goal of being fully prepared for the January wholesale market.

Salary: $50,000 – $60,000 / year

jobs.description:
The Role

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Creative Production Coordinator to own and coordinate our creative production workflows, initially focusing on User-Generated Content (UGC), with the opportunity to expand into other creative formats over time.

This is a project management and operations role. You won't be responsible for developing creative strategies or writing scripts. Instead, you'll ensure that every creative project moves smoothly from kickoff to delivery, that deadlines are consistently met, and that everyone involved knows exactly what needs to happen next.

Your mission is simple: keep creative production moving, eliminate bottlenecks, and ensure projects are delivered on time.

Key Responsibilities

1. UGC Creator Sourcing

  • Source UGC creators across different creator marketplaces.
  • Send them briefs, scripts, and production requirements provided by our Creative Strategists
  • Shortlist creators based on defined profiles, budgets, and project requirements.
  • Communicate with creators to coordinate production timelines and deliverables.

2. Creator & Production Management

  • Collect creator shipping information and coordinate product shipments with clients.
  • Track shipments and confirm creators have received their products.
  • Monitor production progress and ensure creators are filming according to agreed timelines.
  • Follow up with creators, identify delays, and resolve issues before they affect delivery dates.
  • Hold creators accountable for deadlines, deliverables, and production requirements.

3. Footage Quality Control

  • Review submitted UGC footage to ensure it meets production requirements.
  • Verify that all required script lines, product shots, and deliverables have been captured.
  • Check basic technical quality, including lighting, audio, framing, and footage usability.
  • Request reshoots or missing footage directly from creators when needed.
  • Download, organize, and upload approved raw footage to our Google Drive

4. Post-Production Coordination

  • Create and assign editing tasks in ClickUp with all necessary files, briefs, and instructions.
  • Coordinate handoffs between creators and video editors.
  • Track editing progress and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Follow up with editors when tasks are delayed or require attention.
  • Notify Creative Strategists when completed creatives are ready for internal review.
  • Coordinate additional editing rounds when revisions are requested.

5. Project Management & Reporting

  • Own and maintain accurate production dashboards showing the status of every creative project.
  • Track deadlines, deliverables, and project progress across multiple clients simultaneously.
  • Identify bottlenecks, anticipate delays, and escalate issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Provide regular status updates to Creative Strategists and leadership.
  • Ensure that no project, task, or deliverable falls through the cracks.
  • Continuously improve production processes, documentation, workflows, and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Previous experience in project management, production coordination, creative operations, or a similar role.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong ownership mentality and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proactive communication skills, including the confidence to follow up persistently and hold people accountable.
  • Ability to work independently, anticipate problems, and find solutions without constant supervision.
  • Experience using project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or similar.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment with multiple stakeholders and tight deadlines.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience managing UGC creators or influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Experience with Influee or similar UGC platforms.
  • Familiarity with Meta advertising and eCommerce creative production.
  • Experience coordinating video editors or creative production teams.
  • Familiarity with Google Drive, Frame.io, and creative asset management workflows.
  • Experience using ClickUp & Slack
  • Previous experience working at a digital marketing or performance marketing agency.

What Success Looks Like

You'll be successful in this role when:

  • Creative projects are consistently delivered on or ahead of deadlines.
  • Creators and editors are proactively managed, with minimal delays or missed deliverables.
  • Every project has a clearly documented status, owner, and next step.
  • Potential problems are flagged and addressed before they become serious delays.
  • Creative Strategists spend significantly less time managing production logistics and more time focusing on strategy, creative direction, and client performance.
  • Stakeholders always have visibility into production progress without needing to chase updates.
  • Our creative production process becomes faster, more predictable, and more scalable.

Growth Opportunities

Initially, this role will focus primarily on UGC production. As your role evolves, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of additional production workflows, including video ads, static creatives, and other creative formats.

Over time, this position could evolve into a broader Creative Operations Manager role, overseeing the entire creative production pipeline across the agency.

The L3 Systems Engineer is a hands-on senior engineering role within the NexusTek Engineering Center, the company's dedicated L3 Center of Excellence for the hybrid cloud stack. Work Environment

  • Fully remote — open to candidates coast to coast within the United States.

  • Rotational on-call schedule shared across the team; this is a required responsibility of the role, and rotation frequency may vary based on team and business needs.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own resolution of escalated incident, service request, and alert tickets across SLA-bound and non-SLA queues.
  • Serve as the L3 escalation point for issues that exceed L1/L2 capability, taking ownership from intake through resolution and RCA closure as needed.
  • Handle direct engineer-to-engineer escalations and mentorship as they arise.
  • Partner with customer technical contacts on long-term solutions, lifecycle planning, and infrastructure health/remediation reviews — remotely, with no on-site presence required.
  • Design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and highly available architectures across AWS, with growing scope across Azure, GCP, and on-premises compute infrastructure.
  • Infrastructure as code experience is a plus.
  • Support of containerized and serverless workloads (Amazon EKS, AWS Lambda) as part of modern, cloud-native platform delivery is a plus.
  • Streamline infrastructure delivery and reduce manual repetitive work.
  • Extend engineering depth into on-premises/hybrid infrastructure and secondary clouds (Azure, GCP) as client environments require — all delivered remotely.
  • Configure and maintain identity and access management controls (IAM, Active Directory/Entra ID, SSO, MFA) across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Perform vulnerability remediation, audits, and compliance/audit-readiness activities relevant to client environments (e.g., CMMC 2.0, SOC 2, HIPAA).
  • Apply cloud security best practices, including encryption, centralized logging, and threat-detection tooling.
  • Monitor platform health, ticket SLAs, and service metrics; proactively identify and remediate issues before they escalate.
  • Build and maintain automated health checks, remediation playbooks, and DR/backup validation routines that reduce manual intervention over time.
  • Create and maintain runbooks, technical documentation, and procedure guides so knowledge is documented and shared, not single-threaded.
  • Review and perform cost optimization and rightsizing across managed cloud environments.
  • Serve as primary or secondary engineer on project work, including cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, onboarding/offboarding, and lifecycle/EOL upgrades.
  • Participate in customer-facing calls and technical reviews as a senior engineer/subject-matter expert, including project SOW reviews and solutioning discussions.
  • Assist with customer onboarding and managed services transitions, including technical assessments, discovery, and project scoping.
  • Identify and submit new opportunities uncovered during the course of engineering engagements.
  • Contribute to the certification roadmap and internal Skill Builder Workshop program by building and delivering technical content that raises team-wide capability.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to L1/L2 engineers — supporting them well is core to this team's mission.
  • Take ownership of improving processes, tools, and documentation; when something isn't working, take point on fixing it.
  • Communicate early and often on progress, blockers, and risk, and own mistakes quickly so the whole team can learn from them.
  • Participate in a rotational on-call schedule as an escalation engineer, engaged on P1/P2 incidents outside standard business hours when 24x7 L1/L2 cannot resolve them.
  • Acknowledge and respond to after-hours escalations per team SLA commitments, and hand off active incidents with full documentation at the close of the on-call window.

Technical Skills & Tools

  • EC2, Auto Scaling & Compute Services
  • VPC & Hybrid/Cloud Networking
  • EKS & Container Orchestration — a plus
  • Lambda & Serverless (API Gateway / Step Functions)
  • S3 & EBS Storage
  • Organizations / Multi-Account Architecture
  • CloudWatch
  • Microsoft Azure: core compute, storage, networking, and identity (Active Directory/Entra ID, SSO, MFA).
  • Google Cloud Platform: core compute, storage, and networking fundamentals.
  • Prior hands-on AWS specialists without Azure/GCP background are still encouraged to apply; Azure and GCP proficiency is expected to develop on the job.
  • Linux & Windows Server Administration
  • Hybrid Networking, Firewalls & VPN
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code
  • Ansible / Configuration Management
  • CI/CD Pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline)
  • Kubernetes & Docker
  • Monitoring & Observability (CloudWatch, LogicMonitor, N-Able, SIEM)
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery (Veeam/Commvault, replication, failover testing)
  • Scripting & Automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
  • Security & Compliance Frameworks (CMMC 2.0, SOC 2, HIPAA)

Certification is a plus, not a requirement at hire. Engineers who do not already hold a current AWS certification are expected to obtain at least one recognized AWS certification within 12 months of hire, supported by NexusTek's certification program.

  • Develop, maintain, and monitor client budgets, forecasts, and KPIs to ensure alignment with business objectives.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure consistent application of Entreflow’s accounting standards, internal controls, and operational policies.

We are seeking Physicians specialized in Endocrinology and Obesity Medicine to join our innovative, multidisciplinary chronic disease management team. A valid medical license to practice and prescribe legally in any US state is required, and eligibility to obtain additional state licenses as needed is required.

This role is designed for an American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM) certified Endocrinologist with demonstrated expertise in obesity medicine, comprehensive diabetes management, and a strong interest in working collaboratively with Endocrine Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in providing high-quality patient care.

A critical aspect of this role is ensuring the safe and effective management of patients with complex co-morbidities, including Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), and Cardiovascular conditions.   • Review charts and conduct initial and return visits to ensure quality, continuity of care, and appropriate management of CKD/ESRD and CAD/CV conditions
  • Provide advanced treatment planning and medical management support for complex endocrinology cases, escalated concerns, and patients requiring specialized management protocols.

  • Ensure clinical documentation, protocols, and treatment pathways are followed consistently within the team, with a focus on guidelines for managing complex diabetic populations

  • Participate in team-based care initiatives and contribute to a culture of collaboration and high-quality care
  • Attend relevant departmental meetings and contribute to quality improvement efforts within the diabetes and obesity medicine program

About You:

  • Must have an MD or DO degree
  • Required: Valid and current Board certification in Endocrinology by the American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM)
  • Highly Preferred: Certification by the American Board of Obesity Medicine (ABOM)
  • 2 years of clinical experience and pharmacotherapy (older generation oral and newer injectable medications) in obesity medicine or endocrinology, post residency OR completed an accredited Fellowship program in Endocrinology or Obesity Medicine, in lieu of years of experience
  • Required: Active and unrestricted Medical State License in any US State, and eligibility to obtain additional state licenses (IMLC preferred, but not required)
  • Must be currently opted-in with Medicare
  • Demonstrated competency and comfort in managing patients with complex co-morbidities, including CKD, ESRD, and CAD/CV conditions
  • Expertise in advanced diabetes management, including the use of CGMs, insulin pumps, and complex insulin regimens
  • Interest in mentoring, teaching, and collaborating with Endocrine-Specialized APPs and Registered Dietitians specializing in diabetes, as needed
  • Demonstrated experience working with APPs, medical residents, or trainees in a clinical academic setting
  • Adherence to evidence-based treatments, behavioral interventions, nutrition, and pharmacotherapy for both endocrine disorders and obesity
  • Open to working one of the following W2 roles: 32hrs/week, 36hrs/week or 40hrs/week
  • Committed to delivering patient-centered, culturally competent care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience providing synchronous patient care in a telehealth setting is preferred
  • Bilingual candidates with medical fluency in Spanish are desired, but not required

About Kinaxis

Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.   

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, with a brand-new HQ based in Kanata North in Ottawa. As one of Canada’s Top Employers, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

At Kinaxis, we power the world’s supply chains to help preserve the planet’s resources and enrich the human experience. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries, with more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries. We are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in the UK or EMEA region.

About the team

The Talent Acquisition Specialist works directly with hiring managers within an assigned business portfolio to effectively source, assess, and select talent that fit role, culture, and business requirements, and to provide coaching and guidance to hiring managers throughout the recruitment cycle. They will leverage data to contribute to strategic decisions about global hiring, including region, level, and offering, will contribute to and support the implementation of talent acquisition programs, guidelines, tools, and processes that ensure a world-class candidate experience and the selection of the very best talent.

What you will do

  • Partner with HR Business Partners, HR Advisors, and hiring managers to source, assess and select talent for requisitions in the organization, specializing in high-volume roles; in alignment with the company’s business needs and diversity practices
  • Be a trusted advisor to hiring managers, educating them on the recruitment process, interview techniques and selection criteria, and managing the flow and quality of candidates
  • Understand and proactively seek information about the business units within the portfolio, and Kinaxis in general; balance priorities of multiple hiring managers ensuring that a great candidate experience is the number one priority
  • The incumbent will understand that finding talent isn’t a “one size fits all” approach; develop sourcing strategies that meet the unique aspects of assigned roles.
  • Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, professional networks, and employee referrals, to identify potential candidates; Actively search for passive candidates who may not be actively looking for new opportunities, and build and maintain a talent pipeline for future staffing needs.
  • Review resumes and applications to shortlist qualified candidates. Complete initial screening call with candidates, providing insight and assessment to hiring manager and recommending next steps
  • Be a Kinaxis brand advocate through the execution of end-to-end talent acquisition activities and processes to attract top talent within assigned portfolio area.
  • Promote the company’s recruitment brand through active participation in job fairs, conferences, and other networking and marketing events. Ensure timely communication with candidates, hiring managers, and vendors on the recruiting process and pending needs.
  • Assist in salary negotiations and facilitate the offer process, and ensure a smooth transition for candidates from accepting the offer to joining the organization.
  • Ensure that all talent acquisition activities and processes, including job postings and interviews, are executed in a way that fully support and enable the company’s diversity, equity, and inclusion strategies and goals; customize the approach as talent is engaged across multiple timezones and cultures
  • Network through industry contacts, memberships in professional associations and groups, and through employees
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in talent acquisition, and continuously evaluate and enhance recruitment processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness

Primary Skills and Qualifications

  • Post-secondary degree in Human Resources (or related field)
  • 4+ years of experience in progressively senior talent acquisition roles, in-house preferred
  • Experience working with a broad range of teams including Corporate Services teams (Finance, HR, Legal, IT, Marketing), Customer Support, Sales and Professional Services, in a high-tech, global environment
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high sense of urgency and an inventive approach to work through ambiguity and complex issues   
  • Highly adaptable and able to pivot based on prioritization and needs of the business 
  • Agile and resilient in managing multiple projects with multiple sources of information 
  • A clear, concise, and professional communicator with the ability to present information and demonstrate knowledge to stakeholders at varying levels within the business 
  • Strong work ethic, a high respect for confidentiality and sound professional judgment and initiative
  • Strong accountability and responsibility to meet aggressive deadlines

What we are looking for

  • Experience performing end-to-end recruitment cycle in a high-growth environment
  • Exceptionally detail-oriented with a passion for using data to drive decision making
  • Knowledge of recruiting database systems including applicant tracking systems
  • Ability to influence and negotiate
  • Proven ability to balance a high number of open positions, managing roles globally across multiple teams and departments and locations.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to tie an organization’s business drivers to its hiring needs
  • Strong customer service orientation along with a high degree of attention to detail
  • Knowledge of employment and related legislation (Human Rights Code, and Employment Standards Act), contractual obligations, and sound human resource practices
  • Knowledge in immigration/work permit authorization
  • Strong sourcing capabilities to find top talent by leveraging social networks, research tools, as well as more creative techniques to identify potential talent
  • Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including behavioral interviewing techniques, and the ability to drive and manage the full recruitment cycle

#Term

Mid-Senior level - #Intermediate

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Yamaha, P&G, Honda, and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs

Amerit Fleet Solutions, one of the leading fleet maintenance companies in the U.S., is seeking an experienced, inspired and mission-driven Director of Employee Relations to join our growing team!

The Director, Employee Relations leads Amerit's Employee Relations function, setting the strategy, standards, and operating discipline for how the organization identifies, investigates, and resolves employee relations matters across a multi-site, field-based workforce. This role owns the ER team's highest-risk work, including EEOC and other agency charge response, and oversight of complex and sensitive workplace investigations. The Director serves as the primary connection point to Legal on employee relations matters and partners closely with the Director, People Business Partners and People Business Partners (PBPs) to ensure ER and PBP work in close alignment, with clear escalation discipline, on employee matters across the business.

The ideal candidate combines deep employee relations and labor relations expertise with strong people leadership skills, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to build scalable, defensible ER practices in a fast-paced, multi-site operational environment.

jobs.description:
Company Name

ARS-Rescue Rooter

Overview

The Azure Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on infrastructure role that designs, builds, migrates, secures, and operates production Azure infrastructure extending our on-premises VMware and Windows datacenter. Focus areas: Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, virtual machines and platform services, disaster recovery, and migration execution.

The role is DevOps-savvy, not DevOps engineering: the engineer uses Infrastructure-as-Code, Git, and pipelines to keep infrastructure repeatable and auditable, following and extending team standards.

The engineer partners with Infrastructure, Networking, Security, Database, and Application Development teams and external consultants.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Azure Infrastructure Engineering & Operations

  • Independently design, deploy, and maintain Azure infrastructure: landing zones, management groups, VMs, storage, backup, monitoring, and governance.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, performance, access, and availability issues across VM, OS, network, DNS, firewall, and identity layers; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
  • Develop runbooks and operational standards; participate in incident response, change management (CAB), maintenance windows, and on-call.

Hybrid Networking, DNS & Application Delivery

  • Design and troubleshoot VNets, NSGs, routing/UDRs, hub-and-spoke or Virtual WAN, Azure Firewall, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute, including BGP and failover behavior.
  • Design name resolution across Azure and on-premises (Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, conditional forwarding).
  • Implement private connectivity to PaaS services using private endpoints.
  • Support application delivery with Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancing, and WAF, including TLS certificate lifecycle and failure-mode design when an edge service or policy fails.
  • Work with Networking on firewall rules, IP addressing, NAT, and datacenter, branch, and third-party connectivity.

Migration Execution

  • Plan and execute VMware and Windows migrations to Azure: dependency assessment, Azure Migrate, lift-and-shift, test migrations, cutover, and post-migration support.
  • Produce cutover plans, validation checklists, and rollback criteria; execute off-hours production cutovers.
  • Support Azure infrastructure for SQL Server migrations (Always On to Azure SQL Managed Instance or SQL Server on Azure VMs).
  • Maintain hybrid domain controllers, DNS, and AD integration for Azure workloads.

Resiliency, Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Design and test DR using Site Recovery, geo-redundant storage, and region/availability-zone design against RTO and RPO targets.
  • Operate Azure Backup and evaluate it against third-party backup and replication platforms for new Azure data stores; document and report recovery test results.

Platform Services Infrastructure

  • Provide infrastructure for App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, and API Management: VNet integration, private endpoints, identity, Key Vault, and monitoring.
  • Support AKS at the platform level (private cluster, CNI, node pools, ingress, managed identity) with Application Development.

Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Build, modify, and troubleshoot Terraform following team standards: modules, remote state, environment separation, and drift.
  • Use Git pull requests and code review; maintain Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines, including approval gates and self-hosted agents reaching private endpoints.
  • Automate operations with PowerShell and Azure CLI.

Identity, Security & Governance

  • Apply Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access, and managed identities to enforce least privilege and segregation of duties.
  • Implement guardrails with Azure Policy, management groups, tagging, and Defender for Cloud.
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit on PCI DSS, NIST, and CIS controls, remediation, and audit evidence.

Observability & Cost Management

  • Build Azure Monitor and Log Analytics alerts, workbooks, and dashboards; tune alert noise and logging volume; use Application Insights for tracing.
  • Right-size and manage cost with Cost Management, Advisor, reservations, and savings plans, after establishing baselines.

Collaboration & Cross-Training

  • Share knowledge both ways: train teammates in Azure and cloud practices, and learn from them in their areas of expertise.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Note: Candidates must demonstrate each item below with specific examples of work they performed as an individual contributor.

  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered.
  • 5+ years of enterprise infrastructure engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on production Azure.
  • Hybrid networking: hands-on VNets, NSGs, routing, DNS, and ExpressRoute or site-to-site VPN; can explain tradeoffs and failure behavior.
  • On-premises to Azure migrations: direct involvement in preparation, cutover, rollback planning, and post-migration support.
  • Working knowledge of VMware vSphere, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.
  • Resiliency: Azure Backup and Site Recovery (or equivalent DR design) against RTO/RPO targets.
  • Automation: working proficiency with Terraform (state, modules, environments), PowerShell, Git, and Azure DevOps infrastructure pipelines.
  • Identity and governance: Entra ID, RBAC, least privilege, and Azure Policy.
  • Independent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex Azure issues.
  • Experience supporting PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, or similar compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

Working knowledge

  • Platform services: App Service, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure VMs.
  • Azure Virtual Desktop/FSLogix, Bicep/ARM, Defender for Cloud, and Sentinel.
  • AKS, Docker, Helm, and Cosmos DB.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-700, AZ-500, AZ-400) or HashiCorp Terraform Associate; must be current.
  • AKS platform operations, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or IIS/.NET application migrations.
  • PCI DSS audit evidence, CrowdStrike or similar security platforms, and multi-site hybrid environments.
  • Experience mentoring peers and using AI tools to speed scripting and troubleshooting.

Work Details

  • Remote; work day would be in Central Time Zone.
  • Regular business hours with scheduled after-hours maintenance and cutovers, occasional incident response, and on-call as required; participation in change management (CAB).
  • Occasional travel for project work, meetings, or datacenter activities.

jobs.description:
Overview

At Wipfli, people count.

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

We believe in flexibility. We focus on relationships. We encourage each individual to follow their own path.

People truly matter and they feel it. For those looking to make a difference and find a professional home, Wipfli offers a career-defining opportunity.

Requisition Number: 2026-8488

Job Summary:

Shape how growing organizations leverage CRM technology to drive meaningful business transformation. As a Master Consultant, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to executives and business leaders, helping clients reimagine sales, marketing, customer engagement, and operational processes through innovative HubSpot and Creatio solutions.

In this role, you'll lead complex implementation and transformation initiatives from strategy through execution, combining technical expertise, business consulting, and client leadership to deliver measurable results. You'll also play a key role in mentoring team members, influencing solution strategy, supporting business development, and helping drive the future of our CRM consulting practice.

Responsibilities

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead complex HubSpot and Creatio implementations from discovery and solution design through deployment, adoption, and optimization.
  • Partner with client leaders to assess business processes, define requirements, and recommend solutions aligned with organizational goals.
  • Architect scalable CRM solutions across sales, marketing, customer service, reporting, automation, data, and integrations.
  • Lead solution design sessions and review configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, and deployment activities for quality and alignment.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by identifying process and technology gaps, resolving complex delivery challenges, and communicating recommendations to executive stakeholders.
  • Partner with project managers to manage scope, financial performance, timelines, risks, resources, and change control.
  • Mentor consultants and technical team members through design guidance, delivery coaching, and quality reviews.
  • Create reusable tools, processes, and implementation standards that improve delivery consistency and client outcomes.
  • Support business development through discovery, demonstrations, solution scoping, estimates, proposals, and statements of work.
  • Help expand client relationships and develop new HubSpot and Creatio solutions and service offerings.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’ of Science Degree in Business, Technology, or Computer Science or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7+ years of relevant professional services experience, or 10+ years of related industry experience with at least 1+ years in professional services.
  • Advanced experience leading complex, end-to-end CRM implementations, including discovery, solution architecture, configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, training, and deployment.
  • Advanced hands-on HubSpot experience, including hubs, objects, properties, workflows, pipelines, permissions, reporting, automation, and integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise executive stakeholders, lead client workshops, make complex solution decisions, and oversee engagement quality and performance.
  • Experience coaching and mentoring consulting or technical professionals.
  • At least one advanced certification aligned with the primary product or solution area.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Creatio implementation and configuration experience.
  • Experience integrating CRM platforms with ERP, marketing automation, analytics, financial, or other enterprise systems.
  • Experience supporting presales, proposals, estimates, and statements of work.
  • Multiple advanced certifications in CRM, integration, data, automation, or related technologies

Benjamin Dzanic, from our recruiting team, will be guiding you through this process. Visit his LinkedIn page to connect!

The actual salary at the time of offer depends on business related factors like location, skills, experience, training/education, licensure, certifications, business needs, current associate pay, and relevant employment laws.

Individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, subject to participation rules and based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual and Firm performance.

Other benefits include firm-sponsored basic life and short and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) savings plan & profit share as well as Firm matching contribution, well-being incentive, education & certification assistance, flexible time off, family care leave, parental leave, family formation benefits, cell phone reimbursement, and travel rewards. jobs.description:
Company Overview

Recognized as a Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Top Workplace for 14 consecutive years, including three years of being honored as number one! Join us at West Bend, where we believe that our associates are our greatest asset. We hire talented individuals who are conscientious, dedicated, customer focused, and able to build lasting relationships. We create and maintain an environment where you feel a sense of belonging and appreciation. Your diversity of thought, experience, and knowledge are valued. We’re committed to fostering a welcoming culture, offering you opportunities for meaningful work and professional growth. More than a workplace, we celebrate our successes and take pride in serving our communities.

Job Summary

Take ownership of complex workers comp claims from initial investigation through resolution, using your experience and judgment to make sound coverage, liability, and settlement decisions. This is an active claims desk, strong organization, time management, and the ability to effectively prioritize a busy workload are important to success.

Work Location

This position offers both remote and hybrid work locations.  Candidates who reside within 50 miles of an office location (West Bend, Madison, Appleton) will be offered a hybrid work schedule.  Candidates who are fully remote (beyond 50 miles) may occasionally be asked to travel to an office location for in-person engagement activities such as team meetings, training and corporate events. 

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Summary of Responsibilities

Take ownership of complex workers comp claims from initial investigation through resolution, using your experience and judgment to make sound coverage, liability, and settlement decisions. This is an active claims desk, strong organization, time management, and the ability to effectively prioritize a busy workload are important to success.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Manage complex and higher-exposure workers comp claims with minimal supervision.
  • Research policy language and develop well-supported coverage decisions.
  • Conduct thorough investigations and evaluate liability, damages, reserves, and settlement strategy.
  • Negotiate effectively with insureds, claimants, attorneys, and other involved parties.
  • Oversee litigated files and partner with counsel to develop appropriate resolution strategies.
  • Proactively manage a busy caseload while maintaining accurate reserves, timely follow-up, and strong file documentation.
  • Present complex claims to Committee and clearly communicate recommendations.
  • Collaborate with teammates and internal partners to resolve claims effectively.
  • Serve as a resource and mentor to others on the Claims team.
  • Deliver a high level of customer service while meeting department quality and audit standards.

Preferred Experience and Skills

We’re looking for an experienced claims professional who is comfortable managing a fast-moving, active desk and brings strong judgment, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Prior experience handling large, complex, or higher-exposure claims.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong investigation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong time management, organization, and prioritization skills.
  • A team-oriented approach and willingness to collaborate and support others.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with insureds, claimants, attorneys, and internal partners.
  • Comfort working independently and making decisions while knowing when to collaborate or escalate.
  • Proficiency with claims technology and other computer-based tools.
  • Experience handling claims in Nebraska, Kansas, and/or Missouri is preferred. Experience in Kansas and Missouri is especially valuable as we continue to grow in these markets.

Preferred Education and Training

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Insurance, or a related field.
  • Associate in Claims (AIC) designation.
  • Associate in General Insurance (AINS) designation.
  • CPCU coursework or other relevant insurance education or continuing professional development.

Salary Statement

The salary range for this position is $70,000-$90,000.  

 

The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.  Compensation decisions are made by West Bend and are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. 

Benefits

West Bend offers a comprehensive benefit plan including but not limited to:  

  • Medical & Prescription Insurance 
  • Health Savings Account 
  • Dental Insurance 
  • Vision Insurance 
  • Short and Long Term Disability 
  • Flexible Spending Accounts 
  • Life and Accidental Death & Disability  
  • Accident and Critical Illness Insurance 
  • Employee Assistance Program 
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match 
  • Pet Insurance 
  • Paid Time Off. Standard first year PTO is 17 days, pro-rated based on month of hire. Enhanced PTO may be available for experienced candidates
  • Bonus eligible based on performance 
  • West Bend will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for Colorado employees, in accordance with its plans and policies.

EEO

West Bend provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, and promotion.

Why Us

Now is your moment to make a difference in the lives of the underserved. If there is one unifying characteristic of everyone on our team, it is the deep desire to make a difference by helping society's most vulnerable and often overlooked individuals. Every day we have the distinct honor and responsibility to show up with non-judgmental compassion to provide hope and healing to those who need it most. For those whose calling it is to serve others, now is your moment to join our mission to provide quality care to every patient with compassion, collaboration, and innovation, to live our mantra to “Always Do The Right Thing!”, and to collectively do our part to heal the world, one patient at a time.

Wellpath sees hundreds of thousands of unique individuals in their facilities month over month and a very large percent of those individuals receive direct clinical care, which includes lives saved by Narcan.

We offer ongoing training and development opportunities for licensed and unlicensed healthcare team members, and have best in class clinical resources for training, education, and point of care support.

How you make a difference

The Licensed Practical Nurse Telehealth assists in delivering patient care through assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation under the supervision of a Registered Nurse. This role supports individualized treatment programs and guides patient teaching based on demonstrated competencies. The position assists onsite staff with remote access and virtual technology while providing care in accordance with established policies, procedures, and protocols. The Licensed Practical Nurse Telehealth also documents nursing encounters and communicates patient information to the appropriate healthcare team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with patient assessments, treatment planning, and patient teaching under the supervision of a Registered Nurse.
  • Implement individualized treatment programs and therapeutic diet plans as directed by the Health Care Practitioner.
  • Support onsite staff using remote access and virtual technology.
  • Provide clinical and technical care in accordance with established policies, procedures, protocols, and safety practices.
  • Document nursing encounters and communicate patient information to nursing staff, physicians, supervisory personnel, and other staff as necessary.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

  • Graduate from an accredited school of nursing.

Experience

  • Prefer a minimum of one (1) year correctional healthcare experience or
  • A minimum of one (1) year clinical experience.

Licenses/Certifications

  • Have and maintain current licensure as a Licensed Practical/Licensed Vocational Nurse within the state of employment.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain CPR certification.

This position is available only to those who reside in the United States.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of uniqueness.

We celebrate a variety of backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
Staff Accountant-Full Time (Remote)

Our Organization:

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMO’s) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help PMO’s raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public broadcasting.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information visit

Role Summary:

The Staff Accountant role at CDP offers a valuable opportunity to build accounting skills through hands-on experience and guidance from an experienced Finance team. With a primary focus on accounts payable and employee expense reporting, the selected candidate will gain exposure to the full accounting cycle, including billing, cash activity, reconciliations, month-end close, and audit support. Working with colleagues across departments, this person will learn how accounting connects to day-to-day business operations and develop broader responsibilities as their skills and experience grow. This role reports sits on the CDP Finance team and reports to the Senior Accountant.

Primary Responsibilities:

Accounts Payable:

  • Own and manage the Accounts Payable inbox and ensure invoices are processed accurately and timely.
  • Create and maintain vendor records, including new CDP employees when applicable, and collect required documentation such as W-9s and ACH/remittance information.
  • Maintain accurate vendor payment methods and remittance contacts, including ACH, credit card, and check information.
  • Maintain the current-year 1099 vendor/contractor listing and support annual 1099 preparation and processing.
  • Enter vendor invoices into Sage Intacct and route invoices to the appropriate CDP reviewer and approver.
  • Monitor Accounts Payable workflows and follow up with reviewers/approvers regarding outstanding invoices or approvals.
  • Communicate with vendors and CDP employees regarding missing invoices, out-of-pocket invoices, payment documentation, and other billing-related questions.
  • Access vendor portals and retrieve recurring or monthly invoices as needed.
  • Maintain a working understanding of general ledger expense accounts and appropriate P&L classifications.
  • Support monthly P&L reviews to identify missing expenses and potential accruals.
  • Maintain a working understanding of prepaid expense accounts and related balance sheet activity.
  • Support the review and reconciliation of prepaid expenses at month-end.
  • Support the monthly out-of-pocket (OOP) expense process.

Expense Reports & Corporate Credit Cards:

  • Support the monthly employee expense report process, including Expensify and corporate credit card activity, and verify that the vendor is populated on each expense when the system supports it.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding in Expensify and corporate credit card systems, including account setup, access changes, and coordination of card activation or cancellation as directed.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly reminders to all staff regarding timely expense submission and approval.
  • Follow up with employees and approvers regarding outstanding or incomplete expense reports.
  • Perform the initial review of expense reports for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate supporting documentation. Route reports to the Manager for additional review, particularly during the first year; thereafter, follow review requirements and dollar thresholds established by Finance leadership.
  • Provide basic Expensify support and troubleshooting to employees when appropriate.
  • Assist with monthly corporate credit card reconciliations, including Visa, American Express, and Expensify activity.

Bank Statements and Reconciliation Support:

  • Provide bank statements and supporting documentation for monthly bank reconciliations. The Manager retains responsibility for preparing and reviewing bank reconciliations to maintain segregation of duties.
  • Research bank transactions and provide documentation to the Manager to help resolve reconciling items.
  • Maintain organized and accurate bank statement folders by account, month, and year.
  • Immediately escalate suspicious, unusual, or unidentified bank transactions to Finance leadership.

Other Duties:

  • Support ad hoc Finance and Accounting projects as needed.
  • Maintain organized, current, and accurate files and folders within the internal Finance drive.
  • Assist with expense and financial analysis when appropriate.
  • Support the year-end financial statement audit and related documentation requests.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures, workflows, policies, and internal controls, and assist with documenting approved changes.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other CDP departments as needed.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on Finance team needs, business priorities, and the employee’s demonstrated experience and development.

Preferred Qualifications:

Accounts Receivable & Billing:

  • Assist with preparing and issuing client invoices through Sage Intacct accurately and timely, and serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day billing inquiries.
  • Prepare, save, and maintain supporting invoice backup and PDF documentation when applicable.
  • Maintain current station Accounts Receivable contacts and applicable CDP contacts copied on invoices.
  • Maintain and update monthly and quarterly invoice-upload templates.
  • Assist with updating the MSB billing tracker for MSB, PS, and CRM services as needed. The Manager retains responsibility for reconciling the tracker to client agreements to confirm billing completeness and accuracy.
  • Update recurring invoicing information by station and product/service.
  • Add new MSB stations and update assigned Client Services representatives when applicable.
  • Maintain accurate license and email allotment information by station.
  • Monitor billing-related email, respond to routine questions, and collaborate with Station Finance and other internal teams. Escalate discrepancies, agreement questions, and unresolved issues to the Manager.
  • Assist with distributing Accounts Receivable aging statements to stations and supporting follow-up when appropriate.

Month-End Close:

  • Support completion of the monthly Finance close checklist and PS close checklist.
  • Prepare draft journal entries for prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned accounts.
  • Assist with preparing monthly OOP journal entries and station-level allocations.
  • Collaborate with MMT on station breakouts and supporting documentation when needed.
  • Assist with monthly account reconciliations for corporate cards, prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned balance sheet accounts; provide supporting documentation for bank reconciliations performed by the Manager.

Systems and Experience:

  • Experience with Sage Intacct, Bank of America CashPro, and Expensify is a plus.

Commitment to Inclusion

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized and underrepresented groups to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and commitment to public service. All CDP people have unique talents and experiences that create our company culture where we can all thrive and bring our whole selves to work each day.

Successful candidates will identify easily with a set of character attributes, as listed below:

  • DEI mindset: You embrace and demonstrate a diversity and inclusion mindset and role model these behaviors for the organization.
  • A Communicator: You possess strong communication skills and have great customer service skills; you like people and want to help.
  • A Critical Thinker: You regularly look for ways to find efficiencies, innovate, and make improvements where you can.
  • Process Oriented:You’re able to understand, work in, create, and improve processes.
  • A Collaborator: You’re a team player willing to help where needed; a relationship builder whose can-do attitude inspires others; you actively share your job knowledge with team members.
  • Someone Who Seeks to Learn: You are eager to listen, study, and learn new things quickly; you are resourceful and are open to regularly accepting and growing from feedback.
  • Enterprising: You have proven success working in a fast-paced and changing environment; you have a strong work ethic and are excited to add value to the organization and its mission.

CDP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, nationality, immigration status, citizenship, religion or religious creed (or belief, where acceptable), sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, citizenship, marital status, handicap or disability, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), Veteran or military status, political belief, or socio-economic status. jobs.description:
Position Overview

Power Your Future with Qualus in our Transmission Line department as a Senior Manager of Engineering. The Senior Manager will own a number of critical business processes across Qualus' standard ownership domains. Ownership implies a responsibility for the proper and effective execution and management of business functions. Tasks related to the execution of these functions will likely be delegated to subordinate employees, however, the responsibility for the overall performance of owned functions falls directly on the Senior Manager of Engineering. This is a professional position responsible for managing, training, coordinating, and providing oversight of overhead transmission engineering. This position is also responsible for implementing best engineering methods, pursuing business development opportunities and maintaining good relationships with internal and external stakeholders. The role will provide technical guidance and management to engineering teams, supporting established organization objectives by developing goals and strategies, and overseeing group financials. The successful candidate will possess a broad, extensive, and deep understanding of both engineering principles and management practices and demonstrate the ability to apply that knowledge and experience to all aspects of operations.

Responsibilities

This is a professional position responsible for directing, training, coordinating, and providing oversight of engineering operations. This position is also responsible for implementing best engineering methods, pursuing business development opportunities and maintaining good relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Assignments will include providing technical guidance to engineering teams and top management, supporting established organization objectives by developing goals and strategies, and overseeing group financials. The successful candidate will possess a broad, extensive, and deep understanding of both engineering principles, business practices, and demonstrate the ability to apply that knowledge and experience to all aspects of operations. Additional responsibilities include:

  • Functional leader of service line
  • Responsible for service line financials
  • Maintains good relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Implements best practice engineering methods, develops training programs and performs training for service line employees
  • Interacts with other service lines to bid on and complete projects, cross train employees, share best practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • Registered as a Professional Engineer
  • Ten (10) or more years of experience in engineering, preferably related to utility infrastructure design, including a minimum of three (3) years of management experience leading engineering teams
  • Extensive and thorough knowledge of engineering design for service line and related fields
  • Advanced knowledge of applicable design software
  • Advanced knowledge of engineering principles and practices, including computer applications
  • Extensive knowledge of field techniques for construction
  • Extensive knowledge of surveying techniques, practices, and procedures
  • Extensive knowledge of safe working practices related to electric transmission lines
  • Extensive knowledge of project management practices and financials
  • Advanced knowledge of standard business applications including Microsoft Office
  • Must be able to demonstrate ability to communicate with all levels of the organization and appropriate stakeholders
  • Action-mindset; having the ability to move from thinking about something to doing it
  • Strong team player: Accomplish tasks by working with others and recognizing how his/her decisions may impact the team and have a willingness to seek input from others
  • Time Management: Have the ability to successfully plan and accomplish tasks within an established timeline
  • Ability to analyze problems and develop effective solutions at both strategic and functional levels
  • Willingness to travel up to 15% of the time on an annual basis.
  • Must possess a valid driver’s license.

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

jobs.excerpt: About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Offensive security

The internal offensive security team is responsible for the penetration testing program, red team engagements, and offensive research aimed at uncovering sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius Cloud stack.

The Role

We're hiring an Offensive Security Engineer to join us at Nebius. You'll design and execute adversarial simulation across our cloud platform - attacking the same infrastructure our customers depend on - and translate findings into measurable security improvements.

This is a hands-on engineering role within Product Security Team. You will be part of an internal red team, establish a penetration testing program, and conduct research to uncover sophisticated attack scenarios targeting high-value assets across the Nebius tech stack.

What you’ll do

  • Validate and extend early-stage Secure SDLC threat models via continuous penetration testing, assessing threat severity and mitigation status while challenging assumptions made during threat modeling and system development. Automate routine validations to keep pace with increasing feature flow, reserving manual analysis for genuinely complex cases.
  • Plan and execute full-scoped red team engagements against Nebius cloud platform - including compute, storage, inference, networking, orchestration layers, and internal tooling. Identify threats, which are able to impact an organization's operations. jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of the role

As Manager, Corporate Security - Platform Engineering, you'll lead a small, distributed team of security engineers and own programs that span Corporate Security teams. You'll define clear team boundaries, run security tooling through GitOps-based engineering practices, and bring program priorities, budgets, and vendor decisions to Security leadership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you won't be the primary implementer, but you'll write code, review designs and merge requests, make architecture decisions, and support incident response. This role is remote within North America, reports to the VP, Corporate Security, and is at job level M3 (Manager, Security Engineering).

What you’ll do

  • Lead, hire, coach, and develop security engineers, including Staff engineers setting technical direction in artificial intelligence (AI) security and cloud environments. Build clear career paths and support ownership, written communication, and psychological safety.
  • Own the lifecycle of shared security tools, from evaluation and procurement through renewal and retirement. Use infrastructure-as-code repositories and GitOps practices, and give each tool a named owner, budget line, and exit plan. Initial priorities include Axonius, Push Security, Island, Material Security, the transition from Koi to Fleet osquery, and the CrowdStrike contract split with Security Operations.
  • Lead the secure access service edge (SASE) and always-on virtual private network (VPN) rollout, and own data loss prevention policy. Coordinate Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) boundary decisions with Security Compliance, working with Endpoint Engineering on clients and device posture signals and Identity Engineering on Okta network-zone policy.
  • Run the corporate email gateway and own domain-based message authentication, reporting, and conformance (DMARC), sender policy framework (SPF), and DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) across GitLab domains, including the FedRAMP tenant. Complete the separation of product email flow from corporate Google Workspace.
  • Operate Sandbox Cloud across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including the self-service portal, demo and training environments, the SSP GitLab instance, and other gitlab.systems environments. Build automated deprovisioning and cost guardrails while keeping identity and access management with Identity Engineering and production infrastructure with Infrastructure Security and Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Own Corporate Security's operating-model reporting, annual operating plan, software spend, change management, systems directory, handbook upkeep, and dashboards. Coordinate audit evidence across all three teams for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), and FedRAMP, replacing screenshots with code and query exports.
  • Run departmental intake and reduce repeated requests through Slack automation, Serval, self-service security reviews, documentation hubs, and AI-assisted answers. Help each team focus on the systems it owns rather than routine triage.
  • Represent Platform Engineering in Corporate Security and Security leadership forums, the Authorization to Operate Council, and monthly AI spend reviews. Partner with Corporate IT, Infrastructure Security, security incident response, Security Compliance, Security Risk, Enterprise AI, Legal and Privacy, Procurement, and Finance to resolve shared priorities and ownership questions.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience managing security or platform engineering teams across time zones, including hiring engineers and developing senior individual contributors. Experience defining a team's remit and redirecting work to the right owner.
  • Experience owning several categories of corporate security tooling, such as network security, email security, software-as-a-service security posture, asset visibility, and cloud sandboxes. Sound judgment about when to adopt, consolidate, or retire tools.
  • Experience leading a team that operates tools as code using Terraform or OpenTofu, GitOps, merge-request change management, continuous integration pipelines, and Python or a similar language. The technical depth to review designs and code.
  • Hands-on experience deploying SASE, zero-trust network access, or always-on VPN solutions, alongside data loss prevention controls, in a remote-first company.
  • Knowledge of AWS and GCP organization structures, account provisioning, guardrails, and cost controls sufficient to operate a self-service sandbox platform safely.
  • Experience owning objectives and key results, vendor relationships, budgets, and security audit evidence programs, with the ability to write clear, concise plans for senior Security leadership.
  • Experience using agentic AI tools in your work and a clear approach to governing AI tools, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and credentials. The ability to run an enablement program without becoming the approver for every tool.
  • Clear written and asynchronous communication, a record of resolving ownership questions across functions, and an approach aligned with GitLab's values and all-remote, handbook-first ways of working. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable experience relevant to this work.

About the team

Platform Engineering owns shared security tooling, non-production environments, and department-wide programs within Corporate Security. The team works alongside Endpoint Engineering and Identity Engineering, with clear boundaries around each team's responsibilities. Its focus is to make security services easier to operate and use through automation, self-service, and written documentation, while keeping ownership, costs, and audit evidence clear. You'll lead a small, distributed team and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with technical, security, and business partners.
