We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.

Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

jobs.excerpt: About WebEngage: WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps.
jobs.description:
About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

This is a deeply technical individual contributor role on the Systems Lifecycle Engineering team, reporting to the Manager of Systems Lifecycle Engineering. You are the final authority on whether a drive, server platform, or component is ready for production, and your work directly determines the reliability, capacity, and cost efficiency of Backblaze's infrastructure for years to come.

You will work closely with the Capacity Planning, Data Center Operations, Purchasing, and SRE teams, as well as directly with hardware vendors.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Qualification & Testing

  • Facilitate end-to-end qualification testing for all HDD and SSD platforms under evaluation for Backblaze storage pods and server infrastructure, including 22TB-26TB+ CMR drives, HAMR-based drives, MAMR-based drives, and emerging SMR drive technologies as application support matures.
  • Execute structured validation test plans in staging environments covering drive endurance, sustained throughput, error rates, firmware behavior, and compatibility with Backblaze's storage pod chassis and HBA infrastructure.
  • Maintain and continuously update the hardware qualification documentation:
    • Production-approved drives and server platforms with full qualification records.
    • Hardware currently under evaluation, not yet approved for production.
    • Legacy hardware certified for continued conditional use (e.g., older drive models still deployable in specific scenarios).
  • Track drive writes per day (DWPD) endurance specifications, manufacturer SLA terms, and long-term capacity roadmaps across all qualified drive families.

Server Platform Qualification

  • Evaluate and qualify server platforms from multiple vendors across all Backblaze server types:
    • Storage pods: 60-bay chassis (20TB-26TB+ HDDs) and SMR-capable configurations.
    • Core servers: NVMe-heavy platforms for storage, Kubernetes, KVM hypervisor hosts, API servers, and other intensive workloads.
  • Define and maintain standard hardware BOMs for each server type, including CPU, RAM (DDR4/DDR5), NVMe (M.2, U.2), NIC (25GbE, 100GbE), HBA, and chassis, ensuring specs align with workload requirements and purchasing efficiency.
  • Work with Capacity Planning and Purchasing to minimize hardware SKU proliferation across the fleet, reducing serviceability complexity and spare parts overhead.
  • Validate server platform compatibility with Backblaze's provisioning pipeline, PXE boot infrastructure, and Ansible configuration management before approving for production deployment.

Firmware Lifecycle Management

  • Own firmware qualification and fleet maintenance across all hardware types, including HDD firmware, SSD firmware, NIC firmware, BMC/IPMI firmware, and BIOS/UEFI for all server platforms.
  • Coordinate firmware testing in staging before fleet-wide rollout, validating stability, performance, and compatibility with Backblaze's OS stack and application workloads.
  • Maintain a firmware version registry, documenting approved versions per hardware model, known issues, and rollout status across the fleet.
  • Partner with the Systems Security & Compliance team to ensure firmware updates address applicable CVEs within SLA windows.
  • Manage vendor relationships for firmware escalations, interfacing directly with server and drive manufacturers.

Staging Environment & Hardware Testing Infrastructure

  • Own and maintain Backblaze's hardware staging environment, the dedicated infrastructure used for all pre-production hardware qualification.
  • Design and execute test scenarios that simulate production conditions at scale, including sustained load testing, thermal validation, power draw measurement, and failure mode analysis.
  • Evaluate next-generation storage media and interconnect technologies in staging to inform long-term infrastructure planning and vendor roadmap alignment.
  • Coordinate with internal development and application teams to ensure hardware qualification is aligned with software readiness milestones.

Documentation & Hardware Governance

  • Produce thorough qualification reports for every hardware platform evaluated, including test methodology, pass/fail criteria, observed behavior, and a clear production recommendation with rationale.
  • Maintain living documentation covering approved hardware, current evaluation status, firmware versions, and legacy hardware disposition guidance.
  • Create and maintain hardware comparison matrices enabling Purchasing to make informed procurement decisions aligned with qualification outcomes.
  • Document hardware decommissioning criteria: when a drive or server model should be retired from the approved list and transitioned to the legacy or end-of-life category.
  • Write installation guides, RMA instructions, and remote-hands tickets from the DC Technician's point of view, describing what they'll actually see when they open the ticket: which bay, which cable, which LED, what it looks like before and after. Elaborate rather than assume.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise hardware, including servers, storage, or data center infrastructure in a production environment.
  • Deep understanding of HDD technology, including CMR, SMR, HAMR, MAMR, drive endurance metrics (DWPD, TBW), SMART attributes, and enterprise drive specifications.
  • Familiarity with SAS/SATA HBA infrastructure, drive firmware, and enterprise storage chassis (60-bay or equivalent).
  • Experience with server hardware platforms, including CPU, RAM, NVMe, NIC, BMC/IPMI, BIOS configuration, and hardware diagnostics.
  • Proficiency with Linux (Debian preferred), comfortable running hardware stress tests, interpreting dmesg output, reading SMART data, and using tools like hdparm, nvme-cli, fio, and smartctl.
  • Strong written communication: able to produce clear, detailed qualification reports and hardware documentation that non-experts can act on.
  • Hands-on data center hardware experience: physically racking, cabling, seating drives, and servicing chassis, not just evaluating hardware at the spec or software level. Understanding what a component looks and feels like in the rack is what makes it possible to write install guides and remote-hands instructions that a DC Technician can follow without back-and-forth.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multiple vendor server platforms, including chassis, BMC (IPMI/Redfish), etc.
  • Familiarity with storage concepts and filesystems.
  • Understanding of SMR drive zone management and HM-SMR vs DM-SMR distinctions.
  • Experience with IEEE 2883-2022 or NIST SP 800-88 data sanitization standards, including ATA Enhanced Erase, NVMe Sanitize, and degaussing.
  • Familiarity with configuration management for hardware configuration management and firmware rollout automation.
  • Experience with drive manufacturers' qualification and RMA processes.
  • Background in capacity planning or hardware lifecycle management at scale.

What You'll Own

  • The hardware qualification and certification process for all drives, server platforms, and components entering the Backblaze fleet.
  • Documentation of hardware qualification matrix: production-approved, under evaluation, and legacy hardware lists.
  • The hardware BOM standards for each server type across the fleet, minimizing SKU sprawl and serviceability complexity.
  • Firmware lifecycle management across HDDs, SSDs, NICs, BMC, and BIOS for all qualified hardware models.
  • The staging hardware environment used for all pre-production qualification testing.
  • Technical relationships with server vendors and drive manufacturers at the engineering/product level.

Field Sales Trainer

Location: Remote (U.S.), with 60 to 75% travel Type: Full-time, W-2
Compensation: On Target Earning: $80,000 - $90,000, plus full travel coverage, health insurance, 401(k), and PTO

About Sales Focus Inc.

Since 1998, Sales Focus Inc. (SFI) has built and managed outsourced sales teams for companies across the U.S. Headquartered in Charleston, SC, we have run programs of 120+ reps across 38 states, and every rep we place is a full-time W-2 employee. Our clients range from fiber and home-services providers to B2B technology companies, and our promise is simple: Trusted Process. Proven Results.

The Role

As SFI's Field Sales Trainer, you will travel to our client programs nationwide to launch new sales teams, train and certify reps in the field, and step in when a market needs a lift. You will spend most of your week side-by-side with reps, at the door, in the car, and on the sales floor, turning our playbooks into results.

What You Will Do

  • Lead on-site launch training for new programs and new-hire classes: product knowledge, client scripting, objection handling, CRM and order-entry systems
  • Run ride-alongs and live field coaching; model the pitch, then observe and give real-time feedback
  • Certify reps against SFI's standards before they work independently
  • Deploy into underperforming markets to diagnose issues (skill, activity, territory, or process) and build a turnaround plan with the program manager
  • Track trainee progress and report ramp metrics (time to first sale, week-6 production, 90-day retention) after every visit
  • Help build and refresh training materials, role-play scenarios, and certification checklists for each program
  • Develop team leads and identify future leaders in each market
  • Feed field insights back to leadership and clients on what is and is not working

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of field sales experience (door-to-door, outside B2B, or territory sales), with a track record of top performance
  • 1+ years training, coaching, or leading reps (team lead, field trainer, or sales manager)
  • The ability to learn a new product and pitch quickly and teach it within days
  • Comfort with direct, in-the-moment coaching and difficult performance conversations
  • Willingness to travel 60 to 75%, including frequent flights and extended stays in market
  • Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and ability to rent a car
  • Organized and self-directed; comfortable with CRM tools (HubSpot experience a plus)

Nice to Have

  • Experience across multiple industries (fiber/telecom, home services, energy, SaaS)
  • Experience launching new markets or sales offices from scratch
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish)

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary plus quarterly bonus tied to your trainees' success
  • All travel covered: flights, hotel, rental car or mileage, and daily per diem
  • Health insurance, 401(k), and PTO
  • A front-row seat to dozens of sales programs and a clear path into program management or sales leadership

jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Binnen een programma voor databeheer werk je mee aan verschillende opdrachten en projecten rond marktwerking. Die omvatten onder meer de stabilisatie van een centraal marktsysteem, de ondersteuning van nieuwe marktprocessen en initiatieven rond capaciteit, marktdata en gas.

De projecten situeren zich voornamelijk binnen de marktwerking en hebben een sterke interactie met systemen voor metering, assetmanagement en financiën. Als testcoördinator en testspecialist werk je samen met verschillende teams om de kwaliteit en integratie tussen de domeinen te bewaken.

Je kunt worden ingezet binnen functionele domeinen zoals Metering, Structure en Billing, maar ook binnen transversale domeinen zoals reporting en transitie.

  • Je documenteert testscenario's en de testvoortgang in een centrale testtool en verzorgt de rapportering.
  • Je voert zelf functionele testen uit en werkt daarbij hands-on.
  • Je coördineert end-to-end-testen over meerdere applicatieteams en/of projecten heen.
  • Je bespreekt potentiële defects met functionele analisten en zorgt voor een duidelijke defectomschrijving in de centrale testtool.
  • Je begeleidt eindgebruikers en businessanalisten bij het uitvoeren van user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Je stemt met de betrokken domeinen af om de nodige testdata voor te bereiden.
  • Je volgt openstaande defects op en bewaakt actief hun volledige levensloop.
  • Je organiseert Go/No-Go-meetings en rapporteert de testresultaten telkens duidelijk in Confluence.

Technische kennis

Je beschikt over theoretische en praktische kennis van de volgende domeinen en hulpmiddelen:

  • Enterprise Application Integration-oplossingen, BPM, XML en SQL.
  • Testtools zoals JIRA en Zephyr.
  • SpecFlow, Reqnroll, Tosca, Playwright of Selenium.
  • Geautomatiseerd testen, bijvoorbeeld met Selenium.
  • Azure, .NET en/of Java in het kader van testing.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt ervaring als testcoördinator en als tester met een focus op testuitvoering.
  • Je hebt grote, bedrijfskritische toepassingen met een hoge complexiteit getest.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met formele testmethoden en -technieken en kunt functionele en technische analyses interpreteren voor de correcte uitwerking van testscenario's.
  • Je stelt teststrategieën en testscenario's op voor databeheer- en marktprocessen en voert deze uit.
  • Je schrijft testautomatisatie en hebt ervaring met het testen van webapplicaties.
  • Je hebt ervaring met testen binnen een Agile/Scrum-project.
  • Je kunt testresultaten visueel presenteren aan de betrokken stakeholders.
  • Je hebt ervaring met UML en use-case-modellering.
  • Je beschikt over het ISEB Foundation Certificate in Software Testing of een ISTQB-certificaat.
  • Je toont tijdens het gesprek aan dat je hands-on werkt.
  • Ervaring in de Belgische nutsector is vereist.
  • Je denkt pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht binnen een afgesproken scope.
  • Je analyseert defects en formuleert daarvan een efficiënte en duidelijke omschrijving.
  • Je communiceert vlot en diplomatisch met verschillende stakeholders en draagt bij aan een goede samenwerking door informatie te delen met collega's.
  • Je staat open voor inzet in verschillende domeinen en kunt vlot omgaan met veranderende omstandigheden.
  • Je beschikt minimaal over een bachelordiploma.
  • Je drukt je vlot uit in het Nederlands en kunt Engels minstens lezen en goed begrijpen.
  • Je kunt goed overweg met Office-toepassingen.
  • Basiskennis van scripting of ontwikkeling is een pluspunt.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

jobs.excerpt: About GiveDirectly What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?
locationRestrictions: Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
jobs.description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role:

GiveDirectly has put more than $1B directly into the hands of people living in poverty. Now our finance function needs to scale with that.

We’re hiring a Finance Manager, a brand-new role in our Malawi/US pod (with room to take on additional entities), to build the capacity that growth demands. The pod backs programme operations and owns the core accounting in both countries.

You’ll lead the pod’s accounting, drive internal and external reporting, and shape budgeting, and that’s just the start. When the money moves this fast, the finance team keeps it moving accurately and on time.

Reports to : Senior Finance Manager

Level : Manager

Location : This is a remote role, that is open to citizens and permanent residents of the following countries only: DRC, Malawi, Mozambique, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda

Travel Requirements: Must be able to travel 1-2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or colocations

What you'll do:

  • Drive accurate financial reporting:
    • Act as preparer and reviewer for day-to-day accounting across the Malawi and US pod, including transaction review, coding, and financial data integrity.
    • Coordinate month-end, quarterly and year-end close for assigned entities.
    • Coordinate donor invoicing and donor financial reporting, ensuring accuracy, completeness and on-time delivery.
    • Lead reconciliation of GD bank and investment accounts, Wallet accounts, central payroll reconciliation and postings, and other asset and liability accounts.
    • Support budgeting, forecasting and budget-to-actual reviews for both countries, working with budget owners to keep forecasts grounded.
  • Strengthen controls and manage risk:
    • Strengthen internal controls, compliance and fraud prevention across the pod as transaction volume grows.
    • Serve as a trained backup for accounting and record-keeping
    • Ensure compliance with donor requirements, local regulations, tax obligations and organisational policy in both jurisdictions.
    • Coordinate audit preparation for assigned entities, respond to auditor requests, and follow through on findings to closure.
    • Conduct spot checks on transactions, advances, allowances and supporting documentation.
  • Keep finance operations running smoothly:

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

About the role

As a key designer on the nesto Servicing team, you will drive the end-to-end design process from discovery to delivery, partnering with cross-functional teams to shape our product vision. You will act as a relentless advocate for the user, leveraging direct customer feedback and data to transform complex problems into simple, intuitive experiences. By actively integrating AI-powered tools into your daily workflow, you will accelerate ideation and prototyping while owning and evolving our scalable design system to deliver beautiful, highly functional solutions.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the design process for key products and features, from discovery to delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to define the product vision and align on strategy.

  • Translate user research, analytics, and feedback into beautiful, functional designs that solve real problems.

  • Create high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and animations that impress stakeholders and users alike.
  • Facilitate design workshops and brainstorming sessions to inspire creativity across teams.
  • Advocate for the user at every stage, ensuring design decisions are grounded in user needs and usability.
  • Be opinionated and leverage a direct line to our customers to get insights. Explore solutions, create prototypes, and dive into user feedback and data to identify friction and opportunities for improvement.
  • Stay current with emerging design technologies, AI capabilities, tools, and industry best practices, bringing new approaches to how we design and deliver products.
  • Sweat the details, prioritize simplicity, and seamlessly integrate interconnected projects to transform complex tasks into intuitive experiences.

Who we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience designing digital products (web, mobile, or SaaS).
  • A strong portfolio showcasing UX/UI case studies, high-impact product design, and innovative solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma or similar design tools, with an interest in code, motion design, or interactive prototyping.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools as part of your regular design workflow, whether for research synthesis, concept generation, rapid prototyping, design exploration, or improving productivity.
  • Comfortable experimenting with emerging AI design and development tools, such as Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable, v0, or similar platforms, to accelerate how ideas are explored and brought to life.
  • Ability to combine strong design fundamentals with AI-assisted workflows, knowing when to leverage automation and when human judgment, creativity, and attention to detail matter most.
  • Experience setting up user research sessions and using tools such as Maze, UserTesting, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working within agile teams and collaborating with developers, PMs, and other stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to balance business goals with user needs to create designs that are both functional and beautiful.
  • Strong understanding of design systems and component libraries, with a focus on efficiency, consistency, and the end-user experience.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present your work and confidently guide discussions with senior leadership.

A curious, problem-solving mindset, with a passion for experimenting, challenging established approaches, and iterating quickly.

  • Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
  • Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.


Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the role

Engine’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) function builds and maintains the framework that lets the company sell, partner, and scale without compromising security or compliance. We are looking for a staff practitioner to serve as the Internal Security Assessor (ISA) for PCI DSS and to lead the company’s compliance program alongside its SOC 2 lifecycle. This person reports into the Manager of GRC and works closely with Legal, Security, Engineering, and Infrastructure to keep a complex, growing cardholder data environment (CDE) defensible and audit-ready.

Reporting and partnership

This role reports into the Manager of GRC within the legal department and is part of the company’s overall compliance and risk work. The person partners closely with Legal on contractual and regulatory obligations, including translating those obligations into security and compliance requirements. They also work with Security engineering, IT, People, Engineering, and Infrastructure, and represent GRC’s work credibly to engineering leadership.

What you’ll do

ISA and PCI DSS leadership (primary focus)

  • Serve as the Internal Security Assessor for PCI DSS 4.0.1, owning the PCI program day to day
  • Sign off on Self-Assessment Questionnaire versions where the program permits, and coordinate the annual assessment with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA), including the year-end assessment cycle
  • Own CDE scoping and the determination of which SAQ type applies to new and existing payment flows, including service provider flows
  • Maintain PCI compliance artifacts: CDE system inventory, payment provider tenant inventory, data flow diagrams, and PCI scoping documentation
  • Run the change management process for in-scope systems and confirm PCI impact on new engineering and product work before launch
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for PCI requirements, publish clear control baselines so teams can self-serve, and coordinate evidence collection across CDE system owners
  • Stay current on PCI requirements and Council guidance, and maintain the ISA credential
  • Own the GRC side of vulnerability scanning for PCI DSS, including the quarterly external scans performed by our Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) and the associated rescans until passing results are achieved
  • Define and maintain the scan scope (in-scope IP ranges, domains, and systems), and reconcile it against the asset inventory and the CDE boundary at least annually and after significant changes
  • Manage the ASV relationship and the scan dispute and false-positive process, and document justifications for any findings that are not remediated
  • Coordinate quarterly internal vulnerability scans and the annual penetration test required by PCI DSS, including scheduling, scope, and evidence collection
  • Track scan findings through remediation in the issue management process, with clear owners and due dates, and report status to leadership

Compliance program management

  • Lead the annual SOC 2 audit lifecycle: scoping, data requests, evidence gathering, fieldwork support, and report publication
  • Execute mid-year SOC 2 control check-ins with control owners and maintain the Controls Matrix (RCM) mapped to the Trust Services Criteria
  • Coordinate IT General Controls support for business-driven audits
  • Manage regular control testing across business, IT, and security processes on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, and bi-annual cadence

Legal and cross-functional partnership

  • Partner with Legal on contract and regulatory requirements that carry security or compliance obligations, including customer due diligence questionnaires and contract reviews
  • Advise Legal on PCI, SOC 2, and security obligations in customer, vendor, and partner agreements
  • Support product, go-to-market, and business teams on compliance questions during design and launch

Security architecture support

  • Participate in Security Architect reviews, assessing proposed designs for compliance and control implications before they ship
  • Translate PCI and SOC 2 requirements into design-time guidance for architects and engineers

Disaster recovery and resilience

  • Partner with engineering stakeholders on the Disaster Recovery Plan and defining meaningful recovery objectives
  • Coordinate annual DR and incident response tabletop exercises required by SOC 2 and PCI DSS

Shared GRC responsibilities

  • Contribute to the Security Risk Register, issue management, and policy lifecycle
  • Support customer security questionnaires and due diligence as needed

What you bring

  • 5+ years in security compliance, with substantial hands-on PCI DSS experience, ideally including SAQ D and service provider environments
  • Deep working knowledge of PCI DSS 4.0 and 4.0.1 and its requirements
  • Experience preparing for and coordinating with a QSA during PCI or SOC 2 assessments
  • Hands-on experience with SOC 2 audits, ideally as a lead or primary coordinator
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability management and PCI scanning cadence, including working with an ASV and tracking findings through remediation
  • Ability to read and reason about technical architecture (cloud infrastructure, payment flows, APIs, access control) well enough to challenge engineers, not just collect their evidence
  • Experience with control frameworks and risk methodologies such as NIST CSF 2.0, SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, or ISO 27001
  • Ability to work alongside lawyers, translating legal and contractual obligations into concrete controls
  • Strong written communication and the ability to translate requirements into guidance that non-specialists can act on
  • Comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward building repeatable processes, and the judgment to know which problems are worth a deep dive

Required

  • Ability to obtain the PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) credential through Engine’s ISA program within 3-6 months of hire
  • Eligibility to complete the required ISA training and certification steps once employed

Preferred

  • Experience with GRC platforms and evidence automation
  • Experience with ISO 27001 or ISO 42001 implementation

  • Prior experience serving as an ISA or working in an ISA program at another organization

jobs.description:
We're Hiring

Remote Academic Coach & Student Assistant (Part-Time, ~10 hours/week)

The steady partner who helps a high-achieving student master hard material and never miss a deadline.

About the Role

Seamless Assist is hiring a part-time Academic Coach & Student Assistant for a US-based family. You will work one-on-one, online, with their daughter, a motivated high-school student taking classes a year ahead of her grade, including several college-level Advanced Placement (AP) courses. This role reports to the student's parent.

Why This Role Exists

The student doesn't need to be taught from scratch. She is carrying a demanding, writing-heavy course load, and the pressure is in the volume: essays, problem sets, labs, tests and extracurricular deadlines all landing in the same week. This role exists to give her a sharp, organised partner who can keep up with advanced material, help her work through the hardest parts, and keep her schedule under control so nothing slips.

Her Current Classes

  • AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics
  • AP Biology
  • AP English Language & Composition
  • AP US History
  • Pre-Calculus
  • Spanish 4
  • Journalism & News Production

You don't need to be an expert in every subject. You do need to be strong in several of them, especially writing-heavy courses (AP English Language, AP US History) and at least one of economics, biology or maths.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Academic coaching (about 70% of your time)

  • Run live one-on-one video sessions to work through homework, problem sets, essays and test preparation.
  • Explain difficult concepts clearly and check that she can explain them back.
  • Review essays and written work for argument, structure, evidence and citations, including AP-style timed essays.
  • Build practice questions, review plans and study guides ahead of tests and the AP exams in May.
  • Learn how each course is taught and graded (syllabi, teacher rubrics, the College Board AP course frameworks) and coach to them.
  • Coach, never complete. Her work must always be her own, in line with her school's academic integrity rules.

Planning and student assistant support (about 30% of your time)

  • Run a weekly planning session: map every class's assignments, tests and deadlines into a shared calendar and task list.
  • Keep her schedule current across classes, activities and appointments, with study time blocked in.
  • Send short reminders before deadlines and confirm work was actually submitted.
  • Track grades and flag early when something starts to slip.
  • Send the parent a short weekly progress update.

Schedule

About 10 hours per week. Sessions fall on weekday afternoons and evenings, US Pacific Time (roughly 3:30–8:30 pm PT), plus one short weekend planning session. You must be reliably available in that window.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

This is a high-trust role with a bright, busy teenager. You will need real subject depth, patience, and the organisational discipline of a strong executive assistant.

  • You explain things clearly and can tell the difference between "I get it" and actually getting it.
  • You are a strong writer and can give specific, useful feedback on an argumentative essay.
  • You run your own life from a calendar and a task list, and you follow up without being asked.
  • You are warm, steady and encouraging, and you hold a high standard.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in education, English, history, economics, biology, mathematics or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of tutoring or teaching high-school or first-year university students.
  • Strong command of the material in several of the subjects listed above.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Your writing will be assessed during screening.
  • Uses AI tools in your daily work (for example Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) to build study materials and plan faster, and can teach a student to use them responsibly and within school rules.
  • Able to work US Pacific Time afternoons and evenings, about 10 hours per week.
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a webcam and a backup power or internet plan.
  • Willing to complete a national police clearance or background check and provide two professional references before starting.

Nice to have

  • Experience with the US Advanced Placement (AP) programme, or strong AP, SAT, IB or A-Level results of your own.
  • Conversational or better Spanish.
  • Journalism, editing or newsroom experience.
  • Comfortable in Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Drive) and a task tool such as Notion or Todoist.

How We Work

Because this role involves working one-on-one with a teenager, clear safeguards apply. All sessions run on a family-owned video account and are recorded. All messages go through a group channel that includes a parent. There is no private messaging or social-media contact with the student. A background check and references are required before the first paid session.

Pay

Competitive hourly pay, paid monthly in USD. Pay varies by country.

How to Apply

Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short AI-led video interview, a written subject task, an interview with the family and a paid trial session.

In this 100% remote position, you'll work with experienced network engineers and technical teams to support network integration, routing and switching, SD-WAN connectivity, troubleshooting, and infrastructure modernization.

Why Join Leidos?

At Leidos, you'll have the opportunity to build your networking expertise while supporting a mission that directly impacts the U.S. Army's global communications.

You'll work alongside experienced engineers, gain exposure to advanced enterprise networking technologies, and contribute to the modernization of critical military infrastructure.

If you're a cleared Network Engineer with routing, switching, and network integration experience who wants to grow your technical skills, we'd like to hear from you!

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About WRS Health WRS Health builds an Electronic Health Records (EHR) system that medical practices rely on every day to care for patients.
jobs.description:
About WRS Health

WRS Health builds an Electronic Health Records (EHR) system that medical practices rely on every day to care for patients. Our platform runs on Linux servers in AWS with a PHP application stack, and it holds some of the most sensitive data there is: protected health information.
We are now investing heavily in AI agents that work alongside clinicians and staff. That shift opens new ground for our product and new attack surfaces for our security program. We are hiring a Security Engineer to help us protect both.

The role

As our Security Engineer, you will find and fix security risks before attackers do, across our AWS infrastructure, our PHP application, and our growing fleet of AI agents. You will look ahead to emerging threats, especially those unique to LLMs and autonomous agents, and build defenses before they are needed.
This is a hands-on, collaborative role. You will work directly with our development and AI teams, helping them understand issues, prioritize fixes, and ship secure code. We want someone who teaches and enables, not someone who only files tickets.

What you'll do

Application security
  • Review PHP code and architecture for vulnerabilities such as injection, broken authentication, insecure deserialization, and access-control flaws.
  • Run and tune SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning (e.g., Composer packages) in our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Lead threat modeling for new features and work with developers to fix findings, with clear guidance and secure code examples.
Cloud and infrastructure security
  • Harden our AWS environment: IAM least privilege, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management.
  • Monitor and respond to findings from tools such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
  • Secure and patch Linux servers, and define hardened baselines for new infrastructure.
AI and agent security
  • Assess AI agents for risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive permissions, insecure tool use, and model supply-chain issues.
  • Define guardrails for what agents can access and do, especially where PHI is involved, including logging, human-in-the-loop controls, and output validation.
  • Partner with the AI team to build security into agent design from the start, using frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
Threat management and response
  • Track emerging threats to healthcare, cloud, and AI systems, and turn that intelligence into concrete defenses.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and vulnerability management, from discovery through verified fix.
  • Help build and run our incident response plan, including tabletop exercises.
Compliance and culture
  • Support HIPAA and HITECH compliance.
  • Run secure-coding training and build security awareness across engineering.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in security engineering, application security, or a closely related role.
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS environments, including IAM, VPC design, KMS, and AWS security services.
  • Strong Linux administration and hardening skills.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and driving findings to resolution.
  • Working knowledge of LLM and AI agent risks, such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, and over-permissioned agents.
  • Scripting or automation skills in Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain risk to developers and leadership in practical terms.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or other regulated-data environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare IT or with EHR systems and standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Prior work securing AI agents, RAG pipelines, or LLM integrations in production.
  • Infrastructure-as-code security (Terraform or CloudFormation) and container security.

What success looks like in your first year

  1. First 90 days: You have assessed our AWS, Linux, and PHP environments and our AI agent designs, and you have a prioritized risk roadmap.
  2. By six months: Automated security scanning runs in every pipeline, and developers fix critical findings quickly with your guidance.
  3. By one year: Every new AI agent passes a security review before launch, our incident response plan has been tested, and security is part of how engineering works day to day.

Details and how to apply

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time - Independent Contractor
  • Reports to: CTO
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Sapio Sciences is on a mission to accelerate scientific drug discovery and high-throughput clinical and diagnostics for our clients and partners. Sapio is one of the few software providers to offer a truly unified and highly configurable lab informatics platform and a broad suite of purpose-built solutions. The Sapio platform makes it easy for scientists, laboratory, and bio/informatics professionals to streamline and manage their end-to-end laboratory operations, from instrument data integration to workflow and experiment setup to sample and materials management, data management, and scientific data analysis and reporting.

Working at Sapio

At Sapio, we’re not just building lab informatics solutions. We’re creating tools made for the scientist and motivated to make the world a better place. We understand that lab informatics is about more than managing data or connecting workflows. It’s about making life easier for the scientist and making scientific progress faster for everyone. Our platform delivers the levels of configurability, usability and insight that scientists have only ever dreamed of.
We’re a team of scientists, developers and innovators who question convention and stay focused on what matters most - advancing drug discovery science. We challenge the status quo and respond to the needs at the heart of science with powerful solutions that are simple to use, effortless to evolve and downright easy to love.
As part of the Sapio team, you’ll work in a collaborative and forward-thinking environment where your ideas are valued, your growth matters and your work makes a difference.
We’re proud to partner with leading labs around the world, from ambitious start-ups to global organisations, who trust Sapio to support discovery, development and diagnostics with industry-first science-aware solutions.

About the Role

    You'll be the person who tells Sapio's story. You'll shape how the market understands our platform and give the demo that makes a room of scientists lean in. You'll also be the one the CEO asks, "What are customers really telling us?"

    This is a rare hybrid role. You'll sit between product, sales and marketing. You'll present on conference stages and also walk through the details of a GMP workflow. If you have deep scientific credibility, you're a natural presenter, and you're happiest in front of customers, read on.
    Location: Remote (US). We strongly prefer candidates based in the Eastern Time Zone.

    • Build the demo toolkit. Create and maintain demo environments, use-case scenarios and customer-facing collateral that show the platform accurately.
    • Get the message out. Shape content, conference presentations and webinars, and help prepare for customer advisory boards.
    What Motivates You

    • You're curious about how scientists actually work, and you're driven to solve their real problems.
    • You're equally effective one-to-one and in front of a crowd.
    • You juggle product, sales and marketing priorities without letting quality slip.
    • You're a self-starter who does well with autonomy and holds yourself to a high bar.
    • You collaborate easily across geographies and functions.
    • You're comfortable with ambiguity and adapt as the strategy evolves.
    • You do what you say you'll do, and you're open about progress and setbacks.
    • You obsess over the details of anything a customer will se

Qualifications

    Required

    • 8 + YOE in product management or product marketing experience at a life sciences software company, in a role that faced customers and the market.
    • 8+ YOE working in and developing deep knowledge of ELN and LIMS. You can talk credibly with scientists, lab managers and IT stakeholders.
    • Domain expertise across CMC, bioanalysis, bioprocessing, GMP manufacturing and QC LIMS. Experience with biologics and the biotech/pharma development pipeline is a strong plus.
    • A product marketing instinct. You can turn complex functionality into value propositions and customer stories that people remember.

    • A track record of demos that move deals forward.

    • Experience in a combined PM/PMM role, or working closely across both.
    • Familiarity with regulated environments such as 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP.
    • Experience at a Series B/C software company, building processes and collateral from scratch.
    • Exposure to scientific data management, informatics or related software.
    • Experience speaking at conferences, user groups or customer advisory boards.

Our People

At Sapio Sciences, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our lab informatics solutions are powered not just by technology, but by a shared commitment to our core values—what we proudly call The Sapio Seven, aka EMBRACE:

- Make a difference

- Remember why we’re here

These values shape how we work, how we grow, and how we deliver impact for our clients every day.

Reasonable Adjustments

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Backend Engineer, Data & Integrations Company: Solen Software Group Location: Karachi/Lahore, Pakistan Employment Type: Full-time, Contract About Solen Solen Software Group is a long-term owner and operator of mission-critical B2B software companies.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Backend Engineer, Data & Integrations
Company: Solen Software Group
Location: Karachi/Lahore, Pakistan
Employment Type: Full-time, Contract

About Solen

Solen Software Group is a long-term owner and operator of mission-critical B2B software companies. We acquire proven, profitable businesses and partner with their teams to build lasting market leaders. Unlike traditional private equity firms, Solen invests with permanent capital: we buy to keep, not to sell.

About the role

As our Backend Engineer, Data & Integrations, you will own the integrations and data foundations behind our AI platform: connecting the sources our research, M&A and operations teams rely on, organizing that information, and making sure it is accurate and available to the right people.

We want to start with what our first workflows need, not with a large data warehouse. What we learn from those workflows will tell us which warehouse and reporting capabilities we actually need, and you will help decide and build them.

Key responsibilities

First priorities

  • Connect the sources needed for our first research and M&A workflows, such as public datasets (for example US Census, BLS and SEC EDGAR), paid data providers, our CRM and internal documents.
  • Organize that information so it is consistent, accurate and easy to use, with clear definitions of what a company, industry, deal or person means.
  • Make sure each person and agent can access only the data they are allowed to see.

Integrations

  • Build and maintain integrations through APIs, webhooks and connectors, including tools such as Salesforce, Slack, Microsoft 365 and data providers.
  • Bring meeting transcripts, emails and documents into a shared, searchable store, applying the team's permission and redaction rules.
  • Extract structured data from PDFs, spreadsheets and call transcripts, using LLM-assisted pipelines where they help.
  • Later, connect the accounting, ERP and operating systems of the companies we acquire through a standard approach.

Data quality and foundations

  • Clean and link messy records across sources, including the relationships between industries, suppliers, customers and acquirers.
  • Add automated data quality checks and alerts so problems are caught before they reach a decision.
  • As needs become clear, design the warehouse, data model and reporting the team needs, sized for today with room to grow.

Engineering practice

  • Write well-tested, versioned code in Git, with monitoring for every integration.
  • Follow good security practice for credentials, access and sensitive data.
  • Document sources, integrations and definitions so others can use the data without help.

Key requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.
  • 3 or more years of backend or data software engineering in production.
  • Strong Python and SQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining API integrations (REST, webhooks, authentication) with third-party systems.
  • Experience working with messy, incomplete data from many sources and making it reliable.
  • Working knowledge of a cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure) and Git.
  • An AI-first way of working: you use coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex every day.
  • Comfortable working with financial data, such as P&L, balance sheet, customer and transaction data.
  • Clear written and spoken English.
  • Employment Type: Independent Contractor

Nice to have

  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse (for example Postgres, BigQuery or Snowflake), a transformation tool such as dbt or an orchestrator such as Airflow, Dagster or Prefect.
  • Experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or a similar tool.
  • Experience with document extraction, LLM-assisted pipelines or MCP servers.
  • Experience with data in banking, financial services or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with graph databases.

What will set you apart

We are looking for a strong engineer who takes pride in data that people can trust and wants to build foundations that last.

  • Owner: you treat every integration and data source as your system and keep it clean, documented and reliable.
  • Pragmatic: you build what the current workflows need, not the most complex version, and design it so it can grow.
  • Careful with detail: you check your numbers, catch errors early and flag issues before someone else finds them.
  • Business-minded: you want to understand how the data is used in a deal or a board report, not only how it moves.

Solen-isms (How We Operate)

  • Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.
  • Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.
  • Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.
  • Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.
  • Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.
  • Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.
  • Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.
  • Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.
  • Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.
  • Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.
  • Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.
  • Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.
  • Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.

Recruitment Disclaimer
Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.
We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Design learning with AI

  • Create courses and learning experiences in Sana, using it to draft outlines, learning objectives, lesson content, summaries, and assessments
  • Turn existing materials, such as slide decks, PDFs, SOPs, and technical documentation, into engaging interactive learning
  • Write effective prompts and instructions, and refine AI outputs until they meet instructional, technical, and brand standards
  • Use AI to adapt content for different roles, regions, and languages, and keep it current as processes and client requirements change
  • Explore new AI capabilities, share what works with the team, and help shape our standards for AI-enabled content development

Apply human expertise where it matters most

  • Partner with subject matter experts to identify business, client, and learner needs, and to validate content before it’s published
  • Review all AI-generated content for technical accuracy, tone, quality, and compliance with in-house standards and client guidelines. You are the final quality checkpoint
  • Translate complex technical information into clear language while keeping it accurate
  • Set clear instructional goals and make sure every piece of content helps learners achieve them

Build, measure, and improve

  • Develop learning content that meets our LMS requirements, including SCORM packages where needed
  • Design assessments and use learner data and feedback to improve both the content and the learner experience
  • Create supporting media (audio, visuals, simulations) that strengthen learning, using AI-assisted tools where appropriate
  • Work with operational leaders to support the ongoing monitoring and mentoring of learners

Collaborate and scale

  • Work with cross-functional teams across remote and office-based locations
  • Follow our processes, templates, and SOPs, and keep learning programs adaptable and scalable

Job Requirements

  • 5 years of experience in instructional design or learning content development
  • Hands-on experience using generative AI in content development, including prompting, iterating, and critically evaluating outputs
  • A responsible approach to AI: you understand its limits and rigorously review its output for accuracy, bias, and quality
  • In-depth knowledge of learning theories and instructional design models
  • Lesson and curriculum planning skills

Education Skills and Experience

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus, provided you have relevant experience and/or training
  • A master’s degree in instructional design, educational technology, or a related field is valued

Skills

  • Strong writing across instructional text, copy, and audio and video scripts
  • Effective verbal and written communication, with strong interpersonal and presentation skills, including the ability to work well in a remote setting
  • Strong computer skills
  • Positive, collaborative, and optimistic: you share ideas freely and see AI and change as opportunities
  • Self-driven and adaptable: you take initiative and are comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-evolving field
  • Commercially aware: you communicate confidently with commercial colleagues, negotiate well, and read a situation accurately

Experience

  • Experience with Sana or Workday Learning. Experience with other AI-native or AI-assisted authoring platforms is equally welcome, and we’ll support you in getting up to speed
  • Experience with traditional authoring tools (Articulate, Captivate, Lectora) and designing SCORM packages
  • Experience creating learning content for multilingual or global audiences
  • Design, video editing, and basic HTML skills
Join us and turn great knowledge into learning that people actually want to complete. With AI as your partner and your expertise as the guide, you’ll help create learning experiences that are clear, engaging, and built to make a real difference in how our people grow

Remote Academic Coach & Student Assistant (Part-Time, ~10 hours/week)

The steady partner who helps a high-achieving student master hard material and never miss a deadline.

About the Role

Seamless Assist is hiring a part-time Academic Coach & Student Assistant for a US-based family. You will work one-on-one, online, with their daughter, a motivated high-school student taking classes a year ahead of her grade, including several college-level Advanced Placement (AP) courses. This role reports to the student's parent.

Why This Role Exists

The student doesn't need to be taught from scratch. She is carrying a demanding, writing-heavy course load, and the pressure is in the volume: essays, problem sets, labs, tests and extracurricular deadlines all landing in the same week. This role exists to give her a sharp, organised partner who can keep up with advanced material, help her work through the hardest parts, and keep her schedule under control so nothing slips.

Her Current Classes

  • AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics
  • AP Biology
  • AP English Language & Composition
  • AP US History
  • Pre-Calculus
  • Spanish 4
  • Journalism & News Production

You don't need to be an expert in every subject. You do need to be strong in several of them, especially writing-heavy courses (AP English Language, AP US History) and at least one of economics, biology or maths.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Academic coaching (about 70% of your time)

  • Run live one-on-one video sessions to work through homework, problem sets, essays and test preparation.
  • Explain difficult concepts clearly and check that she can explain them back.
  • Review essays and written work for argument, structure, evidence and citations, including AP-style timed essays.
  • Build practice questions, review plans and study guides ahead of tests and the AP exams in May.
  • Learn how each course is taught and graded (syllabi, teacher rubrics, the College Board AP course frameworks) and coach to them.
  • Coach, never complete. Her work must always be her own, in line with her school's academic integrity rules.

Planning and student assistant support (about 30% of your time)

  • Run a weekly planning session: map every class's assignments, tests and deadlines into a shared calendar and task list.
  • Keep her schedule current across classes, activities and appointments, with study time blocked in.

Reviews, evaluates and assesses medical records of patients, looks for specificity of an illness, the accuracy of the clinician’s documentation, coding requirements and documentation of important medical details to ensure the overall quality and completeness of clinical documentation of the patient medical record and ensure it is in compliance with government and other regulations. Tangem solutions offer multi-support of a growing number of thousands of tokens by a single wallet. SBI Crypto Investment Ltd., the digital asset venture investment company wholly owned by SBI Holdings Inc., has invested $15 million into Tangem in 2019 for mass adoption of blockchain technology.

About the role
We are looking for a Security QA Engineer to take ownership of security testing within the Tangem QA team.You will act as a Security Champion, identify security risks in new features, define the required security checks, and validate the security of our iOS and Android applications.We expect you to work independently, challenge potentially unsafe solutions, and help the team detect vulnerabilities before they reach production.

Responsibilities

  • Review new features and technical changes to identify security risks and potential attack vectors.
  • Define security testing scope and priorities based on feature risks.
  • Perform hands-on security testing of Tangem mobile applications on iOS and Android.
  • Design and execute security test cases, including negative tests, abuse scenarios, and edge cases.
  • Validate security-critical wallet operations, including wallet creation and recovery, transaction signing, authentication, and sensitive data handling.
  • Test security aspects of WalletConnect, dApp interactions, API communication, and external integrations.
  • Participate in feature design discussions and raise security concerns before implementation.
  • Investigate potential vulnerabilities, assess their severity, and verify fixes.
  • Maintain security regression coverage for critical application functionality.
  • Guide the QA team on security risks, testing approaches, and areas that require additional attention.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in mobile application testing on iOS and Android.
  • Practical experience in application security testing and vulnerability assessment.
  • Good understanding of OWASP MASVS, common mobile vulnerabilities, and attack techniques.
  • Experience with security testing tools such as Burp Suite, MobSF, Frida, or similar.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, secure storage, and network security.
  • Ability to analyze application behavior beyond the UI, including API requests and integration flows.
  • Experience with threat modeling, risk assessment, and security-focused test design.
  • Ability to independently identify risks, explain their impact, and propose relevant security checks.
  • Strong investigation skills and ability to collaborate with developers on security issues.

Nice to have
  • Experience testing crypto wallets, blockchain applications, or financial products.
  • Understanding of private key management, seed phrases, derivation paths, and cryptographic signing.
  • Knowledge of Web3 security, smart contract interactions, and transaction approval risks.
  • Experience with mobile application reverse engineering and dynamic analysis.
  • Experience with automated security testing and CI/CD integration.

Benefits

  • Stability, development, participation in the future unicorn's growth;
  • Remote work from anywhere in the world, excluding Russia and Belarus, with a schedule aligned with GMT+3;
  • Competitive salary in EUR/USDT;
  • Unlimited vacation;
  • Birthday presents;
  • Compensation for the purchase of necessary technical devices for the work;
  • Paid sick leaves.

Job Title: Experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA II / Sr / PCRA) - Ontario Canada

Job Location: Remote, Canada
