Job Description

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our global Clinical Operations colleagues within our PPD® clinical research services provide end-to-end support for clinical trials from study start up to monitoring through to study close out, across commercial and government contracts. Together, we help clients define and develop clinical programs, minimize delays, and execute high-quality, cost-efficient clinical studies.

Discover Impactful Work:

Performs and coordinates all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. Conducts remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation. Manages procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e. FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acts as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well-being and data reliability. Ensures audit readiness. Develops collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to role are outlined in the task matrix.

A day in the Life:

  • Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
  • Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.
  • Assess investigational products through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.
  • Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution.
  • May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
  • Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process.
  • Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
  • Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites.
  • Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted.
  • Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
  • Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations.
  • Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
  • Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports tothe Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required.
  • Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
  • Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
  • Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
  • Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
  • Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members.
  • Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.
  • Job Complexity Works on problems of limited scope. Follows standard practices and procedures in analyzing situations or data from which answers can be readily obtained.
  • Job Knowledge Learns to use professional concepts. Applies company policies and procedures to resolve routine issues.
  • Supervision Received Normally receives detailed instructions on all work.
  • Business Relationships Contacts are primarily with immediate supervisor, and other personnel in the department. Builds stable working relationships internally.

Keys to Success:

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in life related field or a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.

Experience

  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 1 years as a clinical research monitor) or completion of PPD Drug Development Fellowship.
  • Valid driver's license where applicable.
  • In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Proven clinical monitoring skills
  • Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
  • Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
  • Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
  • Ability to manage Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes·Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
  • Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • Effective interpersonal skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required
  • Good computer skills: solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
  • Good English language and grammar skills
  • Good presentation skills

Work Environment

Thermo Fisher Scientific values the health and well-being of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:

  • Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.
  • Able to work upright and stationary for typical working hours.
  • Able to work in non-traditional work environments.
  • Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.
  • Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.
  • May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments.
  • This role requires independent travel up to 80%, inclusive of traveling in automobiles, airplanes, and trains.

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today!

Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
About ArmorCode

ArmorCode delivers the Agentic Control Plane for Unified Exposure Management. The ArmorCode platform ingests findings from 425+ security tools, correlates them with business context in the Context Risk Graph, and puts Anya AI agents to work prioritizing, routing, and verifying fixes. Enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to remediate at machine speed and reduce risk fast.

Processing over 400 billion findings a year across hundreds of native integrations, ArmorCode unifies, prioritizes, and drives remediation across applications, cloud, code, infrastructure, and AI. Powered by Anya, the industry's first agentic AI framework for enterprise security, ArmorCode is trusted by global enterprises to reduce exposure and adopt AI and modern software practices with confidence, without replacing existing tools or forcing vendor consolidation.

ArmorCoders believe in five core values: Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human. Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression.

The Role

The Marketing Operations Manager is the engine behind ArmorCode's go-to-market measurement and execution. You will own the marketing technology stack, data architecture, lead lifecycle, and reporting that show us what is working, and you will use AI and automation to help a lean marketing team perform well beyond its size. You will report to the CMO with a dotted line to the Director of Growth Marketing.

What You'll Own

AI-First Execution & Automation

  • Use AI as the primary tool for execution work: campaign build specifications, copy and audience variants, list upload logic, QA, and reporting.
  • Build, configure, and test AI agents and automations that run marketing workflows, own the automation roadmap, and metrics reporting
  • Pilot new capabilities, then codify what correct execution looks like, including the eval rubrics and human-review checkpoints that hold agents to it.
  • Connect AI tools to HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, and 6sense through APIs, integrations, and agent tooling.
  • Raise the AI capability of Marketing and partner teams through documentation, enablement, and coaching.

Marketing Technology Stack & AI Enablement

  • Own implementations of HubSpot, Outreach, and 6sensemaximize the value we get from each. Collaborate with SalesOps on marketing workflows/schema captured in Salesforce, and implementation of lead enrichment, and lead routing tools
  • Evaluate new tools and AI capabilities, make clear build vs. buy recommendations, and build lightweight tooling and automations where it is the better answer.
  • Apply AI and agentic workflows to remove manual work across campaign setup, list management, enrichment, reporting, and analysis.
  • Maintain the stack roadmap, integration health, and cost-to-value view of every tool.

Budgeting, Planning, and Housekeeping

  • Provide top-down and bottoms-up marketing planning and forecast against pipeline goals
  • Use conversion metrics to model the number of qualified leads, meetings, and opportunities needed to meet pipeline goals
  • Track and report on campaign performance including POI (Pipeline on Investment) metrics for campaigns.
  • Maintain and execute the process to upload event leads and lists into the system in a timely manner for lead follow ups
  • Monitor the marketing and BDR funnel for leaks and work with marketing and BDR leadership to fix issues early

Always-On Metrics & Campaign Performance

  • Run always-on funnel and campaign reporting for a lean marketing organization, with weekly, monthly, and quarterly views for Marketing, BDR, and leadership.
  • Work with the Growth team to monitor campaign performance in near real time, diagnose issues (routing, tracking, deliverability, targeting, scoring, nurture), and apply fast, practical tweaks.
  • Maintain MQL scoring, nurture logic, and deliverability so volume and quality stay matched to BDR capacity and pipeline goals.
  • Advise campaign owners at the brief stage on what is executable and at what cost, and turn execution learnings into platform and process requirements.

Web Metrics & Growth Partnership

  • Interpret web and digital conversion metrics (traffic sources, engagement, form conversion, landing page and site performance) and turn them into prioritized opportunities.
  • Partner with Growth Marketing to design tests, instrument tracking, and improve conversion across the website, paid, and email.

Attribution, Pipeline Origination & Influence

  • Own the attribution model and methodology, including marketing sourced and marketing influenced opportunities, and channel sourced vs. channel influenced criteria.
  • Provide a clear, trusted picture of pipeline origination and influence, and reconcile discrepancies between HubSpot, Salesforce, and Finance.
  • Maintain the UTM and campaign tracking taxonomy and governance.

Data Architecture, Routing & Governance

  • Own HubSpot schema and collaborate with SalesOps on SFDC schema, lifecycle stages, lead statuses, SLAs, lead routing, and deduplication.
  • Maintain data hygiene standards, enrichment strategy, list upload processes, and consent and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).
  • Run the quarterly MOPS health review: sync errors, UTM compliance, scoring accuracy, list hygiene, and deliverability.
  • Summarize and present to E-staff on marketing metrics, support the creation of board slides and QBR decks

ABX & Intent Activation

  • Operationalize ICP tiers across HubSpot, Salesforce, and 6sense, and turn intent signals into BDR tasks and nurture enrollment.
  • Keep the marketing-to-BDR handoff, accept/reject/recycle logic, and SLA enforcement running cleanly.

Sales Ops Partnership

  • Represent Marketing in conversations with Sales Ops on definitions, routing, territories, reporting, and system changes.
  • Hold your own on data and process trade-offs, and align the funnel, handoffs, and metrics with Sales, BDR, and Channel leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in B2B marketing operations, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity, with ownership of a full marketing tech stack
  • Deep proficiency with HubSpot and strong familiarity with Salesforce, plus hands-on experience with Outreach, 6sense, lead enrichment tools (such as ZoomInfo), and lead routing tools
  • Experience with channel tools such as Crossbeam and channel enablement or deal registration platforms
  • AI-savvy: you actively use AI tools and agents to automate work, can evaluate new tools critically, and understand build vs. buy trade-offs, including when to build tooling yourself
  • Demonstrated use of AI to produce real marketing work, with specific examples of what you automated and the measured effect on time, cost, quality, or volume
  • Hands-on experience building, configuring, and evaluating AI agents or LLM-based workflows
  • Experience connecting AI tools to marketing systems through APIs, integrations.
  • Experience leading a workflow from manual to automated agentic execution
  • Strong command of attribution models, with the ability to explain pipeline origination and influence clearly to executives and Finance
  • Ability to read and interpret web and funnel metrics and translate them into recommendations for Growth Marketing
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot campaign performance and apply tweaks quickly in a lean team
  • Strong reporting and dashboard skills, and a bias toward automation over manual work
  • Comfort with ambiguity, where the standard does not exist yet and part of the job is writing it
  • Clear, direct communicator who documents processes and works well across Marketing, BDR, Sales, Channel, and Finance

Why This Role, Why Now

ArmorCode is building the category-defining platform for Unified Exposure Management. We're entering a pivotal growth phase with a strong product, a proven team, and the momentum to match. This role sits at the center of that, and the person who steps into it will have a direct line to the CMO, with career advancement opportunities and real ownership over how we measure and run go-to-market.

Why You Will Love It

  • Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and provide career progression paths, enabling our employees to advance in their careers.
  • Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance, offering flexible hours and remote work options to promote a sustainable lifestyle.
  • Collaborative Environment: Our company fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, where employees can collaborate and learn from each other's experiences.
  • Employee Recognition: We value and recognize the contributions of our team members through awards, employee of the month programs, and other forms of acknowledgment.
  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses, recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health insurance for employees and dependents, to support the overall well-being of our employees. We encourage learning and skilling, and aid our employees to continuously upskill themselves.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: We are committed to diversity and inclusion, striving to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.

Join ArmorCode and lead the charge in reducing signal fatigue, prioritizing risk and streamlining key cybersecurity workflows. Apply today to be part of a close-knit team, dedicated to democratizing software security and helping build the safest software possible.

Field CTO

Aimpoint Digital is a market-leading data, AI, and analytics consulting firm. We help organizations design, build, and operationalize modern data platforms, analytics solutions, and production AI applications.

We work across Databricks, Snowflake, Anthropic, and other leading platforms, and we are expanding our pre-sales solutions organization. We are seeking a Field CTO to help shape and win complex data and AI consulting engagements.

About the Role

As Field CTO, you will build deep client relationships and own the technical portion of the sales cycle end-to-end for our largest and most strategic opportunities, from initial discovery through solution design, scoping, proposal development, technical validation, and handoff to delivery. You will also act as the senior technical voice with executive clients, helping them decide where and how to invest in data and AI.

You will partner directly with our key clients, as well as with sales, alliance, and delivery teams to understand client needs, design the right technical solution, and translate that solution into a credible and executable consulting engagement.

This role is designed for someone who has done similar work in a consulting or professional services environment. You know how to move from an ambiguous client problem to a clear architecture, delivery approach, team structure, estimate, and statement of work. You are also comfortable working above the level of a single project, defining roadmaps for strategic transformation programs at Fortune 500 clients.

You will work across platform deployment and infrastructure, migrations, data engineering, data science, AI, and the human interfaces on top of them, including BI tools, custom applications, and bidirectional integrations with SaaS platforms. Your technical depth should be strongest in data and platform engineering, with a strong understanding of how modern data architectures support downstream analytics and AI.

You will be expected to define solutions on any platform we work with. Cloud provider solutions on AWS, Azure and GCP, Data platforms including Databricks, Snowflake, AI and ML implementations leveraging Anthropic and OpenAI, and front end facing tools like Sigma, Omni, and other BI tools.

What You Will Do

  • Own the technical portion of pursuits from first client conversation through signed engagement and transition to delivery.
  • Lead technical discovery with client engineering, architecture, data, analytics, AI leaders, and C-suite stakeholders.
  • Define roadmaps for strategic transformation opportunities across Fortune 500 clients, and make and defend recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Design architectures for new platforms, migrations, modernization programs, and complex data workloads on Databricks, Snowflake, and Anthropic, and on Sigma, Omni, and other BI tools, across and including Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Define lakehouse, warehouse, and medallion architectures across bronze, silver, gold, and downstream consumption layers.
  • Solution data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, governance, security, platform deployment, infrastructure, and semantic layer patterns.
  • Design data foundations that support BI, self-service analytics, ML, GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI use cases.
  • Design the human interfaces on top of the platform, including BI tools, custom applications, and bidirectional integrations with SaaS platforms.
  • Define AI Governance implementation approaches covering people, process, security and tools to support them.
  • Translate technical requirements into project scope, delivery phases, assumptions, risks, resource plans, and estimates, including outcome-based and multi-phase engagements.
  • Partner with sales and delivery leaders to develop proposals and statements of work.
  • Build and deliver technical demos, proofs of concept, architecture workshops, and solution presentations that help clients understand and validate the proposed approach.
  • Create reusable pre-sales materials, including demo environments, reference architectures, discovery frameworks, solution patterns, technical content, and estimation models.
  • Work directly with Databricks, Snowflake, Anthropic, and other partner account teams and solution architects on joint pursuits and co-sell opportunities.
  • Ensure clean handoffs from pre-sales into delivery so project teams inherit clear architecture, scope, assumptions, and client context.
  • Represent Aimpoint externally through client briefings, events, and published points of view on data and AI architecture.
  • Bring what you learn in the field back to our sales, consulting, and alliance teams to sharpen our offerings and help the wider team sell and deliver.

Who We Are Looking For

  • We are looking for a strong consulting technologist who combines strategic thinking, business analysis, and deep technical experience with client presence and commercial judgment.
  • You have likely worked in a consulting, systems integrator, or professional services organization where you owned or played a major role in complex data and AI platform pursuits. You are comfortable entering a sales cycle early, leading discovery, challenging assumptions, whiteboarding architecture, building demos, estimating delivery effort, and helping turn a technical solution into a signed engagement.
  • You have enough hands-on engineering experience to earn credibility with technical teams, while being able to simplify complex concepts for data leaders and the C-suite. You are confident making a recommendation in front of an executive audience and defending it when challenged.
  • You understand that strong pre-sales work is not about designing the most sophisticated architecture. It is about identifying the right solution, demonstrating that it will work, building client confidence, and creating an engagement that the delivery team can execute successfully.
  • You are a team player and a good culture fit, and you enjoy working side by side with our consulting and sales teams.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or related roles.
  • Significant experience in consulting, professional services, systems integration, or technical pre-sales.
  • Demonstrated experience owning the technical workstream of complex enterprise sales cycles, ideally with Fortune 500 clients.
  • Strong architecture and implementation experience on Databricks and Snowflake in enterprise environments, with working knowledge of Anthropic’s platform for AI and agentic use cases.
  • Deep knowledge of modern data engineering, including Spark, SQL, Python, data pipelines, orchestration, data modeling, and distributed processing.
  • Strong understanding of lakehouse and warehouse architecture, medallion patterns, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, governance, and security.
  • Experience with data platform or warehouse migrations.
  • Understanding of semantic layers, analytics architectures, BI tools such as Sigma and Omni, and how enterprise data platforms support AI and ML workloads.
  • Working knowledge of Azure, AWS, and GCP, including platform deployment and infrastructure.
  • Experience designing custom applications and bidirectional integrations with SaaS platforms.
  • Expert-level experience leading client discovery, architecture workshops, solution design, demos, estimation, and SOW scoping, including outcome-based and multi-phase projects.
  • Experience defining roadmaps for strategic transformation programs at large enterprises, ideally Fortune 500 clients.
  • Exceptional communication skills across engineers, architects, data leaders, and the C-suite, including the ability to make a recommendation and defend it under challenge.
  • Willingness to travel roughly once every one to two months for client meetings, workshops, and events.
  • Certifications in Databricks, Snowflake, or the major cloud providers preferred.

Vice President of Engineering

OUR COMPANY

SimX is a fast-growing company that has brought virtual and augmented reality to medical simulation training. At the end of 2024, we were acquired by Madison Industries, a partnership that has provided a surge in resources to accelerate our growth and mission. Our professional-grade VR system is the first of its kind, used by physicians, nurses, and paramedics to reduce medical errors and save lives.

Over the last decade, demand for our product has exploded; we are now used by 10 of the nation’s top 15 hospitals, including world-renowned institutions like the Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Pennsylvania, our product is used around the world, and our technology is deployed across more than 50 US Military installations. We are looking for a mission-driven engineering leader to help us continue this momentum and achieve our mission to save lives around the world through better, faster, and more accessible simulation training.

THE MISSION

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Vice President of Engineering will be the executive leader of our engineering organization. Your mission is to further develop the maturity of our engineering organization, foster a culture of engineering excellence in a time of unprecedented change to engineering practices, and accelerate the delivery of our life-saving VR products. You will guide the evolution of our technical platform, ensuring it is robust, scalable, extensible, and capable of supporting our rapid growth as we scale toward $50M+ in ARR and beyond.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Engineering Leadership & Vision

  • Partner with the CEO, CTO, and executive team to define and execute the technical and engineering roadmap, ensuring alignment with our mission, product strategy, and market expansion goals.
  • Architect a long-term engineering strategy that balances rapid feature delivery with scalable, secure, and maintainable infrastructure.
  • Define, track, and report engineering KPIs that give the executive team and Madison Industries leadership clear visibility into delivery, quality, and team health.
  • Adapt the engineering organization to the rapidly advancing frontier of engineering processes, including the ubiquitous use of AI tooling, in order to maximize the performance of the team.

Team Building & Organizational Scaling

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a world-class, distributed engineering team, scaling the organization to support a business 10x its current size.
  • Establish robust engineering management practices, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Manage the company’s Engineering division, including direct reports at the Director level and technical leads and individual contributors through the reporting chain, and own its organizational design.
  • Develop a strong engineering leadership bench (managers and technical leads) and ensure they are capable of independently owning major engineering areas as the organization grows.

Engineering Execution and Effectiveness

  • Own the end-to-end software development lifecycle, driving disciplined agile practices that deliver predictable, high-quality releases.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Operations, and Clinical Education teams to ensure engineering outputs consistently meet the rigorous standards required for professional healthcare training.
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring adoption and continuous improvement of best practices (e.g., optimizing CI/CD pipelines, automating testing, reducing technical debt), as well as integrating new approaches (e.g., AI-driven testing, automated code reviews, etc.) when appropriate.

Architecture, Quality, & Security

  • Oversee the design and evolution of our platform architecture, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability across global education, hospital and military deployments.
  • Complete the platform’s transition to a fully composable architecture of well-separated, extensible components that can be combined to serve any scenario, product, or market.
  • Standardize how platform components are designed, described, and documented (consistent interface contracts and rich, machine-readable metadata) to ensure that scenarios and products can be composed through tooling.
  • Establish engineering standards that ensure software is secure, reliable, maintainable, and observable throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Lead continuing efforts to support our enterprise customers via an engineering focus on security and compliance (e.g., SOC 2 and other relevant certifications, secure software development lifecycle, and broad adoption of best practices).
  • Own engineering metrics related to software quality, platform reliability, security posture, technical debt, and performance.
  • Establish engineering ownership for production reliability, including monitoring, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of professional engineering experience, with at least 4 years in a senior leadership role (VP, Senior Director, or equivalent) in a high-growth environment.
  • Proven experience scaling a SaaS, gaming, or EdTech company’s engineering organization through significant growth phases (e.g., $10M to $50M+ ARR); experience specifically at a B2B company selling to enterprise customers preferred.
  • Deep technical expertise in modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI-assisted engineering tooling and practices.
  • Experience leading engineering organizations through navigating regulatory requirements and security and compliance initiatives such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or similar, and including integrating secure development practices into the software development lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated success in recruiting, managing, and retaining high-performing, distributed engineering teams.
  • U.S. Citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. SimX is unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a PE or VC-backed environment.
  • Previous experience in the healthcare, simulation, gaming, or medical technology industries.
  • Hands-on experience with game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine and VR/AR hardware ecosystems.
  • Experience building and managing distributed teams in a remote-first environment.
  • Experience leading component-based platforms, including standardized component models and interface contracts, consistency and reuse across a large library of parts, and self-describing systems (schemas, metadata, documentation) that authoring tools and non-technical users can build on without engineering involvement.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Target salary range: $255,000 - $285,000 annually, commensurate with experience, plus a 15% annual performance bonus based on business performance targets.
  • Equity Appreciation Rights (EARs), which let you share directly in the value created as the company grows.

Bid Writer

Programme: UK Growth

Location: UK Mobile Worker with travel as required

Salary: £36,900 - £61,000


We are expanding our Growth team and have a number of opportunities available across different levels of seniority. We are keen to hear from talented growth professionals with a strong track record of developing and winning complex opportunities, including those with experience of leading major strategic deals. The level of appointment and any salary offered will reflect the individual’s relevant skills and experience, as well as their performance throughout the interview and selection process.

We are looking for motivated Bid Writers to join our established bid management function.

Working with Bid Managers, Capture Managers, Solution Architects and subject matter experts (SMEs), you will create clear, compliant and persuasive content throughout the bid lifecycle, turning complex information into compelling responses that explain our solution, demonstrate credible evidence and differentiate our offer.

What you will bring

  • You will combine strong writing and editorial skills with the confidence to engage technical specialists and stakeholders across the business.
  • Experience developing bid or proposal content through drafting and structured review.
  • The ability to translate complex information into concise, persuasive, evaluator-focused responses, supported by strong editorial judgement and attention to compliance, accuracy and evidence.
  • Effective facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to challenge weak or unsupported material constructively.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines and sensitive information with sound judgement.
  • A writing-related qualification or equivalent professional writing experience is desirable but not essential.

What you will do

  • Own assigned responses and content workstreams from requirement analysis and storyboarding through drafting, review and final editorial assurance, ensuring clarity, technical accuracy, compliance and alignment with the agreed bid strategy.
  • Analyse procurement documents, customer questions, instructions and evaluation criteria, translating requirements into logical response structures and maintaining compliance and gap controls.
  • Plan content using storyboards, response templates, content plans and Walls of Truth to control requirements, evidence and messaging.
  • Facilitate SME interviews and workshops to establish the proposed approach, rationale, evidence, differentiators and measurable customer benefits.
  • Draft PQQ and tender responses from workshop outputs, SME input and technical source material, restructuring contributions to improve clarity, logic and persuasion.
  • Ensure each response explains what we will deliver, how and why the approach is credible, and the customer benefits, with technical accuracy validated by SMEs.
  • Review content from an evaluator’s perspective, addressing evidence and rationale gaps while embedding agreed win themes, discriminators, customer priorities and value propositions.
  • Research and tailor case studies, proof points, model answers and corporate credentials using the Proposal Information Centre (PIC) and approved programme information.
  • Support storyboard, Pink, Red, Grey and final white-glove reviews, helping to prioritise and resolve feedback.
  • Complete final editorial assurance, checking grammar, terminology, consistency, cross-references, formatting, attachments and page, word or character limits.
  • Work with SMEs and production colleagues to identify where graphics, tables and callouts will communicate complex information more effectively and prepare clear briefs for their development.
  • Build productive relationships across pursuit and delivery teams, partners, reviewers and production colleagues, communicating actions, deadlines, dependencies and quality concerns clearly.
  • Develop reusable bid content, coach SMEs and developing writers, and champion best practice by sharing learning and improving templates, reviews, content libraries and writing standards.

Development opportunities

The role offers continued professional development through:

  • Working with experienced bid professionals and technical specialists.
  • Training and practical development in proposal best practice, content planning, storyboarding and structured reviews.
  • Support for APMP membership and certification.
  • Longer-term career pathways in proposal content or bid management.

What Application Development & Maintenance contributes to Cardinal Health


Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.


Application Development & Maintenance develops, enhances, and sustains software systems in a cross-functional team environment through established design controls and engineering practices. The function partners with business leaders to understand needs and deliver, maintain, and enhance technology solutions.


Position Overview


Cardinal Health Sonexus Health Pharmacy Services is seeking an experienced Manager, AI Solutions Owner to lead delivery of prioritized AI solutions from incubation through production and sustainment.


The ideal candidate combines strong solution ownership and delivery leadership with AI and software engineering knowledge to direct a technical team, guide solution and vendor decisions, and challenge architecture, data, security, evaluation, and production-readiness assumptions.


As the accountable technology Solution Owner for assigned AI capabilities, this leader will translate patient, customer, operational, and growth opportunities into executable delivery plans and measurable outcomes.

Because AI often requires more discovery than traditional solutions, the role will use focused incubation, prototypes, and vendor evaluations to reduce uncertainty and inform delivery decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Own prioritized AI solutions end-to-end, from incubation through delivery, production, sustainment, and retirement.
  • Lead delivery, including plans, estimates, capacity, resources, milestones, dependencies, risks, budget, and execution outcomes.

  • Ensure solutions meet production, architecture, security, privacy, Responsible AI, regulatory, quality, and operational requirements.
  • Own solution health and sustainment, including production performance, incidents, technical debt, enhancements, support readiness, and lifecycle decisions.

Qualifications

  • 8-12 years of technology experience, preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience, preferred.
  • 5+ years of solution ownership, delivery leadership, or comparable experience driving complex technology solutions to completion.
  • Proven ability to build and lead strong teams, set expectations, resolve barriers, and deliver outcomes.
  • Strong delivery planning, capacity, resource, financial, risk, and dependency management skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership across Product, business, engineering, operations, and enterprise partners.
  • Strong executive communication and influence, including driving prioritization, trade-offs, commitments, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong AI and technical fluency to guide engineering teams, evaluate solution options, and lead focused incubation using appropriate AI SDLC, testing, observability, FinOps, and production practices.

  • Experience evaluating AI vendors and build, buy, partner, or enterprise-reuse options preferred.

  • Ensures employees operate within guidelines
  • Decisions have a short term impact on work processes, outcomes and customers

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.
Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production.

At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compresseddata in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.
As an SRE, you’ll combine software engineering with production ownership: understand how the platform behaves, identify what limits its reliability and growth, and build lasting improvements alongside the developers and teams who use it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and improve the reliability, performance, and capacity of our YTsaurus clusters, with particular attention to data durability and predictable behavior under load.

  • Develop services, Kubernetes automation, and operational tooling in Go to simplify cluster provisioning, upgrades, and maintenance.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools so we can detect problems early and understand their impact on users.

  • Investigate failures across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed storage and compute. Participate in on-call, lead incident investigations, and turn findings into lasting fixes.

  • Improve resource utilization and workload isolation as the platform grows and serves more teams.

  • Work with platform developers and users to make architectural decisions, deliver changes safely, and reduce repetitive operational work.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience operating distributed, stateful systems in production and taking responsibility for their reliability.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to investigate resource bottlenecks and failures beyond the application layer.

  • Practical Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads.

  • Strong programming skills and experience building maintainable software. We primarily use Go; experience in another language and a willingness to learn Go are welcome.

  • A systematic approach to troubleshooting, using evidence from logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior.

  • The ability to drive improvements from problem identification through delivery, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate with developers and platform users.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).

  • Experience developing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

  • Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, or resource management in multi-tenant systems.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Who are we?

TripledotStudios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

This role sits within our Peoplefun studio.

PeopleFun is an award-winning creator of mobile games for players across the globe, and a part of Tripledot Studios, with world-class projects, resources, and infrastructure.

PeopleFun is a Dallas-based game studio founded and led by game industry veterans, where game developers thrive on collaboration, creativity, teamwork, and fun. Our games are played by over 25 million players each month, and we are hard at work on a number of exciting new mobile games to fuel our future growth.

We believe in bringing People together through Fun by creating best-in-class social features and communities in our games that enable our players to engage deeply with other players. We also bring our studio teammates together by creating the very best game teams, ones that foster healthy collaboration, incredible productivity, and life-long professional relationships.

Job Summary

Wordscapes is one of the most-loved word puzzle games on mobile, and a long-running live game with a huge, loyal player base. We're looking for a Senior Game Designer who can do two things really well: craft levels players can't put down, and design features that keep them coming back for years.

You'll own work end to end, from the first idea and spec through ABT, tuning and live ops. Some weeks that means reshaping the early level ramp so new players stick around longer. Other weeks it means designing a new event, meta system or level mechanic and seeing it in front of millions of players. You'll sit on a small, senior, data-literate team where good ideas ship fast and every change is measured.


Responsibilities

Level design

  • Design, build and tune crossword levels and level ramps, balancing word choice, grid layout, letter sets and difficulty.
  • Shape progression and pacing across hundreds of levels, with deliberate spikes, breathers and rewards.
  • Use per-level funnels, churn points and completion data to find where players struggle, then fix it.
  • Design new level mechanics and goals that add variety and depth without breaking the core loop.
  • Partner with engineers on tooling, procedural generation, and general collaboration.

Feature design

  • Own features end to end: pitch, spec, UX flows, reward tuning, and success metrics.
  • Design retention-focused systems for new, engaged and returning lapsed players, from FTUE to long-term meta.
  • Write clear features specs with a hypothesis, treatments and KPIs, then read results with data partners and decide next steps.
  • Work closely with product, engineering, art, UX and QA to get features shipped on time and at quality.

Across both

  • Prototype ideas quickly, on paper, in whitebox, or with AI tools, and drop what doesn't test well.
  • Play the top casual and word games and bring back sharp, specific lessons.
  • Bring your years of experience and expertise to raise the bar for design docs and reviews on the team.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of game design experience, with at least 3 years on mobile casual or puzzle games.
  • Hands-on level design: you've built, tuned and shipped levels at scale in a level editor, and can show examples.
  • Feature design: you've taken features from concept to live, and can walk us through what moved the metrics and what didn't.
  • Strong grasp of progression, pacing, difficulty curves, FTUE and retention levers.
  • Comfortable working from data: funnels, cohorts, retention curves and A/B test results.
  • Clear, structured writing. Your specs are easy for engineers, artists and QA to build from.
  • Experience working in a live game with regular releases and live ops.
  • This role is remote, with a hybrid schedule for those near our Dallas office: 4 days a week in office (Monday–Thursday) if you live in Dallas, or 3 days a week (Monday–Wednesday) if you live within a 3-hour radius.

Nice to have

  • Shipped word, crossword, puzzle or match-3 games.
  • Hands-on with Looker, BigQuery, Tableau or similar, enough to answer your own questions.
  • Designing ABTs on level content: difficulty, ramps, content swaps.
  • Spreadsheet fluency for ramp, economy and parameter tables.
  • Unity experience.
  • Procedural or AI-assisted content generation.
  • Prototypes or tools you've built with AI.
  • Experience designing for returning and lapsed players, or for social and competitive features.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We care more about how you think and what you've shipped than a perfect match.

Working at Tripledot

  • Time Off: Flexible Discretionary Time Off policy in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year.
  • Financial: Generous 401k match, discretionary bonuses, and competitive salaries.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage.

jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

As our Senior Procure to Pay Specialist, you'll own Boulevard's Procure to Pay process from end to end, from the first purchase request to the final vendor payment. It's a highly cross functional role with real visibility across the company, including our leadership team. You'll partner with Accounting, Finance, Legal, IT, and teams across Boulevard to make buying here simple, compliant, and well organized.

We act like owners. You'll have room to shape how things work, spot opportunities to automate, and see the impact of your work every day. This role is remote.

What you’ll do here:

  • Own the procurement process in Ramp, from request intake through purchase approval, guiding purchasers at each stage and making sure requests are complete, accurate, and approved on time.
  • Monitor compliance with our purchasing policy and escalate exceptions when needed.
  • Coordinate contract negotiations between internal purchasers and vendors, and keep track of renewals.
  • Collect and maintain vendor onboarding documents, like W-9s and contracts, in line with our accounting policies.
  • Own the full accounts payable process, reviewing invoices for accuracy, support, and department approval, and making sure they're coded and processed accurately and on time.
  • Collect vendor tax documentation, lead the annual 1099 process, flag invoices that may need sales or use tax review, and reconcile vendor statements to resolve discrepancies, duplicates, and payment questions.
  • Administer the company credit card program in Ramp and complete AP close tasks on the close calendar, including accruals, cutoff review, and AP subledger to general ledger reconciliation.
  • Refine and document our procurement policies, workflows, and controls, look for ways to automate, and partner with Legal, Finance, and other teams on ad hoc projects.

What you’ll need to thrive:

  • 5-8 years of experience in accounts payable, procurement, or similar roles. Experience in both is preferred.
  • A solid understanding of accounting concepts, plus familiarity with accounting systems and general operational processes.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • The ability to multitask and prioritize to meet deadlines, with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • A strong team player's mindset, with a willingness to help and learn from colleagues and a high customer service orientation.
  • An athlete mentality and adaptability.
  • A plus: experience with procurement systems (e.g. Zip, Ramp), Bill.com, and major ERPs (e.g. NetSuite) or similar systems, and experience at a SaaS, fintech, or other high-growth company.
  • BS/BA in Accounting, Finance, or a relevant field.

How we'll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $89,500 - $105,500 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

  • Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.
  • Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.
  • Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.
  • An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

Overview

The Senior Communications Specialist is the central point of coordination for print and digital customer communication requests, guiding each request from intake through review, approval, implementation, and final documentation. Working closely with lines of business, Compliance, and Legal, this role keeps communications moving so they are developed and released accurately and on time.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary intake coordinator for print and digital customer communications, managing requests from initial submission through review, approval, implementation, and final documentation, and assessing incoming requests to ensure required information is provided and requests are appropriately prioritized and routed.
  • Act as a central liaison between business stakeholders, Compliance, and Legal, organizing and facilitating communication reviews to ensure appropriate stakeholders are engaged, feedback and decisions are obtained within established timelines, and outstanding reviews, approvals, or issues are escalated.
  • Coordinate approval workflows and final communication approvals with business owners prior to implementation or production release, documenting approvals, decisions, revisions, and supporting evidence.
  • Track communication requests and changes from intake through implementation, monitoring milestones, dependencies, outstanding decisions, approvals, and completion status.

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Location: New Delhi | Reports to: Programme Director | Employment: Full-time | Experience: 5+ years

About TrustBridge

TrustBridge Rule of Law Foundation is a non-profit research think tank whose mission is to accelerate economic growth in India by strengthening the state's ability to provide a globally trusted legal and regulatory system. Founded by Akshay Jaitly and Karan Singh, we work at the intersection of law and economics on financial markets regulation, energy transition, and contracts and dispute resolution.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Research Fellow with at least five years of experience in academia, a think tank, or policy research, who uses statistical techniques to answer policy questions in finance and electricity.

What You Will Do

  • Frame the question. Identify the problems affecting markets and state capacity, and design a research strategy that separates causes from consequences.
  • Work with lawyers. Work closely with lawyers to understand the legal, regulatory and institutional structure of these markets before framing questions, and engage comfortably with legal issues as you frame questions and interpret results.
  • Do the analysis. Apply event studies, difference-in-differences, panel and time-series methods and other causal inference tools, in R or Python, to regulatory, financial market and electricity-sector data.
  • Translate to policy. Convert quantitative analysis into actionable policy recommendations.
  • Write and publish. Author blogs, working papers, policy briefs, and consultation submissions with clear, implementable recommendations.
  • Lead. Guide junior colleagues and review their work on ongoing projects.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Master's or PhD in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Public Policy or a related field
  • 5+ years of applied quantitative research experience
  • Strong grounding in econometrics and statistical techniques
  • Proficiency in R and LaTeX
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • You are excited about doing rigorous descriptive work as about finding a good identification strategy.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of Indian financial markets or the electricity sector
  • Published work, or work that has informed policy, regulation or litigation
  • Experience supervising or mentoring researchers
  • Exposure to government, regulators or reform bodies
  • You realise that understanding the institutions and the data, and describing what is going on, is as important.

Why Join Us

Collaborate with experts in law, economics and regulation, and shape debates on financial markets and energy policy in a team focused on solving problems. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.

How to Apply

Email with subject "Application — Senior Research Fellow" and include your CV and a writing sample (working paper, policy note, or article). Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

About the role

We are seeking a highly organized and customer-focused Transportation Claims Total Loss Specialist to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for working with rental facilities, body shops, salvage vendors, and appraisers to manage the total loss settlement process and rental expenses, reviewing the valuation of the vehicle based on its type to resolve the claim efficiently and reviewing damage estimates to confirm vehicles are total losses.

Your role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of claims, triaging critical claims, and delivering service to all constituents of the claim.

The ideal candidate has a willingness to work through a design process that supports the quickest claim resolution with the best outcome. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams to give feedback and identify technology and process improvements.

  • Recognize recovery opportunities in regards to subrogation and salvage, as well as total loss
  • Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures
  • Negotiating and communicating all total loss settlements per company and state guidelines within approved payment authority
  • Provide input for continuous development of claims guidelines, best practices, and process improvements
  • Oversee and direct outside investigative service providers and work closely with the client and client counsel and investigative services to resolve the claim

  • Active adjuster license: resident-state license where available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license. Willing to obtain any additional required licenses within 60 days, including state testing.
  • Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures
  • Commercial experience preferred
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate complex data and make sound decisions based on established guidelines, policies, and procedures
  • Curious and motivated by problem solving and questioning the status quo
  • Desire to engage in learning opportunities and continuous professional development
  • Willingness to travel for client and claims needs

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. Job Title: Heartbeat Lean Leader

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Senior Leader of a P&L. Not functional specific. (eg.: CEO, COO). Interprets simple internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Stays informed of industry trends that may influence work.

Job Description

Job Description Summary


This Lean Growth Leader will be part of the Radiopharmaceutical team responsible for the design, adoption, and execution of the enterprise-wide lean transformation of the Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDx) business in the United States and Canada (USCAN). They will be focused on and partnered with one (or more) of the leaders in the business for their scope of responsibility. The Lean Growth Leader will possess hands-on experience applying Lean principles and driving results through continuous improvement. They will also be a contributing leader to the overall financial performance of the business unit and drive relevant improvements to the customer experience, as well as to the experience of our field sales and commercial support colleagues.


Job Description


With business partner(s), co-own and support development of the annual “Lean Road Map” and execution plan to drive business results. Roadmap will identify:

  • Identify major processes, key performance indicators (KPIs) and process/KPI owners.
  • Prioritized improvement opportunities, impact, approach, methods, tools and timing to maximize business impact and stakeholder participation.
  • Utilize appropriate lean tools to design and execute the PDx USCAN “Growth Road Map”- with a focus on the lean tools: Problem Solving, Daily Management, Standard Work, Action Plans, Funnel management and Kaizen events. Utilize appropriate lean tools to execute the CI Plan:
  • Development of the KPI bowler aligned with the annual operating plan and process improvement opportunities.
  • Development of the action plans required to achieve the objectives for the year.
  • Development and deployment of the “kaizen funnel” required to achieve the objectives for the year and/or as part of multi-year improvement strategies.
  • Development and deployment of the “daily management” implementation funnel required to achieve the objectives for the year.
  • Application of the Problem-Solving Process (PSP) for KPIs that off target.
  • Establish and execute a roadmap to build, implement and measure Standard Work (SW) across all business partner’s processes.
  • Train and coach key team members to “build the muscle” of the organization to deploy these tools with decreasing reliance (over time) on the PDx USCAN Lean Team for support.
  • Co-own process health check-ins to assist and support leaders in the initial phases of change: Improvements are sustained, and Leader is building a culture of continuous improvement, exposing new and impactful opportunities.

Franchise Pulse Meetings are the Daily Management system to provide cross-functional teams an effective forum to review their most important KPIs and progress against improvement priorities. The Lean Growth Leader supports the business functions to:

  • Build and implement Daily Management from GENBA to support Franchise Pulse Meetings, with a coherent set of KPIs tied to the standard work.
  • Ensure proper training and coaching for effective daily management and a true “embrace the red” culture.

Support key Problem Solving efforts and drive team skill development on Problem Solving

  • Lean Growth Leader needs to be a highly effective coach at root cause problem solving in a transactional and commercial environment
  • Building good problem solving skills across the business is a high priority
  • Ensure there is focus on follow-through of identified countermeasures.

Support Hoshin Kanri and Transformation Improvement Priorities as necessary

  • Coach and develop business partner and direct reports as lean leaders
  • Build core skillsets
  • Drive continuous improvement mindset

Required Qualifications

  • BS or BA Degree
  • Overall minimum 7 years of professional commercial experience, with 3-5 years of experience applying lean tools and systems to drive continuous improvement to “transactional process improvement” opportunities and/or commercial process improvements (i.e. improving the customer experience, lead generation process, sales process, field service process, etc.)
  • Proven ability to coach/influence at senior leadership levels and cross-functional teams (including field-based teams)
  • Led many Kaizen events from Pre-work to Event to Closure
  • Coached teams thru the Kaizen/PDCA approach
  • Proficient in Problem Solving, Daily Management, Standard Work & Facilitation skills in a commercial / transactional environment
  • Excellent time and project management
  • Technical Expertise - Possess the technical skills necessary to be credible; must have significant practitioner experience in Growth & Lean tools and processes.
  • Strong commercial focus on customer and end user experience.
  • Travel: 20-25%

Desired Characteristics

  • Master’s/MBA degree preferred.
  • Healthcare and/or medical device industry experience preferred.
  • Sales experience preferred.
  • Capability to support teams/events through virtual tools (i.e. Microsoft Teams, Miro, etc.) as well as on site workshops.
  • Ideally built and/or designed an organizational management system
  • Ideally developed the playbook for the core processes of an organizational business system
  • Ability to accurately assess key business metrics and situations from a general manager’s or executive leader’s perspective
  • Deep actual experience with lean principles and practices
  • Excellent time and project management skills
  • Proven ability to quickly bring order and structure to Big Rocks and other critical programs as a key team member through the various segments, regions, and functions in the organization
  • Growth mindset with hands-on approach

jobs.description:
Client Sales Executive

General Description

Equiscript is seeking a Client Sales Executive to drive new business growth by identifying, developing, and closing agreements with covered entities, including FQHCs, hospitals, and Ryan White organizations, and by expanding service lines with current clients. The Client Sales Executive owns the sales strategy for an assigned territory, negotiates agreement terms on Equiscript's behalf within approved parameters, and advises prospective clients on how Equiscript's services can strengthen their 340B programs. Client engagement is conducted primarily through virtual meetings and at industry conferences, with in-person client site visits as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Negotiation and Deal Structuring:

  • Lead negotiations with prospective and existing clients on pricing, fee structure, service scope, and contract terms, with authority to negotiate within an approved range.

  • Determine the terms to offer within that range and present negotiated agreements with a recommendation for final approval.

  • Recommend exceptions to standard terms, with a supporting business rationale, when a client's situation warrants it.

  • Structure proposals tailored to each client's 340B program profile, contract pharmacy network, and financial goals.

  • Work closely with Legal, Finance, and Operations to finalize agreements and ensure negotiated terms can be delivered.

  • Territory Sales Strategy and Market Planning:

  • Own the sales strategy and annual plan for an assigned territory, including target markets, priority prospects, conference and event strategy, and revenue goals.

  • Analyze territory and prospect data (e.g., OPAIS registrations, entity type, contract pharmacy footprint) to decide where to focus and how to position Equiscript's services.

  • Recommend changes to go-to-market approach, service packaging, or pricing strategy based on territory feedback and competitive activity.

  • Partner with Marketing to design targeted outreach campaigns for priority segments.

  • Consultative Client Advising:

  • Assess a prospective client's 340B program to identify gaps and opportunities (e.g., referral capture, contract pharmacy coverage, savings) and advise client leadership on available options.

  • Assess a prospective client’s value-based care needs for clinical documentation to close HEDIS measures.

  • Present financial and program-impact analyses to CFOs, pharmacy directors, and executive teams to support their decision-making.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to client decision-makers on how 340B program changes and industry developments affect their organizations.

  • Maintain current knowledge of 340B regulations, industry trends, and Equiscript's service offerings and how they align with client needs.

  • Client and Prospect Engagement:

  • Meet with prospective and existing clients through virtual meetings, at industry conferences, and in person at client sites as needed, to conduct needs assessments, presentations, and negotiations.

  • Represent Equiscript at 340B industry conferences and events, engaging decision-makers and advancing sales discussions on site.

  • Follow up by phone and email to advance opportunities through the sales cycle.

  • Pipeline Management and Reporting:

  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date sales pipeline and forecasts using CRM tools.

  • Report on pipeline, win/loss trends, and territory market insights to leadership.

Professional Qualities

  • Ability to build, foster, and maintain positive professional relationships.

  • High sales drive.

  • Devotion to high-quality service levels and our cause.

  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills including verbal and written communication.

  • Professional demeanor with the ability to quickly develop trust, anticipate problems, and diffuse concerns.

  • Highly motivated, solution-oriented, and with a positive “can-do” attitude.

  • Competency in presenting client financial documents, contracts, and complex concepts.

  • Ability to work independently.

  • Thorough understanding of Equiscript’s suite of services, including the client and patient journey.

  • Positive presentation skills, with the ability to influence people in both one-on-one and group settings.

  • Flexibility to adjust to changing priorities and processes.

  • Strong PC skills (MS Office or Google Apps, web-based programs.)

  • Willingness to travel (up to 50%) to industry conferences and client sites as needed, including overnight and possible weekend travel.

  • Willingness to be flexible with work hours.

  • Proficiency leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude) to improve the quality and efficiency of work, including refining prompts and validating outputs.

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in B2B sales, with a focus on the healthcare or pharmacy industry preferred.

  • In-depth knowledge of the 340B program and contract pharmacy arrangements.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

  • Results-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.

  • Familiarity with CRM software and sales tools preferably Salesforce

Physical Requirements

  • Requires the ability to sit or stand for long periods, occasional stooping, and reaching. require lifting up to 25 pounds; and requires a normal range of vision and hearing with or without accommodation.

  • Must be able to drive.

  • This position is home office based with 50% travel. The travel for this position includes overnight travel and covers multi-state territory.

Additional Information

  • A cleared background check is required.

  • Valid driver's license, clean motor vehicle record, and ability to be insured by company insurance guidelines.

Employment Information

  • The position is remote and will require overnight travel to clients and industry events.

  • Candidates must live within 75 miles of a commercial airport with access to other cities in their territory.

  • Benefits include health plan, dental, vision, and paid time off.

  • Flex time.

  • 401k with up to a 4% company match
