jobs.title: Industry Strategy Lead, PLM
jobs.excerpt: About CoLab At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions. Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design. Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster.

Founded in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company. We’ve recently been recognized on Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post.

Role Summary

This role is a high-leverage operator reporting into the Director of Industry Strategy & Transformation, with direct exposure to revenue leadership and account owners. This role exists to define how CoLab wins and grows inside the PLM ecosystems our customers already run, turning Windchill, Teamcenter, and 3DEXPERIENCE environments into a path to enterprise adoption rather than a reason to stall.

Every enterprise engineering organization we work with has a PLM strategy, a team that owns it, and a long list of programs competing for its attention. Design decisions get made in reviews and typically land in PLM, and the gap between the two is where context gets lost, changes get re-litigated, and engineering teams lose hours every week. You will define how CoLab works with PLM, earn the trust of the IT and digital engineering leaders who own those systems, and turn PLM alignment into a repeatable advantage across the revenue org.

This is a deal-facing, customer-facing, and product-influencing role. The right person is part strategist, part operator, part competitor. Someone who can read a room of executives, build a hyper compelling value case on the fly, speak credibly to the PLM owner and the VP of Engineering in the same meeting, and close out the next step before the meeting ends.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own CoLab’s PLM strategy, including how we position alongside Windchill, Teamcenter, 3DEXPERIENCE, and the rest of the engineering stack, and how design review decisions flow into the digital thread our customers are building.
  • Map the PLM landscape inside strategic accounts, identifying who owns the roadmap, where modernization or migration programs are underway, and where review, change, and release processes break down between engineering and the system of record.
  • Build the value case for PLM and IT leaders, why CoLab strengthens their PLM investment rather than competing with it, grounded in change cycle time, ECO quality, data continuity, and adoption across engineering.
  • Run executive, IT, and engineering workshops that expose workflow friction between design reviews and PLM processes and create the urgency needed to mobilize multi-stakeholder buying groups.
  • Collaborate on deal strategy for strategic opportunities where PLM and IT sit in the buying group, partnering with account executives to coach champions, navigate architecture and security reviews, and build the executive narratives that move buying groups forward.
  • Shape CoLab’s relationships with PLM vendors and systems integrators, identifying where partnerships open doors, where they create a co-sell motion, and where they need to be managed carefully.
  • Package PLM plays that account executives and customer engineers can run without you in the room, from discovery angles by platform to integration-led expansion sequences.
  • Synthesize signals from strategic accounts into structured product feedback on integrations and the connected PLM experience, and validate product concepts with key customers so new capabilities fit how PLM-driven organizations actually work.
  • Support the Director of Industry Strategy & Transformation with boots on the ground market trends, competitive dynamics, and customer insights across the PLM ecosystem.

Who You Are

  • A mechanical engineer by background, with real-world experience in product development, engineering processes, and design collaboration.
  • You’ve lived PLM from the inside. You have a deep understanding of the industry. You bring direct experience owning PLM strategy, implementation, or operations at a manufacturer, a PLM vendor, or a systems integrator, with hands-on depth in at least one of Windchill, Teamcenter, or 3DEXPERIENCE. You know how change management, BOM, and release processes actually run, and you can talk architecture with IT and workflow with engineering.
  • You see the whole stack. You understand where PLM, CAD, ERP, MES, and point tools meet, where the digital thread breaks in practice, and how to position a new platform so it strengthens what a customer already owns.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to read a room of executives in real time. You know when to push, when to pause, when to ask the harder question, and when to take the win and move on.
  • Competitive by nature. You are wired to play to win, you put in the reps, and you run at high cadence. You take losses personally enough to learn from them but not personally enough to slow down.
  • Strong context switching ability. You can move from a board level value conversation to a PLM architecture review to a workflow mapping session back to back and bring the right focus to each one.
  • Sharp sense of time value. You understand which work compounds, which work is throwaway, and which conversations are worth a calendar hold versus a quick Slack. You make calls and you move.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate technical capability into business outcomes that resonate with VPs of Engineering, CIOs and PLM leaders, CEOs, and CFOs.
  • Operationally wired. You understand how work actually gets done inside complex organizations. You can spot process drag, identify where reviews break down, and connect workflow-level friction to business-level cost. You don’t just diagnose, you translate it into a path forward.
  • Clear, direct communicator. You write concisely, present without filler, and can build a clean, compelling deck under pressure. You know that a strong deck is a forcing function, not a deliverable, and you build them that way.
  • Fluent with AI tools as a force multiplier. You know how to use AI to compress research, sharpen messaging, and build faster. You don’t just tolerate the tools, you intentionally reach for them to do more with less.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • You have defined CoLab’s PLM strategy, and PLM and IT leaders at multiple strategic accounts are actively supporting CoLab as a result.
  • You are owning PLM and transformation workshops with our top enterprise accounts.
  • Your PLM plays are in use across the revenue team, with partner-sourced or integration-led pipeline you can point to.
  • You have meaningfully influenced and supported the outcome of multiple seven figure deals.
  • You are trusted to drive customer conversations without backup.

About Treering

At Treering, we help people capture and preserve life’s most meaningful moments — from school milestones to unforgettable travel experiences. Our innovative memory-as-a-service platform combines intuitive, AI-enabled tools with a seamless user experience to make creating personalized keepsakes easy and joyful. We’re a fast-growing, purpose-driven company expanding beyond yearbooks into travel and experiential memories, and we’re equally intentional about creating a workplace where people feel supported, empowered, and connected to the impact of their work.

About the role

    You'll be Treering's first dedicated UX researcher. There's no research team, playbook, or backlog of studies waiting for you. You'll build the practice from the ground up and make the voice of our customers part of how we decide what to build.


    You'll report to the Head of User Experience and split your time between our core yearbook business and new products built for the schools and families we already serve. This is a remote role based in the US.

What you'll do

  • Understand our four core audiences. Lead foundational research with yearbook editors, parents, students, and photography partners to understand their behaviors, goals, frustrations, and unmet needs.

  • Test ideas before we build them. Conduct generative research to find new opportunities and evaluative research to validate concepts, prototypes, and new product bets early, so we invest in what people will actually use and pay for.

  • Build an ongoing listening practice. Establish a steady rhythm of customer interviews and surveys, and analyze existing data, like product feedback and support tickets, to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Empower the team. Build an insights repository the whole company can use, so findings reach further and keep informing the product.

  • Partner with analytics. Work hand in hand with our product analytics effort, pairing what people do with why they do it.

  • Tell the story. Share actionable findings and recommendations in ways that move product designers, product managers, engineers, and executives to act.

  • Set the foundation. Establish research standards, tools, and processes, including how we recruit participants and how we research responsibly with schools and families.

Who you'll work with

    You'll work closely with product designers, product managers, engineers, our customer success team, and the analytics effort. Our teams are small, so your insights will reach the people building the product directly.

What success looks like

    In your first 90 days: You're talking with customers on a regular rhythm. Foundational studies are underway with yearbook editors and parents. An insights repository is up and running.

    In your first year: Research is a regular part of how Treering makes product decisions, and the team has an easy, ongoing way to hear from the people we serve.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of UX research experience, with qualitative methods as your core strength. You're an exceptional interviewer and listener.

  • Comfort conducting surveys and working with behavioral data, analytics tools and A/B test results, though the ability to do advanced quantitative analyses is not required.

  • Experience using AI tools to speed up research and improve its quality.

  • A track record of planning and running qualitative studies that shaped product or business decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including strong storytelling, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

  • Experience working with a cross-functional team including product managers, designers, and developers.

Bonus points

  • A background in EdTech or K-12, including working within school privacy and access constraints.

  • Research with children, including age-appropriate methods and consent/assent practices.

  • Work on consumer or e-commerce products, especially purchase flows.

  • Familiarity with B2B2C products, where you sell to organizations and serve the people inside and around them.

  • Time as a first or solo researcher, building a practice without an existing playbook.

  • Hands-on experience setting up research operations, such as participant recruiting and insights repositories.

jobs.description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

The Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) Quality Reviewer responsibilities include comprehensive secondary clinical chart reviews to identify potential missed opportunities for documentation clarification, act as a liaison between coding and CDI to resolve Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) or other code discrepancies, collaborate with CDI educator to educate CDI team based on opportunities identified in second level reviews and work directly with clinicians and providers to improve the overall quality and completeness of documentation through the query process and/or provider education. The CDI Quality Reviewer will collaborate closely with Coders, Coding Quality Auditors, Quality Department and Providers to assure documentation is clinically appropriate, accurately reflects the severity of illness and risk of mortality for the patient and is reflective of current CMS or other regulatory standards. Typically reports to the CDI Quality/Education Manager.

Job Description

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor's of Nursing, required; Master’s Degree in Nursing or Management preferred.

Licenses/Certifications:

  • Current State of Texas license or temporary/compact license to practice professional nursing
  • One of the following is required:
    • Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist (CCDS) from the Association of Clinical Documentation Improvement Specialists
    • Certified Clinical Documentation Integrity Professional (CDIP) from the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)
    • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) from the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Three (3) years of Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) experience required
  • Approved AHIMA ICD-10-CM/PCS Trainer preferred
  • Previous CDIS auditing, denial and Vizient experience preferred
  • Strong computer proficiency including working knowledge of MS Office- Word, Excel and Outlook and 3M Coding and Reimbursement software; experience with Epic EMR preferred
  • Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving skills are essential
  • Strong organizational skills and must be detail oriented
  • Highly analytical with strong risk assessment, impact analysis and problem- solving skills
  • Highly self-motivated, yet demonstrate ability to be a team player and take direction
  • Flexible and able to multi-task and prioritize daily workload, performing concurrent chart reviews as needed

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Completes comprehensive, clinical secondary reviews of targeted patient populations to include cases with DRG and/or code discrepancies; mortality reviews to ensure documentation supports risk of mortality; hospital acquired conditions (HACs), patient safety indicators (PSIs) or other top priority diagnoses as identified for potential missed opportunities to clarify documentation or clinically validate a diagnosis.
  • Analyzes and interprets clinical data to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and/or opportunities for improvement in the clinical documentation and queries the provider using concurrent query process following ACDIS/AHIMA Guidelines for a Compliant Query Practice.
  • Acts as a liaison between the Coding Department and Clinical Documentation Integrity to reconcile discrepancies in code and/or DRG assignment.
  • Communicates findings of secondary reviews to Manager.
  • Collaborates with CDI Educator/Auditor when educational needs are identified from second level reviews.
  • Researches, investigates and remains up to date on both clinical and coding guidelines in quarterly Coding Clinics as they relate to physician documentation improvement needed, in an ICD-10 coding environment.
  • Assists in overall quality, timeliness and completeness of the quality health record to ensure appropriate data, provider communication, and quality outcomes. Serves as a resource for appropriate clinical documentation.
  • Documents and tracks second level reviews and results; shares this information with Manager.
  • Collaborates with physicians and/or other clinicians to enhance understanding of the CDI program goals; ensures the medical record can be coded accurately in order to accurately reflect patient severity of illness and risk of mortality.

The Development Operations Associate is a high-impact role that keeps WomenHeart’s fundraising operations accurate, organized, and on schedule. Supporting Development team leadership, including the Sr. Director, Fundraising & Development, and the Sr. Director, Corporate Relations, this position manages gift processing and donor records, supports stewardship and funder submissions across a portfolio of individual donors, corporate sponsorships, and grants, and provides the administrative and event support that helps the team meet its fundraising goals.

Duties & Responsibilities:
Donor Relations & Stewardship
  • Process all gifts in a timely and accurate manner, including entry into the CRM.
  • Generate and send donor acknowledgements and stewardship mailings, ensuring they are personalized, accurate, and aligned with WomenHeart messaging.
  • Maintain clean and up-to-date donor records, including contact information, giving history, outreach touchpoints, and stewardship activity.

  • Support donor segmentation, reporting, and list pulls for campaigns and outreach.
  • Track pledges, payments, sponsorship commitments, and campaign progress.
  • Support development of proposals, sponsorship decks, and briefing materials for donor meetings and partnership outreach.
  • Conduct research to support fundraising strategies and donor engagement initiatives.
Grants, Sponsorships & Funder Submissions
  • Manage submission workflows for grants and funder proposals, whether developed proactively by the team or prepared in response to funder requests, including entering applications into funder portals, tracking deadlines, and maintaining a submission calendar.
  • Monitor reporting requirements and deliverable deadlines for active grants and sponsorship agreements, ensuring timely and accurate follow-through.
  • Track sponsorship benefits and fulfillment for corporate partners, coordinating with Corporate Relations, Communications, and event staff to deliver on commitments.
  • Maintain organized records of proposals, grants, and sponsorship agreements in the CRM, including submission history, outcomes, and follow-up notes.
Team & Administrative Support
  • Manage scheduling and calendar coordination for the Development team including internal meetings and external stakeholder appointments.

Event Support
  • Provide administrative and logistical support for fundraising and cultivation events.
  • Manage guest tracking, RSVP management, and follow-up communications to ensure a seamless guest experience.
  • Support coordination with event vendors, sponsors, and partners.
CRM, Data & Systems
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the CRM system (Salesforce, Raiser's Edge, EveryAction, Virtuous, or similar).
  • Generate reports, dashboards, and donor lists to support stewardship, fundraising, and development tracking.

  • Help manage competing priorities and ensure the team is prepared and organized for upcoming work.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal degree requirements.

  • Experience coordinating team calendars, meetings, and event logistics.
  • CRM/database experience (EveryAction, Salesforce, Raiser’s Edge, or similar).

  • Passion for mission-driven work and supporting donor and stakeholder engagement.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience supporting donor engagement, development operations, or event coordination.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems, including data imports and funder or grant portal management.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management tools.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

With a staff that cares deeply about health equity and the women we serve, we believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds create a strong work environment and enhance our ability to pursue our mission. We value diverse experiences and know that the right candidate may not check every box. If you believe you would excel in this role and have a passion for public health and women’s health, we strongly encourage you to apply.

We are committed to building an organization that is intentional about inclusion in how we show up for women living with heart disease and in how we show up for one another. Today, we're looking for a Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales to join our team. Our new Growth Manager will be the first conversation many senior marketing leaders have with Silverback, and the person who helps turn those conversations into clients. You'll work on new business from first touch to signed contract: qualifying inbound leads, building the pitches and proposals that win the work, keeping prospects engaged until they're ready to buy, and supporting the marketing programs that bring the next ones in.

This isn't an account management role. Once a client signs, our account teams own the relationship and the day-to-day work, so you stay focused on winning the next one. It's also not a cold-calling job: you'll work inbound leads that come from our marketing, referrals and thought leadership. You don't need formal sales training. You'll learn our methodology and sales process on live deals alongside our Chief Revenue Officer, then take on more of the pitching yourself over time. This role is ideal for a marketer who's comfortable in front of a CMO, picks up new frameworks fast, and wants to see their work show up as new revenue.

Here's what we expect from our Growth Manager, Marketing & Sales.

—What You'll Do—

  • Lead Qualification & Discovery: Be the first point of contact for every inbound lead. Research each company, judge how well it fits the clients we serve best, and run intro and discovery calls to find the opportunities worth pursuing.

  • Qualification Automation: Use HubSpot and AI tools like Claude to automate how leads are routed, researched, scored and followed up with, so we respond faster and more accurately as volume grows.

  • Sales Materials: Build the decks, audits, proposals and contracts that win new business. Partner with experts across our Paid Media, SEO, Measurement and Creative teams to tell a story that speaks to each buyer's goals.

  • Pitching & Opportunity Management: Start by supporting pitches alongside our Chief Revenue Officer, then grow into leading them yourself: presenting our approach, managing deals from first call to signed contract, and bringing in the right Silverback experts along the way.

  • Pipeline Management: Own HubSpot as our record of every lead, contact and deal. Keep it current so our forecasts are reliable and every lead gets the right follow-up.

  • Prospect Nurture: Segment our HubSpot contacts by engagement, fit and readiness to buy, then build and run email programs that keep Silverback top of mind with prospects who aren't ready yet and past opportunities worth reopening.

  • Gifting & Customer Marketing: Run and grow our client and prospect gifting program around personal and professional milestones, and expand it into a broader customer marketing program that drives referrals, repeat business and growth with existing clients.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Customer Success Manager, Enterprise, you will serve as the strategic partner for our customers, managing post-sales relationships across a portfolio of high-value accounts with $500k+ ACV and navigating complex challenges to create impactful, lasting outcomes. You will be the voice of your customers within SentinelOne, driving product adoption, ensuring retention, and delivering an exceptional experience at every touchpoint. If you are a relationship-driven professional with a technical orientation and a genuine passion for customer success, we'd love to have you on our team.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Manage post-sales relationships with a portfolio of 10-15 of our largest enterprise customers, serving as their primary advocate within SentinelOne and collaborating with internal service teams to establish critical goals, onboarding plans, and success criteria.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Full professional fluency in English, enabling seamless connection with a global customer base.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale enterprise accounts of 20,000+ employees as a Customer Success Manager, with a track record of effectively managing customer expectations and consistently delivering high levels of satisfaction.
  • A genuine customer-first mindset with a passion for building meaningful, trust-based relationships, combined with strong technical acumen and the ability to quickly understand complex challenges and offer impactful, best-practice guidance.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored to a variety of audiences and cultures, meticulous attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a self-starter attitude that thrives without constant oversight.
  • Experience with Totango or similar Customer Success platforms and Salesforce is a plus, as is a background in cybersecurity or a solid understanding of security concepts and industry terminology.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

jobs.description:
Sumer is a fast-growing professional services firm that is dedicated to championing small and medium businesses and helping communities prosper, right across the UK and Ireland. We’re at a unique point in our journey: the excitement of a scale-up combined with the stability of a growing professional services group. This is a chance to join us and help shape the future, and make a real impact.

The P&C Operations Specialist supports the delivery and continuous improvement of People & Culture systems, data and operational processes across Sumer Group.
Working within Group P&C Operations, the role helps ensure our systems and processes operate effectively, people data is accurate and reliable, and P&C colleagues receive consistent operational support.
The role combines systems administration, data management, operational delivery and project work, with opportunities to take ownership of specific processes and improvement initiatives.

As the Group continues to grow, a key focus is on improving how we work through better use of technology, clearer processes and reduced manual administration.

Key Responsibilities

P&C Systems & Operational Delivery
  • Support the day-to-day administration and ongoing development of Group P&C systems, primarily Humaans and Pinpoint.
  • Take ownership of agreed systems, modules and operational processes, ensuring they are delivered accurately and consistently.
  • Support key P&C activities including performance and engagement cycles, onboarding and offboarding workflows, and other employee lifecycle processes.
  • Support system configuration, user permissions, testing and implementation of new functionality.
  • Provide guidance and troubleshoot system or process queries raised by P&C colleagues and other users.
  • Maintain appropriate system documentation, guidance and operating procedures.

People Data, Reporting & Governance
  • Maintain and improve the accuracy, completeness and consistency of people data across the Group.
  • Conduct regular data-quality checks, identify issues and work with stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Support the maintenance of Group data standards, including organisational structures, job titles, grades and other key employee information.
  • Produce and maintain P&C reports and support the development of reporting that provides meaningful operational insight.
  • Identify opportunities to improve how data is captured and maintained, reducing the need for retrospective correction.
  • Support appropriate data governance, confidentiality and GDPR requirements.

Projects & Continuous Improvement
  • Support and, where appropriate, lead P&C operational projects and improvement initiatives, taking ownership of agreed activities and deliverables.
  • Review existing processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardise or automate activities across the Group.
  • Support the design, testing and implementation of new workflows, processes, systems and integrations.
  • Contribute to acquisition integration activity, including data preparation, system implementation and operational transition.
  • Work with relevant stakeholders to coordinate project activity, monitor progress and address risks or issues.
  • Support change management through documentation, guidance and training.

Stakeholder Support & Collaboration
  • Provide a reliable and responsive operational service to P&C colleagues across the Group.
  • Manage and respond to queries through agreed P&C Operations channels, ensuring requests are appropriately prioritised, resolved or escalated.
  • Build effective working relationships with People Support, Talent Acquisition, Employee Experience, People Partnering & Integrations and Hub P&C teams.
  • Support effective handovers and consistent ways of working between P&C Operations and the wider P&C function.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing, cross-training and the development of capability across the P&C Operations team.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to how P&C Operations supports the wider Group.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

  • Experience administering HR systems (HRIS) and applicant tracking systems. Humaans and Pinpoint are a plus.
  • Knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, such as onboarding, offboarding, and performance and engagement cycles.
  • Strong people data skills, with a keen eye for accuracy and the ability to spot and fix data issues.
  • Reporting and analysis skills to turn people data into useful insight.
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and data confidentiality.
  • A process improvement mindset, with the ability to simplify, standardise and automate.
  • Project coordination skills, including managing deliverables, risks and timelines.
  • Clear written communication, including documentation, guidance and training.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, with a responsive, service-focused approach.
  • Strong ownership and attention to detail, with the confidence to take responsibility for processes and improvements.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-growing, changing environment.

jobs.excerpt: Agentify — це міжнародна аутсорсингова компанія, яка з 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів.
jobs.description:
Agentify — це міжнародна аутсорсингова компанія, яка з 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів. За понад 13 років роботи ми виросли з локального стартапу до потужного міжнародного хабу. Сьогодні Agentify — це сотні однодумців, які працюють як у наших сучасних технологічних офісах, так і в зручному віддаленому форматі (Remote) з будь-якої точки світу. Ми обслуговуємо провідні світові бренди, спілкуємося 5 мовами та щодня допомагаємо тисячам людей. Ми працюємо на перетині технологій та комунікацій, а кожен наш співробітник стає мультифункціональним експертом, опановуючи ключові напрямки сучасного бізнесу.

Наші Core-ніші та експертиза:

  • E-commerce & Retail — повний супровід клієнтів інтернет-магазинів: від оформлення замовлень до координації міжнародної логістики та повернень.

  • Активні продажі — робота з теплими лідами, телемаркетинг, cross-sell/up-sell та повернення клієнтів до покинутих кошиків.

  • Омніканальний Customer Care — клієнтська та технічна підтримка користувачів у режимі 24/7/365.

  • Цифрові чати — спілкування з клієнтами без голосу через Live-чати на сайтах, Email та популярні месенджери (Viber, Telegram, WhatsApp).

  • Інтелектуальна телефонія — робота з сучасним програмним забезпеченням, професійними CRM-системами та AI-інструментами автоматизації.

В свою команду зараз ми шукаємоSales Specialista зі знанням німецької мови!

🌟Чому кандидати обирають Agentify?

  • Стабільність з 2013 року —прозорі виплати та впевненістьу завтрашньому дні.

  • Власна Академія —безкоштовне навчання з нуля(ділова комунікація, техніки продажів, робота з програмами та сервісами). Ми інвестуємо в розвиток співробітників і підтримуємо їх на всіх етапах адаптації.

  • Дохід без обмежень —погодинна ставка + відсоток від викупу. У продажах твій заробіток залежить насамперед від твоїх результатів.

  • Реальний кар'єрний ліфт — більшість наших Team Lead, Supervisor та QA-менеджерів виросли всередині компанії.

  • Абсолютна інклюзивність— ми вільні від стереотипів. Для нас важливі лише твої навички, енергія та бажання розвиватися.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Своєчасна оплата праці,що складається зфіксованої ставки 6,4 Євро/год + % від викупу товарів.Очікуваний місячний дохід для ТОП-спеціаліста: ~2000 євро!

  • Повністю віддалена робота.

  • Зручний позмінний графік :9.00−18.00 та з 13.00−22.00 (в кожній зміні година обіду).

  • Бонус за успішне проходження навчання

  • Дружній колектив і наставники, які завжди допоможуть.

  • Подарунки на річницю роботи та дітям співробітників на свята.

  • Спеціальні бонуси для менеджерів з найвищими показниками: індивідуальний графік, оплата спортивних абонементів або оплата курсів з іноземної мови, оплата розваг та інші привілеї.

  • Акція «Бонус за новачка» (ти отримуєш приємний бонус за кожного працівника, що прийшов по твоїй рекомендації)

Наші бізнес-цінності:

  • Відкритість—ми цінуємо вміння говорити прямо, чути інших і шукати нові підходи.

  • Надійність— для нас важливо, щоб на кожного члена команди можна було покластися, і ми створюємо умови для відповідальної роботи.

  • Безперервний розвиток—ми не чекаємо досконалості, але очікуємо бажання вчитися та вдосконалюватися.

  • Націленість на результат— ми працюємо, щоб досягати реальних результатів, а не для виконання формальних планів.

  • Клієнтоорієнтованість— ми ставимо потреби клієнтів у центр уваги та працюємо над тим, щоб забезпечувати якісний сервіс та пропонувати рішення, які створюють реальну цінність

Твої майбутні обов’язки:

  • Здійснювати дзвінки по теплій базі на нативному ринку Німеччини.

  • Виявляти потреби клієнтів, презентувати товари та працювати з запереченнями.

  • Продавати продукцію компанії за скриптами.

  • Фіксувати замовлення в CRM-системі.

Що потрібно, щоб до нас приєднатись:

  • Знання німецької мови: від рівня В2+і вище (важливо розмовний рівень)

  • ПК/ноутбук, дротова гарнітура та стабільний інтернет.

  • Вільне володіння ПК і офісними програмами.

  • Уміння продавати або бажання навчитися це робити.

  • Бажано володіння техніками продажу та роботою з запереченнями.

Що для нас важливо?

Щоб ви бачили сенс у тому, що робите, були чесними з собою та колегами й не боялися вийти за межі звичного, коли це потрібно.

Якщо ви шукаєте місце, де ваші дії справді впливають на результат, ми будемо раді познайомитися.

Надсилаючи свою заявку, ви даєте згоду на обробку ваших персональних даних компанією Agentify Ltd. з метою рекрутингу відповідно до GDPR. Ви можете відкликати свою згоду або запросити видалення ваших даних у будь-який час.

About the role

The Project Manager-Ground Up provides consulting services to our client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives for construction.

This job is part of the Project Management function responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. This is a remote role requiring project site visits equaling approximately 20%-40% day-travel weekly.

What you’ll do

  • Manage all areas of project management for commercial real estate projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.
  • Interface directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project, including the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & landmarks, quality control, and risk identification.
  • Conduct periodic site visits to monitor the progress of construction, review the status of work completed during the period covered, review that work is proceeding in a proper manner and in general accordance with the approved drawings and specifications.
  • Review contractors' direct cost payment requisitions and budget status, review of subcontracts, bonds/subcontractor default insurance, review of change orders, review of Developer's monthly Job Cost Reports, opine on adequacy of contingency, review of construction and disbursement schedules, review of lien waiver and other documentation.
  • Review contract blueprints and specifications and opine for completeness and general compliance with commonly accepted architectural /engineering standard methodologies.
  • Analyze the Developer's direct and indirect cost budget including cost estimate back-up and coordinate with the Cost Advisory group performing parameter estimates, spot quantity take-offs and review of supporting documentation submitted by the Developer, contractor, and subcontractors.
  • Review and make relevant comments concerning the terms of the construction agreement, the submitted subcontracts, architectural and engineering design agreements, building loan agreement as well as review both Contractor and Architect's qualification statements.
  • Review and comment on construction and disbursement schedules as well as other submitted documents including but not limited to zoning approvals, certified surveys, building permits and approvals, utility company approval letters, soil and foundation engineering reports, and designer's certification of code and ADA compliance.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field preferred with 5-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.

Summary:

Habitat for Humanity International works toward a world where everyone has a decent place to live. Achieving that vision requires both direct support to families and changes in the housing systems that shape whether low-income households can access affordable, appropriate, and resilient housing. jobs.description:
We're Hiring

Remote Academic Coach & Student Assistant (Part-Time, ~10 hours/week)

The steady partner who helps a high-achieving student master hard material and never miss a deadline.

About the Role

Seamless Assist is hiring a part-time Academic Coach & Student Assistant for a US-based family. You will work one-on-one, online, with their daughter, a motivated high-school student taking classes a year ahead of her grade, including several college-level Advanced Placement (AP) courses. This role reports to the student's parent.

Why This Role Exists

The student doesn't need to be taught from scratch. She is carrying a demanding, writing-heavy course load, and the pressure is in the volume: essays, problem sets, labs, tests and extracurricular deadlines all landing in the same week. This role exists to give her a sharp, organised partner who can keep up with advanced material, help her work through the hardest parts, and keep her schedule under control so nothing slips.

Her Current Classes

  • AP Microeconomics & Macroeconomics
  • AP Biology
  • AP English Language & Composition
  • AP US History
  • Pre-Calculus
  • Spanish 4
  • Journalism & News Production

You don't need to be an expert in every subject. You do need to be strong in several of them, especially writing-heavy courses (AP English Language, AP US History) and at least one of economics, biology or maths.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Academic coaching (about 70% of your time)

  • Run live one-on-one video sessions to work through homework, problem sets, essays and test preparation.
  • Explain difficult concepts clearly and check that she can explain them back.
  • Review essays and written work for argument, structure, evidence and citations, including AP-style timed essays.
  • Build practice questions, review plans and study guides ahead of tests and the AP exams in May.
  • Learn how each course is taught and graded (syllabi, teacher rubrics, the College Board AP course frameworks) and coach to them.
  • Coach, never complete. Her work must always be her own, in line with her school's academic integrity rules.

Planning and student assistant support (about 30% of your time)

  • Run a weekly planning session: map every class's assignments, tests and deadlines into a shared calendar and task list.
  • Keep her schedule current across classes, activities and appointments, with study time blocked in.
  • Send short reminders before deadlines and confirm work was actually submitted.
  • Track grades and flag early when something starts to slip.
  • Send the parent a short weekly progress update.

Schedule

About 10 hours per week. Sessions fall on weekday afternoons and evenings, US Pacific Time (roughly 3:30–8:30 pm PT), plus one short weekend planning session. You must be reliably available in that window.

Who Will Succeed in This Role

This is a high-trust role with a bright, busy teenager. You will need real subject depth, patience, and the organisational discipline of a strong executive assistant.

  • You explain things clearly and can tell the difference between "I get it" and actually getting it.
  • You are a strong writer and can give specific, useful feedback on an argumentative essay.
  • You run your own life from a calendar and a task list, and you follow up without being asked.
  • You are warm, steady and encouraging, and you hold a high standard.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in education, English, history, economics, biology, mathematics or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of tutoring or teaching high-school or first-year university students.
  • Strong command of the material in several of the subjects listed above.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Your writing will be assessed during screening.
  • Uses AI tools in your daily work (for example Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) to build study materials and plan faster, and can teach a student to use them responsibly and within school rules.
  • Able to work US Pacific Time afternoons and evenings, about 10 hours per week.
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, a webcam and a backup power or internet plan.
  • Willing to complete a national police clearance or background check and provide two professional references before starting.

Nice to have

  • Experience with the US Advanced Placement (AP) programme, or strong AP, SAT, IB or A-Level results of your own.
  • Conversational or better Spanish.
  • Journalism, editing or newsroom experience.
  • Comfortable in Google Workspace (Calendar, Docs, Drive) and a task tool such as Notion or Todoist.

How We Work

Because this role involves working one-on-one with a teenager, clear safeguards apply. All sessions run on a family-owned video account and are recorded. All messages go through a group channel that includes a parent. There is no private messaging or social-media contact with the student. A background check and references are required before the first paid session.

Pay

Competitive hourly pay, paid monthly in USD. Pay varies by country.

How to Apply

Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short AI-led video interview, a written subject task, an interview with the family and a paid trial session.

The Role

You will be the strategic owner of our Salesforce codebase and architecture across the entire group. You will design and build custom logic and user interfaces, connect Salesforce with our products and third-party systems, and make sure everything we ship is secure, scalable, and well within platform limits.

This is not a role for someone who waits for perfectly written tickets. You will work closely with Salesforce Admins and business stakeholders, challenge requirements where needed, make architectural decisions, and proactively identify and fix problems before they affect users.

What You'll Work On

  • Develop scalable custom logic with Apex classes and triggers
  • Build user interfaces with Lightning Web Components, and maintain existing Aura Components and Visualforce pages
  • Build and maintain API integrations connecting Salesforce with our products (Ship2Port, Routescanner), the wider group's platforms, and third-party applications
  • Work across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Subscriptions, and CPQ
  • Evaluate business requirements together with Salesforce Admins for security, governor limits, and scalability
  • Manage release cycles and deployments across sandboxes and production using Salesforce CLI and Git
  • Maintain high test coverage, follow Salesforce coding best practices, and document code effectively
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (Claude) as part of your daily workflow
  • Participate in architecture and technical direction decisions — your opinion will carry weight

What We're Looking For

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of professional Salesforce development experience
  • Strong command of Apex (classes, triggers, asynchronous Apex) and Lightning Web Components
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Bulk, Platform Events) and building integrations with external systems
  • Production experience with Sales Cloud and Service Cloud
  • Solid understanding of governor limits, the Salesforce security model, and scalable data design
  • Experience with Salesforce CLI, Git-based workflows, and release management across sandboxes and production
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I and Platform Developer II certifications
  • Clean code as a practice — you write code your colleagues can confidently extend
  • Genuine ability to self-direct: loosely defined problem -> breakdown -> delivery

Strong plus:

  • Experience with Experience Cloud, Subscriptions, and CPQ
  • Experience with Aura Components and Visualforce (maintaining and migrating legacy code)
  • Salesforce JavaScript Developer certification
  • Salesforce Architect or cloud-specific certifications
  • Experience with CI/CD for Salesforce (e.g. GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar)
  • Background in maritime, logistics, media, or B2B SaaS
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and Salesforce AI features

How We Work

  • Small team, high trust — no micromanagement, no approval chains for every decision
  • Git-centric workflow — PRs, reviews, and automated pipelines keep quality high without bureaucracy
  • Observability-first — we monitor, alert, and fix things before users notice
  • Clean code culture — we refactor, we review, we don't let tech debt compound silently
  • Periodic on-site workshops in the Torun/Bydgoszcz area (every few months)

What We Offer

  • Competitive B2B rate benchmarked to your market
  • Remote-friendly setup — we care about output, not location
  • Group-wide impact — your work supports maritime platforms used 24/7 across Europe and a portfolio of 200+ web properties
  • Real architectural ownership of the Salesforce platform, not just ticket execution
  • A lean, senior team where your technical decisions actually ship
  • AI tooling as a first-class part of the workflow — not an afterthought

About Royal Dirkzwager

Royal Dirkzwager is a Dutch maritime and logistics intelligence company behind products used by port authorities, terminals, shipping agencies, freight forwarders, and cargo owners across Europe and beyond. Our portfolio includes Ship2Port, a 24/7 maritime intelligence and ISPS security platform tracking 200,000+ vessels worldwide, and Routescanner, a container logistics platform that helps shippers compare and optimize intermodal routes based on transit time, carrier reliability, and CO₂ emissions.

Salesforce is the commercial backbone of our group — it supports sales, customer service, subscriptions, and partner portals not only for our maritime products but also for our wider group portfolio of 200+ web properties. We are looking for a senior Salesforce developer who thrives on ownership and does not need hand-holding to deliver.

jobs.description:
Vice President of Marketing

Location: Remote (US) — up to 35% travel to our Santa Barbara, CA headquarters, customer sites, industry events, and analyst meetings

Come build with us. In this role, you will own how the market sees CrossnoKaye — defining the story, positioning, and brand that make ATLAS and our Advanced Process Control (APC) the recognized standard for Software-Defined Automation in heavy industry, and building the team that turns that story into pipeline.

We’re hiring: A player-coach marketing executive from industrial automation, controls, or manufacturing technology. You have marketed AI or other new technology to conservative industrial buyers. You will personally own positioning, segment messaging, product marketing, and analyst relations, and you will build and lead the team that runs demand generation, ABM, and events.

This role reports to: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO)

What you’ll be doing:

What you’ll own directly (player):

  • Marketing strategy: Own CK’s 2026–2028 Marketing Strategy — finalize the strategy deck, keep it current, and bring in the findings of our ARC Advisory Group engagement. Food Processing (APC) is the primary market; Cold Storage stays in maintenance mode.
  • Positioning, segment messaging & personas: Own company and product positioning, the messaging house, and the messaging and buyer personas for each segment. You make the final call; our Product Marketing Manager builds the work.
  • Brand & category: Lead CK’s Software-Defined Automation (SDA) category strategy — the manifesto, the annual State of SDA report, and our point of view — and stand up brand measurement (share of voice, branded search, analyst positioning), reported to the executive team every quarter.
  • Product marketing & launches: Lead product marketing for ATLAS, APC, Energy AI and AURA, and for new products as they ramp (Intelligence, DCS). Install a Pragmatic-style launch framework with product, starting with the next major release.
  • Analyst relations: Own CK’s analyst relationships — ARC Advisory Group and LNS Research first, then ABI and IDC — with a goal of a named ARC research note by the end of 2027. There is no separate analyst relations role; the Channel & Partner Marketing Manager supports from Q4 2027.
  • Executive visibility & PR: Raise the profile of CrossnoKaye and our founders through founder-led bylines, podcasts, speaking, and tier-1 trade media, working with our PR agency.
  • Plan, budget & pipeline: Own the annual marketing plan, budget, and headcount, and the company’s marketing-sourced pipeline target (10% → 25% → 35% from 2026 to 2028), with a pipeline definition and attribution model agreed with sales (and RevOps once the open Director of Revenue Operations seat is filled).

What you’ll build and lead (coach):

  • Demand generation & ABM: Lead our Director of Demand Generation & Marketing Operations and the ABM & Demand Generation Manager (joining in 2027) as they scale ABM across the Top 200 North American food & beverage processors. You set the targeting, tiers, and messaging; the team runs the engine.
  • Product marketing: Lead our Product Marketing Manager (PMM), who covers Food Processing and Cold Storage. Add a second PMM for new products and verticals in the second half of 2027, gated on product releases (Intelligence, DCS) and new verticals.
  • Events: Lead our Events Lead and the three-tier program: the Innovation Summit (75 → 150 → 200 attendees), a food processing trade-show footprint (IPPE, Pack Expo, FA&M, NAMI, ARC Industry Forum; IIAR for cold storage), and road shows and dinners that produce pipeline.
  • Customer marketing & sales enablement: Build case study, reference, and customer advisory board programs, and make sure sales has the plays, battlecards, ROI tools, and proof from every pilot and deployment.
  • Channel & partner marketing: Hire and lead a Channel & Partner Marketing Manager by Q4 2027 to build co-marketing with Amazon, Koch, systems integrators, analysts, and other partners.
  • Team, agencies & culture: Hire, coach, and grow a high-performing team and agency bench (PR, creative, SEO, events) with clear goals, an operating cadence, and career paths.

What we’re looking for:

  • 15+ years of B2B marketing, including 7+ years leading marketing teams and at least 5 years in industrial automation, controls, or manufacturing technology — ideally at (or competing with) Siemens, Schneider Electric, Rockwell Automation, Emerson, Honeywell, ABB, AspenTech, AVEVA, or similar.
  • Experience marketing AI, software, or other new technology to manufacturing and heavy industry — for example industrial AI, advanced process control (APC), Software-Defined Automation (SDA), IIoT, or energy optimization.
  • Fluency with industrial buying committees (VP of Operations, plant manager, Director of Controls & Automation, engineering, CFO, CIO/CDO) and the credibility to hold your own with each of them.
  • A track record of positioning and launching new products end to end — from market definition and messaging through sales enablement and measured adoption.
  • Hands-on analyst relations experience that turned briefings into coverage and category validation.
  • Proven ownership of brand strategy and brand measurement, and of a marketing-sourced pipeline number that you hit.
  • A genuine player-coach: you write the positioning document yourself, and you have built teams and leaders who run demand generation, ABM, and events at scale.
  • Executive presence and judgment — at ease with the CEO, the board, customers, analysts, and the press.

Nice to Have:

  • Category-creation experience — you have named, evangelized, and defended a category before.
  • An engineering, controls, or automation background (or a degree that lets you keep pace with one).
  • Experience in food & beverage processing, industrial refrigeration, or aggregates.
  • Experience with the Pragmatic Institute framework and a modern, AI-enabled marketing stack.

What Success Looks Like:

  • 3 months — Marketing Strategy Deck finalized with ARC’s findings; positioning, messaging house, and segment personas adopted by sales and leadership; brand baseline set; ARC and LNS briefings held; 2027 plan, budget, and pipeline definition agreed with sales and RevOps.
  • 6 months — First major launch delivered end to end under the new launch framework; ABM live across the Top 200 food processor tiers, with the ABM & Demand Gen Manager in seat; State of SDA report published; 2028 Summit and events calendar locked.
  • 9 months — On track for a named ARC research note by year-end; brand metrics up against baseline; marketing-sourced pipeline on track for 25% in 2027 on the way to ~35% in 2028; core team (Director, PMM, ABM Manager, Events Lead) performing; Channel & Partner Marketing Manager hired.

Compensation:

The estimated base salary range for this role is $225,000-$250,000. In addition to base pay, full-time team members are eligible for a company-wide bonus and equity options - giving you the opportunity to grow alongside the company and share in the long-term success we’re building together. Estimated total cash compensation may range from approximately $255,000- $283,000.

Final compensation is determined by several factors including prior experience, skills, and alignment with the role. The range above is intended to provide a helpful benchmark, though it may be updated as needed.

Why Join CrossnoKaye?

  • Impactful Mission: Be part of a team driving sustainable transformation in a resource-heavy industry.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with advanced IoT solutions and industry-leading experts.
  • Career Growth: As we scale, you’ll have opportunities for personal and professional advancement.
  • Inclusive Culture: We love innovation, embrace curiosity, and value well-being and professional development.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary with equity opportunities
  • Health, dental, vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan and parental leave
  • Untracked PTO and sick days
  • Cell phone reimbursements and other perks

At CrossnoKaye, we believe industrial performance is unlocked, not built. Our AI-native platform understands how a plant operates, predicts what’s changing, and either guides the crew or runs the controls itself, driving continuous improvements in throughput, yield, energy and uptime. Join us to help heavy industry get more from the plants it already owns.

jobs.excerpt: Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way.
jobs.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

PTC's Organizational Change Management (OCM) practice has grown from a founding idea into a profitable, high-demand business in the U.S., backed by a rapidly expanding pipeline and a roster of Fortune 500 aerospace, defense, MedTech and industrial manufacturing customers. The next chapter of this growth story is EMEA, and we're looking for a Director, EMEA OCM & Customer Adoption leader to lead it.

This is a rare opportunity for a leader who wants to build and run a business, not simply deliver a service. You will take full, end-to-end ownership of the EMEA region. This includes adapting a proven U.S. playbook to Europe's customers, culture, and market dynamics, with accountability for regional bookings and revenue, direct people leadership, and a mandate to shape how digital transformation and change management show up across strategic EMEA customers.


This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: equal parts regional general manager, change-management practitioner, and cross-functional orchestrator, working \with Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, Customer Success Managers, Business Solution Managers, and Market/Regional leaders across Europe. It reports directly to PTC's Global OCM & Adoption Leader and carries the same level of strategic visibility as our most senior Customer Success leadership roles.

OCM is not a niche delivery function at PTC, it is a named growth priority with active, ongoing sponsorship from PTC's CEO and Customer Success leadership.


Key Responsibilities


1. Regional Commercial Leadership & GTM Strategy

Build and execute an EMEA-specific go-to-market strategy for OCM and digital transformation, in partnership with Business Solution Managers, Market Leads, and Regional Directors.

Own EMEA OCM bookings and revenue targets, with disciplined forecasting and reporting into the global OCM leadership cadence.

Personally shape, scope, and price complex OCM opportunities; especially Director+ and executive-level conversations that require deep change-management and transformation expertise.

Convert the existing and emerging EMEA pipeline, spanning global aerospace, industrial equipment, and automotive manufacturers, into signed, delivered engagements.

Partner with Sales, BSMs, and Market Leads so OCM is embedded into the deal cycle from the start.


2. Global Methodology Partnership & Regional Adaptation

Partner closely with the Global OCM and Adoption Delivery Leader — who owns and drives PTC's global OCM methodology — to adapt and localize the delivery playbook and toolkits for EMEA, ensuring the region applies the methodology consistently and with fidelity to the global standard.

Identify where EMEA-specific adaptation is required -- language, works councils, data residency, and customer culture, and lead that localization effort.

Maintain delivery quality and consistency with the global framework as the region scales.

Represent the EMEA perspective in the ongoing evolution of the global methodology, helping it mature into a truly global capability.


3. Team & Cross-Functional Leadership Across Europe

Directly manage and grow the EMEA OCM delivery team, starting with the regional delivery hub and scaling headcount as pipeline converts to backlog.

Partner day-to-day with Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, and Customer Success leadership across Europe to embed OCM into delivery engagements from kickoff through go-live.

Represent OCM in regional leadership forums, quarterly business reviews, and strategic account planning sessions.

Build strong working relationships with country and market leads to ensure OCM is positioned consistently across every EMEA geography.


4. Coaching, Mentoring & Executive Presence

Coach and mentor direct reports and extended EMEA adoption/OCM contributors, including Customer Success Managers delivering OCM packages.

Represent OCM at EMEA leadership meetings, quarterly business reviews, customer executive sessions, and industry events.

Build trusted-advisor relationships with customer executives, PTC's regional leadership, and cross-functional peers.

Champion OCM's value story internally so EMEA Customer Success Managers, BSMs, and sales leaders confidently and consistently bring OCM into customer conversations.


5. Delivery Excellence & Practice Economics

Own delivery quality and customer outcomes across all EMEA OCM and digital-transformation engagements.

Manage the practice's economics, staffing, utilization, and margin, for the regional team.

Develop reusable, scalable delivery assets tailored to EMEA-specific needs.

Cultivate customer success stories and reference-ability across the region.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in organizational change management, digital transformation, or large-scale enterprise system implementations, including leadership of a regional or country-level business unit.

Proven track record of building and scaling a services or consulting practice, owning bookings, revenue, and margin, not delivery alone.

Deep OCM/change-management expertise (Prosci or equivalent certification preferred), ideally applied to PLM, ALM, CAD, or other enterprise digital transformation programs.

Demonstrated ability to lead a direct team while operating as a peer to Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, and Sales leadership across multiple countries and cultures.

Executive presence to engage Director-level and C-suite stakeholders in complex change and transformation conversations.

Experience building go-to-market strategy and enabling sales/BSM teams to position, scope, and sell a specialized offering.

Based in, or with strong professional ties to, Europe; fluent English required, additional European languages a strong plus.

Willingness and ability to travel extensively across the EMEA region.

Licensed Registered Dietitian — Clinical

Reports To: Manager of RDs

States we are hiring from: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Michigan, Missouri, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Wisconsin (High preference for PST/MST or willingness to work later schedule)

Preferred License: Texas or Florida

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

As a Registered Dietitian at Oshi Health, you'll deliver personalized, evidence-based nutritional care to patients managing complex digestive conditions — all virtually, from wherever you are. You'll work alongside a collaborative team of GI practitioners and mental health professionals to provide whole-person care that truly makes a difference. This role is at the heart of our mission to transform GI care and give patients the relief they deserve.

What You'll Do — Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver virtual patient care using evidence-based protocols including low FODMAP and targeted elimination diets, tailored to each patient's digestive condition
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of GI NP/PAs, and psychologists to ensure a coordinated, whole-person approach to care
  • Develop individualized nutritional care plans that align with Oshi's clinical protocols and evidence-based practice guidelines
  • Document patient interactions accurately and in a timely manner within the EHR
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and contribute to the ongoing development of company-wide nutritional best practices
  • Engage in professional training activities to stay current and continuously advance your clinical knowledge base
  • Share insights and feedback with your team to improve patient experience and outcomes as Oshi scales

What We're Looking For — Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • Master's Degree in Food and Nutrition/Dietetics
  • Completion of an ACEND-accredited internship
  • Active RD or RDN license with ability to be credentialed by insurance
  • Minimum 2–4 years of outpatient clinical experience
  • Must have strong knowledge of GI and use evidence based treatment plans
  • Strong ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a multidisciplinary care team

Preferred

  • Familiarity with telehealth platforms and electronic health record systems
  • Experience in a digital health or high-growth startup environment

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: Commensurate with experience, with annual bonus eligibility
  • Health Benefits: 90% employee premiums paid for medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Time Off: 3 weeks paid PTO + paid holidays throughout the year
  • Retirement: Eligibility to contribute to 401(k)
  • Work Style: Remote-first flexibility — work from home anywhere within our accepted states
  • Growth: Personalized guidance from our Licensure Specialist, access to a CME management platform, and membership to peer-reviewed research tools
  • Support: Access to a dedicated Life Concierge through Overalls

About Oshi Health

Oshi Health is a virtual digestive health practice on a mission to transform GI care. We combine compassionate, multidisciplinary care with innovative technology to help people with chronic digestive conditions get the answers and relief they deserve. When you join Oshi, you're joining a team — and a mission — that's changing what great healthcare looks like.

We take time to get to know each patient and develop a personalized, whole-person care plan that includes identification of symptom triggers and evidence-based interventions including medications, dietary changes, and mental health support.

For Every Oshi Team Member We Want:

  • Genuine passion for improving patient lives and transforming GI care
  • Strong communication skills and emotional intelligence
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, remote-first, mission-driven environment

jobs.description:
Chef d’équipe – Ingénierie (Réunions et Événements)

WhereTo est une entreprise de voyages d’affaires de San Francisco qui a évoluée en un studio de développement et de conception agile au sein de la famille Flight Centre. Nous construisons des solutions de voyage utilisées par certaines des plus grandes entreprises de la planète - nous n’avons qu’un seul objectif : rendre les voyages d’affaires meilleurs pour tout le monde.

WhereTo fournit une plateforme de voyages d'affaires optimisée par l'IA. Elle utilise des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatiques pour recommander des options de voyage personnalisées en fonction des préférences du voyageur, des politiques de l'entreprise et de son budget. La technologie de WhereTo permet également le suivi des voyages en temps réel, la création de rapports et l'analyse des coûts, ce qui permet aux entreprises d'optimiser leurs programmes de voyages et de réduire leurs coûts.

Pour en savoir plus sur WhereTo, cliquez ICI.

À propos du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Chef d’équipe – Réunions et Événements pour favoriser l’excellence en ingénierie au sein d’une plateforme dédiée aux conférences, aux voyages de groupe et aux événements de grande envergure. Vous dirigerez une équipe talentueuse, définirez la stratégie technique et développerez des solutions innovantes en utilisant des technologies modernes, tout en ayant un impact direct sur l’expérience client.

Principales responsabilités

  • Collaborer avec les équipes de direction technique, de produit et d’exploitation des réunions et événements afin d’élaborer et de mettre en œuvre les objectifs stratégiques.
  • Diriger la planification technique et la mise en œuvre dans les domaines suivants : ◦ Recherche de lieux ◦ Processus d’appel d’offres ◦ Inscription des participants ◦ Gestion des blocs de chambres ◦ Budgétisation des événements ◦ Outils de reporting
  • Assurer la fiabilité et la performance des systèmes dédiés aux réunions et événements pendant les périodes de pointe en matière de réservations, lors des ouvertures des inscriptions et pendant les événements en direct.
  • Superviser les intégrations avec les hôtels, les lieux d’accueil, les fournisseurs et les plateformes technologiques événementielles tierces.
  • Encourager la responsabilisation, maintenir le rythme de travail de l’équipe et garantir la fourniture constante de solutions de haute qualité.
  • Animer des séances de planification, des réunions debout, des entretiens individuels et les réunions d’équipe régulières.
  • Communiquer l’état d’avancement des projets, les jalons, les risques et les obstacles à la direction et aux parties prenantes.
  • Diriger des réunions avec les organisateurs d’événements, les clients, les fournisseurs, les partenaires de sites et les prestataires technologiques.
  • Promouvoir les améliorations techniques, le renforcement des infrastructures et la réduction de la dette technique.
  • Assurer le leadership technique, réaliser des revues de code et promouvoir les meilleures pratiques d’ingénierie.
  • Encadrer, conseiller et accompagner les ingénieurs à différentes étapes de leur carrière.
  • Soutenir les initiatives de recrutement, d’intégration et de développement des talents au sein de l’équipe.
  • Aider les ingénieurs à relever des défis techniques complexes et à résoudre les problèmes de production ayant un impact sur les événements.
  • Diriger l’estimation des projets, la planification des versions et les activités de déploiement tout en gérant les délais fixes des événements et la demande saisonnière.
  • Contribuer à créer un environnement de travail sûr, inclusif et accessible, où tous les « Flighties » se sentent bienvenus, respectés et soutenus pour s'épanouir.
  • Autres tâches et responsabilités assignées.

Expérience et compétences

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie informatique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou au moins 4 ans d’expérience professionnelle en tant que collaborateur et responsable.
  • Solide expérience dans la livraison de projets et de produits destinés à une large base d’utilisateurs.
  • Expérience dans la gestion d’équipes, de projets ou d’équipes techniques.
  • Solides compétences en communication, en collaboration et en gestion des parties prenantes.
  • Capacité à évaluer des technologies et à prendre des décisions architecturales éclairées.
  • Expérience pratique de Node.js, React, RabbitMQ, des API SOAP et REST, des langages basés sur la JVM, de Kafka et de la pile ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
  • Expérience avec PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch et Druid/Superset.
  • Expérience avec Docker, AWS et/ou Azure, Vault, HAProxy, LDAP, OpenVPN, PGBouncer et d’autres technologies d’infrastructure similaires.
  • Une expérience dans le développement de produits destinés au secteur des réunions, des événements, des voyages de motivation (incitatifs) ou des voyages de groupe constitue un atout.
  • Une connaissance des processus de recherche de lieux, des flux de travail liés aux appels d’offres (RFP), de la gestion de blocs de chambres, de l’inscription des participants ou des plateformes de gestion d’événements est souhaitable.
  • Une expérience en intégration avec des systèmes technologiques liés à l’hôtellerie, aux lieux d’accueil, aux fournisseurs ou à l’événementiel constitue un atout.
  • Une connexion Internet fiable et à haut débit est requise pour assurer les responsabilités essentielles du poste, y compris, sans s’y limiter, la vidéoconférence, l’accès aux systèmes de l’entreprise et le traitement sécurisé des données de l’entreprise.
  • Le bilinguisme français/anglais est requis, en raison de la nature de la poste qui consiste à traiter avec des membres de l'équipe français et anglais.

Des conditions de travail qui ont de quoi séduire!

FCTG est reconnue dans le monde entier pour ses avantages sociaux exceptionnels et sa culture d'entreprise attrayante. Nous savons que nos collaborateurs représentent notre atout le plus précieux. C'est la passion et le dévouement de nos équipes qui permettent à l'entreprise de rester au sommet de son secteur. Voilà pourquoi nous offrons des avantages sociaux et des primes hors du commun à notre personnel.

  • Profitez de la liberté et de la flexibilité d'une structure de travail hybride qui combine le travail à distance et en personne.
  • Amusez-vous :l’importance d’avoir du plaisir au travail chez Flight Centre imprègne chacun de nos gestes.
  • Récompenses et reconnaissance : célébrez vos succès et ceux des autres lors des fameuses soirées Buzz que nous organisons régulièrement, ainsi qu’au rassemblement mondial annuel. Il faut le vivre pour le croire !
  • Puisez dans votre génie : nos collaborateurs se servent de leur vivacité d’esprit, de leur savoir-faire et de leur persévérance pour trouver en tout temps une solution.
  • L'amour du voyage : notre société a été fondée par des personnes qui voulaient voyager et qui souhaitaient que d'autres fassent comme nous. Cette passion se retrouve dans notre personnel et nos services.
  • Des liens personnels : le fondement de notre grande entreprise repose sur les relations personnelles.
  • Diversité, équité et inclusion: engagement en faveur de la diversité, de l'équité et de l'inclusion par le biais d'initiatives telles que la Journée de la diversité (congé payé pour observer un jour férié ou une célébration culturelle de son choix), les groupes de ressources pour les employés (équité raciale, équité entre les sexes, LGBTQ2IA+, accessibilité, justice environnementale), les initiatives de formation DEI et les pratiques équitables, y compris les évaluations régulières de l'équité et les protocoles de recrutement inclusifs.

  • Nous restons en tout temps aux côtés de nos employés :nous nous engageons fermement à soutenir chaque employé dans son développement professionnel et personnel.
  • Donner en retour :nous nous engageons à faire la différence par le biais de notre programme de responsabilité sociale d'entreprise, qui soutient des organisations caritatives désignées par le biais du bénévolat et de la collecte de fonds, de notre programme environnemental pour les bureaux, des espaces de bureaux certifiés LEED® Gold, et d'une journée de bénévolat rémunérée par année civile.

Voici un aperçu des avantages offerts :

  • Une structure de rémunération avantageuse;

  • Programmes de santé et de bien-être et services de bien-être financier des employés

  • Programme d’avantages sociaux comprenant notamment l'assurance maladie complémentaire, les soins dentaires et les soins de la vue, les soins liés à l'affirmation du genre, les soins de fertilité;

Location – Remote, Canada
